HelpCircle,\n  PlayCircle,\n  CheckCircle2,\n  Trash2,\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\nfunction isWhatShouldIDoIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ماذا') ||\n    s.includes('أعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('اعمل ايه') ||\n    s.includes('نعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('نعلم ايه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدأ بإيه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدا بايه') ||\n    s.includes('المطلوب مني') ||\n    s.includes('what should i do') ||\n    s.includes('what to do') ||\n    s.includes('what now') ||\n    s.includes('next task')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFinishedIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('خلصت') ||\n    s.includes('أنهيت') ||\n    s.includes('انهيت') ||\n    s.includes('تم الانتهاء') ||\n    s.includes('انتهيت') ||\n    s.includes('finished') ||\n    s.includes('i finished') ||\n    s.includes('done') ||\n    s.includes('completed')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isSkipIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تخطي') ||\n    s.includes('تخطى') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز دي') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز دي') ||\n    s.includes('تأجيل') ||\n    s.includes('skip') ||\n    s.includes('skip this') ||\n    s.includes('skip mission')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWrapUpIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص يومي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('إنهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('انهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('مراجعة اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up today') ||\n    s.includes('daily review') ||\n    s.includes('review my day')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWeeklyReviewIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الأسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الاسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('show my week') ||\n    s.includes('weekly review') ||\n    s.includes('my week')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFrustrationIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تعبت') ||\n    s.includes('زهقت') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادر') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادرة') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('صعب جدا') ||\n    s.includes('صعبة جدا') ||\n    s.includes('tired') ||\n    s.includes('exhausted') ||\n    s.includes('too hard') ||\n    s.includes('i want to stop') ||\n    s.includes('give up') ||\n    s.includes('frustrated')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isParentOverrideIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ليه وقت المذاكرة اتغير') ||\n    s.includes('ليه خطتي اتغيرت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه المهام قلت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('إشعار توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('اشعار توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('why parent') ||\n    s.includes('why was my study time changed') ||\n    s.includes('why did study time change') ||\n    s.includes('why did my plan change')\n  );\n}\n\nexport const CompanionChatScreen: React.FC = () => {\n  const {\n    t,\n    language,\n    student,\n    settings,\n    currentDayRecord,\n    missionsForToday,\n    activeMission,\n    startMission,\n    completeMission,\n    skipMission,\n    setActiveTab,\n    currentDailyReview,\n    isDailyReviewOpen,\n    openDailyReview,\n    closeDailyReview,\n    generateAndOpenWeeklyReview,\n    plannerExplanation,\n  } = useApp();\n  const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);\n  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');\n  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);\n  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [showReconstructModal, setShowReconstructModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showClearConfirmModal, setShowClearConfirmModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showStage, setShowStage] = useState(false);\n\n  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n\n  const studentName = student?.name || (isArabic ? 'صديقي' : 'Friend');\n\n  // Load existing conversation or initialize with introductory message\n  useEffect(() => {\n    async function loadChat() {\n      try {\n        const storedConv = student?.id ? await storageService.getConversation(student.id) : null;\n        if (storedConv && storedConv.messages.length > 0) {\n          setMessages(storedConv.messages);\n        } else {\n          // Welcome message directly adhering to the prompt rules\n          const initialGreeting: ChatMessage = {\n            id: 'msg_welcome_' + Date.now(),\n            role: 'assistant',\n            content: isArabic\n              ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا «الرفيق الدراسي الذكي». أنا نظام ذكاء اصطناعي للتعلم، لست معلماً بشرياً ولست هنا لتقييمك أو معاتبتك. وظيفتي هي تنظيم يومك الدراسي، ومساعدتك لفهم المواد بهدوء وبدون ضغط. كيف كان يومك أو ما الذي تود التحدث عنه؟`\n              : `Hello ${studentName}! I am your AI School Companion. I am an AI system, not a human teacher, and I am not here to judge or scold you. My purpose is to help structure your school day, untangle difficult topics, and ensure you study effectively without burnout. How is your day going?`,\n            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n          };\n          setMessages([initialGreeting]);\n          if (student?.id) {\n            const newConv: AIConversation = {\n              id: 'conv_' + student.id,\n              studentId: student.id,\n              messages: [initialGreeting],\n              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            };\n            await storageService.saveConversation(newConv);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.error('Failed to load conversation:', e);\n      }\n    }\n\n    loadChat();\n  }, [studentName, isArabic, student?.id]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n  }, [messages, isSending]);\n\n  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);\n\n  const handleSendMessage = async (textToSend?: string) => {\n    const content = (textToSend || inputText).trim();\n    if (!content || isSending) return;\n\n    setErrorMessage(null);\n    setInputText('');\n\n    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {\n      id: 'msg_u_' + Date.now(),\n      role: 'user',\n      content,\n      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n    };\n\n    const updatedHistory = [...messages, userMessage];\n    setMessages(updatedHistory);\n    setIsSending(true);\n\n    try {\n      let replyContent = '';\n\n      // 1. Check Mission Intent: \"What should I do now?\"\n      if (isWhatShouldIDoIntent(content)) {\n        const topPending =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending' || m.status === 'started');\n\n        if (topPending) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `المهمة المقترحة لك الآن بأعلى أولوية هي:\\n🎯 «${topPending.title}»\\n📚 المادة: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} دقيقة\\n💡 لماذا الآن؟ ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ المصدر: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nهل نتوكل على الله ونبدأها الآن؟`\n            : `Your highest priority mission right now is:\\n🎯 \"${topPending.title}\"\\n📚 Subject: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} min\\n💡 Why now? ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ Origin: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nReady to get started?`;\n        } else if (missionsForToday.length > 0 && missionsForToday.every((m) => m.status === 'completed')) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ما شاء الله عليك يا ${studentName}! 🌟 لقد أكملت جميع مهام اليوم بنجاح (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). استرح واستمتع بوقتك، لقد أنجزت يومك بامتياز!`\n            : `Fantastic job ${studentName}! 🌟 You completed all your daily missions (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). Take a restful break!`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهام مجدولة حالياً. يمكنك الانتقال إلى الشاشة الرئيسية وضبط وقت المذاكرة المتاح لنرتب لك مهام اليوم فوراً.`\n            : `No missions are planned yet. You can check the Home screen and adjust your available time to generate today's missions.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 2. Check Mission Intent: \"I finished\"\n      else if (isFinishedIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ممتاز يا بطلة! لتسجيل إتمام مهمة «${targetMission.title}» رسمياً في سجل إتقانك، تعالي نفتح تمرين المهمة السريع لنتأكد من تثبيت الفكرة ونمنحك نجوم الإنجاز! ⭐`\n            : `Great job! To record completion of \"${targetMission.title}\" in your mastery records, let's open the quick mission check to verify understanding and earn your stars! ⭐`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `رائع جداً! كل مهام اليوم مسجلة كمكتملة، ولا توجد مهمة قيد التنفيذ الآن.`\n            : `Great! All missions are already completed, no active mission pending right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 3. Check Mission Intent: \"Skip this\"\n      else if (isSkipIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          await skipMission(targetMission.id, 'Student skipped via companion chat');\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `تم تخطي مهمة «${targetMission.title}» بناءً على رغبتك.\\n\\n📌 الملاحظة والأثر الأكاديمي:\\nلا تقلق إطلاقاً يا ${studentName}! هذا ليس تقصيراً. سنقوم فقط بإعادة إدراج هذه المفاهيم في خطة قادمة بهدوء حتى لا تفوتك أساسيات المادة، وبدون أي إرهاق لوقتك اليوم.`\n            : `Mission \"${targetMission.title}\" has been skipped per your request.\\n\\n📌 Consequence & Note:\\nNo worries at all, ${studentName}! This is not a failure. We will simply reschedule these concepts in a future study session so you stay on track, keeping your schedule stress-free.`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهمة نشطة لتخطيها حالياً.`\n            : `There is no active mission to skip right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 4. Check Daily Review Intent: \"wrap up today\" / \"لخص يومي\"\n      else if (isWrapUpIntent(content)) {\n        const review = await openDailyReview();\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `حاضر يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد المراجعة اليومية الهادئة:\\n\\n✨ إنجاز اليوم: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 الخطوة القادمة: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nتم فتح نافذة المراجعة التفصيلية لتطّلع عليها بارتياح.`\n          : `Sure thing, ${studentName}! I have prepared your calm daily review:\\n\\n✨ Win Today: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 Next Step: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nYour Daily Review card has been opened for you.`;\n      }\n      // 4b. Check Weekly Review Intent: \"show my week\" / \"لخص أسبوعي\"\n      else if (isWeeklyReviewIntent(content)) {\n        const wkReview = await generateAndOpenWeeklyReview(true);\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `بكل سرور يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد ملخص أسبوعك الدراسي:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageAr}\\n\\n📊 إنجاز الواجبات: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}٪)\\n🎯 التركيز المقترح للأسبوع القادم: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleAr}\\n\\nتم فتح تبويب المراجعة لتتصفح كامل تفاصيل أسبوعك بهدوء.`\n          : `With pleasure, ${studentName}! I have prepared your weekly summary:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageEn}\\n\\n📊 Homework: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}%)\\n🎯 Recommended focus: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleEn}\\n\\nI have switched to the Review tab for you to see all the details!`;\n      }\n      // 5. Check AI Tutor Escalation Ladder (\"I don't understand\" / \"Explain differently\")\n      else if (isEscalationTrigger(content)) {\n        const targetConceptId =\n          activeMission?.conceptId ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.conceptId)?.conceptId ||\n          '';\n\n        if (!student?.id || !targetConceptId) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? 'أحتاج أولاً إلى تحديد الطالب والمفهوم الذي نعمل عليه. افتحي مهمة اليوم أو اختاري درساً من المنهج، ثم قولي لي «اشرحي بطريقة تانية».'\n            : 'I first need the active student and the concept we are working on. Open today’s mission or choose a curriculum lesson, then ask me to explain it differently.';\n        } else {\n          const tutorResponse = advanceTutorEscalation({\n          studentId: student?.id || '',\n          conceptId: targetConceptId,\n          sessionId: 'companion_session',\n          language,\n        });\n\n        const label = isArabic ? tutorResponse.modalityLabelAr : tutorResponse.modalityLabelEn;\n        const attemptLabel = isArabic\n          ? `(المحاولة ${tutorResponse.state.attemptCount} من ٥)`\n          : `(Attempt ${tutorResponse.state.attemptCount} of 5)`;\n\n        replyContent = `[${label} ${attemptLabel}]\\n\\n${tutorResponse.text}`;\n\n        if (tutorResponse.checkQuestion) {\n          const q = tutorResponse.checkQuestion;\n          replyContent += isArabic\n            ? `\\n\\n❓ سؤال فحص فهم تشجيعي:\\n${q.question}\\n• الخيارات: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`\n            : `\\n\\n❓ Comprehension Check Question:\\n${q.question}\\n• Options: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`;\n        }\n\n        if (tutorResponse.modality === 'flag_for_review') {\n          replyContent += isArabic\n            ? `\\n\\n📌 ملحوظة: تم وسم المفهوم لخانة (المراجعة اللاحقة) لحمايتك من الإرهاق. ما رأيك أن ننتقل لنشاط آخر خفيف؟`\n            : `\\n\\n📌 Note: Concept marked for (Later Review) to prevent fatigue. Would you like to move on to a lighter activity?`;\n        }\n        }\n      }\n      // 6. Check Student Frustration / Disengagement (Failure mode 1g)\n      // \"Signal detected (session drop, skip streak, tone) -> Companion offers a break or lighter load -> No guilt\"\n      else if (isFrustrationIntent(content)) {\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سلامتك يا ${studentName}! لما تحس بالتعب أو الزهق، أحسن قرار هو إنك تاخد راحة (10 إلى 15 دقيقة) وتفصل خالص. راحتك وصحتك أهم من أي مذاكرة.\\n\\n✨ تحب نخفف خطة اليوم ونكتفي بما أنجزته، ولا نوقف خالص دلوقتي وتستريح؟ مفيش أي مشكلة إطلاقاً، والأيام جاية!`\n          : `Take a deep breath and a gentle pause, ${studentName}! When fatigue or frustration hits, taking a 10-15 minute screen break is the best move. Your well-being comes first.\\n\\n✨ Would you like to lighten today's missions or call it a day? Zero guilt either way!`;\n      }\n      // 6b. Check Parent Override Intent (Failure mode 1h: Student asks why)\n      else if (isParentOverrideIntent(content)) {\n        const msg = plannerExplanation?.parentOverrideMessage;\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سؤال في محله يا ${studentName}! تم ضبط خطة المذاكرة اليوم لتراعي توجيه ولي أمرك:\\n\\n🛡️ «${msg || 'تم وضع حد زمني مناسب أو موعد نوم هادئ'}»\\n\\nالهدف مش تقليل قدراتك، بل حمايتك من السهر والإرهاق عشان تستمتع بيومك وتصحى بكامل نشاطك. وظيفتي أساعدك تنجز الأساسيات في هذا الوقت بدون أي ضغط!`\n          : `Great question, ${studentName}! Your study plan was adapted to respect your parent's settings:\\n\\n🛡️ \"${msg || 'Daily study limit or bedtime set by parent'}\"\\n\\nThis isn't a restriction, but a healthy safeguard against fatigue and late nights so you can rest. I'm here to ensure you get the most out of your focused study time comfortably!`;\n      }\n      // 7. General Chat via server proxy with 15s timeout & telemetry\n      else {\n        const { data } = await costLatencyService.instrumentedFetch(\n          '/api/chat',\n          {\n            messages: updatedHistory.slice(-8).map((m) => ({\n              role: m.role,\n              content: m.content,\n            })),\n            studentName,\n            grade: student?.grade || 'Grade 5',\n            language,\n            schoolBrainContext: {\n              studentId: student?.id,\n              school: student?.school,\n              location: student?.location,\n              curriculumTrack: student?.curriculumTrack,\n              dayRecord: currentDayRecord\n                ? {\n                    date: currentDayRecord.date,\n                    confirmed: currentDayRecord.confirmed,\n                    lessons: currentDayRecord.lessonsCovered,\n                    homework: currentDayRecord.homeworkAssigned.map((h) => ({\n                      subject: h.subject,\n                      description: h.description,\n                      status: h.status,\n                    })),\n                    notes: currentDayRecord.notes,\n                  }\n                : null,\n              activeMission: activeMission\n                ? {\n                    id: activeMission.id,\n                    subject: activeMission.subject,\n                    lessonId: activeMission.lessonId,\n                    conceptId: activeMission.conceptId,\n                    title: activeMission.title,\n                    status: activeMission.status,\n                    whyNow: activeMission.whyNow,\n                  }\n                : null,\n            },\n          },\n          {\n            studentId: student?.id,\n            language: isArabic ? 'ar' : 'en',\n            timeoutMs: 15000,\n          }\n        );\n\n        replyContent =\n          data.reply ||\n          (isArabic ? 'أنا معاك، نقدر نكمل!' : \"I'm with you, let's continue!\");\n      }\n\n      const assistantMessage: ChatMessage = {\n        id: 'msg_a_' + Date.now(),\n        role: 'assistant',\n        content: replyContent,\n        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n      };\n\n      const finalMessages = [...updatedHistory, assistantMessage];\n      setMessages(finalMessages);\n\n      // Auto-voice if enabled in settings\n      if (settings?.companionVoiceEnabled) {\n        voiceService.speak(replyContent, language);\n      }\n\n      // Persist to storage\n      if (student?.id) {\n        await storageService.saveConversation({\n          id: 'conv_' + student.id,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          messages: finalMessages,\n          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      console.error('Chat error:', err);\n      const assistantFallback: ChatMessage = {\n        id: 'msg_fallback_' + Date.now(),\n        role: 'assistant',\n        content: isArabic\n          ? 'سمعتك بوضوح. كرفيق ذكاء اصطناعي، أنا مبرمج أكون معاك في كل خطوة. نقدر نرتب جدولك وموادك في أي لحظة.'\n          : 'I heard you clearly. As your AI companion, I am set up to assist you with every step of your study routine.',\n        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n      };\n      const finalMessages = [...updatedHistory, assistantFallback];\n      setMessages(finalMessages);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSending(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleClearChat = async () => {\n    if (!confirm(isArabic ? 'هل تريد مسح سجل المحادثة بالكامل؟' : 'Clear entire conversation transcript?')) return;\n    const initialGreeting: ChatMessage = {\n      id: 'msg_welcome_' + Date.now(),\n      role: 'assistant',\n      content: isArabic\n        ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! تم مسح سجل المحادثة السابق. أنا رفيقك التعليمي، هنا لمساعدتك في أي وقت بهدوء وبدون أي ضغط.`\n        : `Hello ${studentName}! pb-2\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-1\">\n          {samplePrompts.map((p, idx) => (\n            <button\n              key={idx}\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => handleSendMessage(p)}\n              disabled={isSending}\n              className=\"px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-[11px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 transition-colors\"\n            >\n              {p}\n            </button>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Input Bar */}\n      <div className=\"p-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900\">\n        <form\n          onSubmit={(e) => {\n            e.preventDefault();\n            handleSendMessage();\n          }}\n          className=\"flex items-center gap-2\"\n        >\n          <VoiceInputControl\n            buttonSize=\"md\"\n            onTranscriptConfirmed={(confirmedText) => {\n              handleSendMessage(confirmedText);\n            }}\n            onFallbackToText={() => {\n              inputRef.current?.focus();\n            }}\n          />\n\n          <input\n            ref={inputRef}\n            type=\"text\"\n            value={inputText}\n            onChange={(e) => setInputText(e.target.value)}\n            placeholder={t.companion.inputPlaceholder}\n            disabled={isSending}\n            className=\"flex-1 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 font-medium disabled:opacity-50\"\n          />\n\n          <button\n            type=\"submit\"\n            disabled={!inputText.trim() || isSending}\n            className=\"px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-40 text-white font-semibold text-xs shadow-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center shrink-0\"\n          >\n            <Send className=\"w-4 h-4 rtl:rotate-180\" />\n          </button>\n        </form>\n      </div>\n\n      {showReconstructModal && (\n        <DayRecordFlowModal onClose={() => setShowReconstructModal(false)} />\n      )}\n\n      {isDailyReviewOpen && currentDailyReview && (\n        <DailyReviewModal\n          review={currentDailyReview}\n          onClose={closeDailyReview}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {/* PHASE 11: The Stage Modal */}\n      {showStage && (\n        <StageModal\n          lessonId=\"off_ar_u1_l2\"\n          onClose={() => setShowStage(false)}\n        />\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport { ChatMessage, AIConversation } from '../../types';\nimport { storageService } from '../../services/storage';\nimport { voiceService } from '../../services/voice/voiceService';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../../services/curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport { isEscalationTrigger, advanceTutorEscalation } from '../../services/tutor/tutorEngine';\nimport { Badge } from '../common/Badge';\nimport { DayRecordFlowModal } from '../dayRecord/DayRecordFlowModal';\nimport { DailyReviewModal } from '../home/DailyReviewModal';\nimport { StageModal } from '../stage/StageModal';\nimport { VoiceInputControl } from '../voice/VoiceInputControl';\nimport { VoiceSpeakButton } from '../voice/VoiceSpeakButton';\nimport { costLatencyService } from '../../services/telemetry/costLatencyService';\nimport {\n  Bot,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Sparkles,\n  AlertCircle,\n  CalendarCheck,\n  HelpCircle,\n  PlayCircle,\n  CheckCircle2,\n  Trash2,\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\nfunction isWhatShouldIDoIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ماذا') ||\n    s.includes('أعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('اعمل ايه') ||\n    s.includes('نعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('نعلم ايه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدأ بإيه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدا بايه') ||\n    s.includes('المطلوب مني') ||\n    s.includes('what should i do') ||\n    s.includes('what to do') ||\n    s.includes('what now') ||\n    s.includes('next task')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFinishedIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('خلصت') ||\n    s.includes('أنهيت') ||\n    s.includes('انهيت') ||\n    s.includes('تم الانتهاء') ||\n    s.includes('انتهيت') ||\n    s.includes('finished') ||\n    s.includes('i finished') ||\n    s.includes('done') ||\n    s.includes('completed')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isSkipIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تخطي') ||\n    s.includes('تخطى') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز دي') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز دي') ||\n    s.includes('تأجيل') ||\n    s.includes('skip') ||\n    s.includes('skip this') ||\n    s.includes('skip mission')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWrapUpIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص يومي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('إنهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('انهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('مراجعة اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up today') ||\n    s.includes('daily review') ||\n    s.includes('review my day')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWeeklyReviewIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الأسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الاسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('show my week') ||\n    s.includes('weekly review') ||\n    s.includes('my week')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFrustrationIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تعبت') ||\n    s.includes('زهقت') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادر') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادرة') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('صعب جدا') ||\n    s.includes('صعبة جدا') ||\n    s.includes('tired') ||\n    s.includes('exhausted') ||\n    s.includes('too hard') ||\n    s.includes('i want to stop') ||\n    s.includes('give up') ||\n    s.includes('frustrated')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isParentOverrideIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ليه وقت المذاكرة اتغير') ||\n    s.includes('ليه خطتي اتغيرت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه المهام قلت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('إشعار توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('اشعار توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('why parent') ||\n    s.includes('why was my study time changed') ||\n    s.includes('why did study time change') ||\n    s.includes('why did my plan change')\n  );\n}\n\nexport const CompanionChatScreen: React.FC = () => {\n  const {\n    t,\n    language,\n    student,\n    settings,\n    currentDayRecord,\n    missionsForToday,\n    activeMission,\n    startMission,\n    completeMission,\n    skipMission,\n    setActiveTab,\n    currentDailyReview,\n    isDailyReviewOpen,\n    openDailyReview,\n    closeDailyReview,\n    generateAndOpenWeeklyReview,\n    plannerExplanation,\n  } = useApp();\n  const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);\n  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');\n  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);\n  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [showReconstructModal, setShowReconstructModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showClearConfirmModal, setShowClearConfirmModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showStage, setShowStage] = useState(false);\n\n  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n\n  const studentName = student?.name || (isArabic ? 'صديقي' : 'Friend');\n\n  // Load existing conversation or initialize with introductory message\n  useEffect(() => {\n    async function loadChat() {\n      try {\n        const storedConv = student?.id ? await storageService.getConversation(student.id) : null;\n        if (storedConv && storedConv.messages.length > 0) {\n          setMessages(storedConv.messages);\n        } else {\n          // Welcome message directly adhering to the prompt rules\n          const initialGreeting: ChatMessage = {\n            id: 'msg_welcome_' + Date.now(),\n            role: 'assistant',\n            content: isArabic\n              ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا «الرفيق الدراسي الذكي». أنا نظام ذكاء اصطناعي للتعلم، لست معلماً بشرياً ولست هنا لتقييمك أو معاتبتك. وظيفتي هي تنظيم يومك الدراسي، ومساعدتك لفهم المواد بهدوء وبدون ضغط. كيف كان يومك أو ما الذي تود التحدث عنه؟`\n              : `Hello ${studentName}! I am your AI School Companion. I am an AI system, not a human teacher, and I am not here to judge or scold you. My purpose is to help structure your school day, untangle difficult topics, and ensure you study effectively without burnout. How is your day going?`,\n            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n          };\n          setMessages([initialGreeting]);\n          if (student?.id) {\n            const newConv: AIConversation = {\n              id: 'conv_' + student.id,\n              studentId: student.id,\n              messages: [initialGreeting],\n              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            };\n            await storageService.saveConversation(newConv);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.error('Failed to load conversation:', e);\n      }\n    }\n\n    loadChat();\n  }, [studentName, isArabic, student?.id]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n  }, [messages, isSending]);\n\n  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);\n\n  const handleSendMessage = async (textToSend?: string) => {\n    const content = (textToSend || inputText).trim();\n    if (!content || isSending) return;\n\n    setErrorMessage(null);\n    setInputText('');\n\n    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {\n      id: 'msg_u_' + Date.now(),\n      role: 'user',\n      content,\n      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n    };\n\n    const updatedHistory = [...messages, userMessage];\n    setMessages(updatedHistory);\n    setIsSending(true);\n\n    try {\n      let replyContent = '';\n\n      // 1. Check Mission Intent: \"What should I do now?\"\n      if (isWhatShouldIDoIntent(content)) {\n        const topPending =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending' || m.status === 'started');\n\n        if (topPending) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `المهمة المقترحة لك الآن بأعلى أولوية هي:\\n🎯 «${topPending.title}»\\n📚 المادة: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} دقيقة\\n💡 لماذا الآن؟ ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ المصدر: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nهل نتوكل على الله ونبدأها الآن؟`\n            : `Your highest priority mission right now is:\\n🎯 \"${topPending.title}\"\\n📚 Subject: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} min\\n💡 Why now? ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ Origin: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nReady to get started?`;\n        } else if (missionsForToday.length > 0 && missionsForToday.every((m) => m.status === 'completed')) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ما شاء الله عليك يا ${studentName}! 🌟 لقد أكملت جميع مهام اليوم بنجاح (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). استرح واستمتع بوقتك، لقد أنجزت يومك بامتياز!`\n            : `Fantastic job ${studentName}! 🌟 You completed all your daily missions (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). Take a restful break!`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهام مجدولة حالياً. يمكنك الانتقال إلى الشاشة الرئيسية وضبط وقت المذاكرة المتاح لنرتب لك مهام اليوم فوراً.`\n            : `No missions are planned yet. You can check the Home screen and adjust your available time to generate today's missions.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 2. Check Mission Intent: \"I finished\"\n      else if (isFinishedIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ممتاز يا بطلة! لتسجيل إتمام مهمة «${targetMission.title}» رسمياً في سجل إتقانك، تعالي نفتح تمرين المهمة السريع لنتأكد من تثبيت الفكرة ونمنحك نجوم الإنجاز! ⭐`\n            : `Great job! To record completion of \"${targetMission.title}\" in your mastery records, let's open the quick mission check to verify understanding and earn your stars! ⭐`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `رائع جداً! كل مهام اليوم مسجلة كمكتملة، ولا توجد مهمة قيد التنفيذ الآن.`\n            : `Great! All missions are already completed, no active mission pending right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 3. Check Mission Intent: \"Skip this\"\n      else if (isSkipIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          await skipMission(targetMission.id, 'Student skipped via companion chat');\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `تم تخطي مهمة «${targetMission.title}» بناءً على رغبتك.\\n\\n📌 الملاحظة والأثر الأكاديمي:\\nلا تقلق إطلاقاً يا ${studentName}! هذا ليس تقصيراً. سنقوم فقط بإعادة إدراج هذه المفاهيم في خطة قادمة بهدوء حتى لا تفوتك أساسيات المادة، وبدون أي إرهاق لوقتك اليوم.`\n            : `Mission \"${targetMission.title}\" has been skipped per your request.\\n\\n📌 Consequence & Note:\\nNo worries at all, ${studentName}! This is not a failure. We will simply reschedule these concepts in a future study session so you stay on track, keeping your schedule stress-free.`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهمة نشطة لتخطيها حالياً.`\n            : `There is no active mission to skip right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 4. Check Daily Review Intent: \"wrap up today\" / \"لخص يومي\"\n      else if (isWrapUpIntent(content)) {\n        const review = await openDailyReview();\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `حاضر يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد المراجعة اليومية الهادئة:\\n\\n✨ إنجاز اليوم: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 الخطوة القادمة: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nتم فتح نافذة المراجعة التفصيلية لتطّلع عليها بارتياح.`\n          : `Sure thing, ${studentName}! I have prepared your calm daily review:\\n\\n✨ Win Today: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 Next Step: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nYour Daily Review card has been opened for you.`;\n      }\n      // 4b. Check Weekly Review Intent: \"show my week\" / \"لخص أسبوعي\"\n      else if (isWeeklyReviewIntent(content)) {\n        const wkReview = await generateAndOpenWeeklyReview(true);\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `بكل سرور يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد ملخص أسبوعك الدراسي:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageAr}\\n\\n📊 إنجاز الواجبات: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}٪)\\n🎯 التركيز المقترح للأسبوع القادم: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleAr}\\n\\nتم فتح تبويب المراجعة لتتصفح كامل تفاصيل أسبوعك بهدوء.`\n          : `With pleasure, ${studentName}! I have prepared your weekly summary:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageEn}\\n\\n📊 Homework: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}%)\\n🎯 Recommended focus: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleEn}\\n\\nI have switched to the Review tab for you to see all the details!`;\n      }\n      // 5. Check AI Tutor Escalation Ladder (\"I don't understand\" / \"Explain differently\")\n      else if (isEscalationTrigger(content)) {\n        const targetConceptId =\n          activeMission?.conceptId ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.conceptId)?.conceptId ||\n          '';\n\n        if (!student?.id || !targetConceptId) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? 'أحتاج أولاً إلى تحديد الطالب والمفهوم الذي نعمل عليه. افتحي مهمة اليوم أو اختاري درساً من المنهج، ثم قولي لي «اشرحي بطريقة تانية».'\n            : 'I first need the active student and the concept we are working on. Open today’s mission or choose a curriculum lesson, then ask me to explain it differently.';\n        } else {\n          const tutorResponse = advanceTutorEscalation({\n          studentId: student?.id || '',\n          conceptId: targetConceptId,\n          sessionId: 'companion_session',\n          language,\n        });\n\n        const label = isArabic ? tutorResponse.modalityLabelAr : tutorResponse.modalityLabelEn;\n        const attemptLabel = isArabic\n          ? `(المحاولة ${tutorResponse.state.attemptCount} من ٥)`\n          : `(Attempt ${tutorResponse.state.attemptCount} of 5)`;\n\n        replyContent = `[${label} ${attemptLabel}]\\n\\n${tutorResponse.text}`;\n\n        if (tutorResponse.checkQuestion) {\n          const q = tutorResponse.checkQuestion;\n          replyContent += isArabic\n            ? `\\n\\n❓ سؤال فحص فهم تشجيعي:\\n${q.question}\\n• الخيارات: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`\n            : `\\n\\n❓ Comprehension Check Question:\\n${q.question}\\n• Options: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`;\n        }\n\n        if (tutorResponse.modality === 'flag_for_review') {\n          replyContent += isArabic\n            ? `\\n\\n📌 ملحوظة: تم وسم المفهوم لخانة (المراجعة اللاحقة) لحمايتك من الإرهاق. ما رأيك أن ننتقل لنشاط آخر خفيف؟`\n            : `\\n\\n📌 Note: Concept marked for (Later Review) to prevent fatigue. Would you like to move on to a lighter activity?`;\n        }\n        }\n      }\n      // 6. Check Student Frustration / Disengagement (Failure mode 1g)\n      // \"Signal detected (session drop, skip streak, tone) -> Companion offers a break or lighter load -> No guilt\"\n      else if (isFrustrationIntent(content)) {\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سلامتك يا ${studentName}! لما تحس بالتعب أو الزهق، أحسن قرار هو إنك تاخد راحة (10 إلى 15 دقيقة) وتفصل خالص. راحتك وصحتك أهم من أي مذاكرة.\\n\\n✨ تحب نخفف خطة اليوم ونكتفي بما أنجزته، ولا نوقف خالص دلوقتي وتستريح؟ مفيش أي مشكلة إطلاقاً، والأيام جاية!`\n          : `Take a deep breath and a gentle pause, ${studentName}! When fatigue or frustration hits, taking a 10-15 minute screen break is the best move. Your well-being comes first.\\n\\n✨ Would you like to lighten today's missions or call it a day? Zero guilt either way!`;\n      }\n      // 6b. Check Parent Override Intent (Failure mode 1h: Student asks why)\n      else if (isParentOverrideIntent(content)) {\n        const msg = plannerExplanation?.parentOverrideMessage;\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سؤال في محله يا ${studentName}! تم ضبط خطة المذاكرة اليوم لتراعي توجيه ولي أمرك:\\n\\n🛡️ «${msg || 'تم وضع حد زمني مناسب أو موعد نوم هادئ'}»\\n\\nالهدف مش تقليل قدراتك، بل حمايتك من السهر والإرهاق عشان تستمتع بيومك وتصحى بكامل نشاطك. وظيفتي أساعدك تنجز الأساسيات في هذا الوقت بدون أي ضغط!`\n          : `Great question, ${studentName}! Your study plan was adapted to respect your parent's settings:\\n\\n🛡️ \"${msg || 'Daily study limit or bedtime set by parent'}\"\\n\\nThis isn't a restriction, but a healthy safeguard against fatigue and late nights so you can rest. I'm here to ensure you get the most out of your focused study time comfortably!`;\n      }\n      // 7. General Chat via server proxy with 15s timeout & telemetry\n      else {\n        const { data } = await costLatencyService.instrumentedFetch(\n          '/api/chat',\n          {\n            messages: updatedHistory.slice(-8).map((m) => ({\n              role: m.role,\n              content: m.content,\n            })),\n            studentName,\n            grade: student?.grade || 'Grade 5',\n            language,\n            schoolBrainContext: {\n              studentId: student?.id,\n              school: student?.school,\n              location: student?.location,\n              curriculumTrack: student?.curriculumTrack,\n              dayRecord: currentDayRecord\n                ? {\n                    date: currentDayRecord.date,\n                    confirmed: currentDayRecord.confirmed,\n                    lessons: currentDayRecord.lessonsCovered,\n                    homework: currentDayRecord.homeworkAssigned.map((h) => ({\n                      subject: h.subject,\n                      description: h.description,\n                      status: h.status,\n                    })),\n                    notes: currentDayRecord.notes,\n                  }\n                : null,\n              activeMission: activeMission\n                ? {\n                    id: activeMission.id,\n                    subject: activeMission.subject,\n                    lessonId: activeMission.lessonId,\n                    conceptId: activeMission.conceptId,\n                    title: activeMission.title,\n                    status: activeMission.status,\n                    whyNow: activeMission.whyNow,\n                  }\n                : null,\n            },\n          },\n          {\n            studentId: student?.id,\n            language: isArabic ? const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_LOGS);\n      if (raw) {\n        this.logs = JSON.parse(raw);\n        this.pruneOldLogs();\n      }\n      this.initialized = true;\n    } catch (e) {\n 'partial' : 'vague',\n        degraded: true,\n        source: 'local_parser_fallback',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const systemInstruction = `\nYou are the \"AI School Companion\" Day Record extractor for a ${grade} student named \"${studentName}\".\nThe student has just come home from school and described their day in free-text: \"${trimmedInput}\".\nToday's timetable scheduled subjects are: ${JSON.stringify(todayTimetableSubjects)}.\n\nYOUR TASK:\nExtract the concrete lessons covered and homework assigned into structured JSON.\nCRITICAL RULES:\n1. Do not hallucinate or invent subjects that the student did not attend or mention.\n2. If the student explicitly names a subject not in the timetable, capture it accurately.\n3. \"homeworkAssigned\": [\n    { \"subject\": \"string\", \"description\": \"string\", \"dueDate\": \"string (optional)\" }\n  ],\n  \"notes\": \"string (optional)\",\n  \"detectedConfidence\": \"high\" | \"partial\" | \"vague\",\n  \"isSilence\": boolean,\n  \"isVague\": boolean\n}\n`.trim();\n\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || });\n\n    const text = response.text || '{}';\n    const parsed = JSON.parse(text);\n\n    res.json({\n      lessonsCovered: parsed.lessonsCovered || [],\n      homeworkAssigned: isVague: Boolean(parsed.isVague),\n      source: 'gemini',\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('Reconstruct Day API Error:', error);\n    res.json({\n      lessonsCovered: [],\n      homeworkAssigned: [],\n      notes: req.body?.studentInput || '',\n      detectedConfidence: 'vague',\n      isSilence: false,\n      isVague: true,\n      degraded: true,\n      source: app.get('*', (_req, res) => {\n    res.sendFile(path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist', 'index.html'));\n  });\n}\n\napp.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => {\n  console.log(`AI School Companion Server running on  "new_content": "import express from 'express';\nimport dotenv from 'dotenv';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'url';\nimport { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai';\n\ndotenv.config();\n\nconst __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst app = express();\nconst PORT = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000;\n\napp.use(express.json({ limit: '15mb' }));\n\n// Initialize GoogleGenAI\nconst apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;\nconst ai = apiKey\n  ? new GoogleGenAI({\n      apiKey,\n      httpOptions: {\n        headers: {\n          'User-Agent': 'aistudio-build',\n        },\n      },\n    })\n  : null;\n\n// Quota & Rate Limit Protection (Circuit breaker for 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED)\nlet globalQuotaCooldownUntil = 0;\n\nfunction isQuotaExhaustedError(err: any): boolean {\n  if (!err) return false;\n  const status = err.status || err.code;\n  const msg = String(err.message || err).toLowerCase();\n  return (\n    status === 429 ||\n    msg.includes('429') ||\n    msg.includes('resource_exhausted') ||\n    msg.includes('quota') ||\n    msg.includes('rate limit')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction handleAiError(scope: string, err: any) {\n  if (isQuotaExhaustedError(err)) {\n    // 10-minute cooldown where no external calls are made; graceful fallbacks are served\n    globalQuotaCooldownUntil = Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000;\n  } else {\n    console.warn(`[${scope}] handled gracefully:`, err?.message || err);\n  }\n}\n\n// Health check endpoint\napp.get('/api/health', (_req, res) => {\n  res.json({\n    status: 'ok',\n    hasApiKey: Boolean(apiKey),\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n  });\n});\n\n// Chat API endpoint for Companion\napp.post('/api/chat', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { messages = [], studentName = 'طالب', grade = 'Grade 5', language = 'ar', schoolBrainContext = null } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const lastUserMsg = (messages[messages.length - 1]?.content || '').trim();\n    const lowerUserMsg = lastUserMsg.toLowerCase();\n\n    // Specific intent detection for Phase 3\n    const isDontUnderstand =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش فاهم') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش فاهمة') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes(\"don't understand\") ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('dont understand') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes(\"don't get it\");\n\n    const isExplainDifferently =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح بطريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('طريقة تانية') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اشرح تاني') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('explain differently') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('another way') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('مش واضحة');\n\n    const isTestMe =\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اختبرني') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اسألني سؤال') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('اختبار') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('test me') ||\n      lowerUserMsg.includes('quiz me');\n\n    if (!ai || Date.now() < globalQuotaCooldownUntil) {\n      // Graceful offline/local companion fallback if API key is not yet set or during quota cooldown\n      let fallbackReply = '';\n      if (isDontUnderstand) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `ولا يهمك خالص يا ${studentName}! عادي جداً متفهمش من أول مرة، دي خطوة طبيعية في التعلم. قولي إيه أكثر نقطة حسيتها ملخبطة وهنبسطها سوا خطوة بخطوة.`\n          : `No worries at all, ${studentName}! Tell me which part felt tricky, and we'll break it down step by step together.`;\n      } else if (isExplainDifferently) {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `حاضر يا ${studentName}! تعال نجرب مثال من حياتنا اليومية أو نشبه الموضوع بحاجة بنشوفها كل يوم. قولي تحب نبدأ من أول فكرة ولا من النص؟`\n          : `Sure thing, ${studentName}! Let's look at this with a simple real-world analogy. Ready for a quick, friendly question on what we discussed? Take your time!`;\n      } else {\n        fallbackReply = isArabic\n          ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا رفيقك الذكي للتعلم. أنا هنا علشان أسمعك وأساعدك تنظم يومك وتفهم اللي محتاجه بهدوء ودون أي ضغط.`\n          : `Hello ${studentName}! I am your AI School Companion. I am here to help organize your day and walk through any questions without stress.`;\n      }\n\n      return res.json({\n        reply: fallbackReply,\n        source: 'local_companion_fallback',\n        detectedIntent: isDontUnderstand ? JSON.stringify({\n      school: schoolBrainContext.school || null,\n      location: schoolBrainContext.location || null,\n      curriculumTrack: schoolBrainContext.curriculumTrack || null,\n      dayRecord: schoolBrainContext.dayRecord || null,\n      activeMission: schoolBrainContext.activeMission || null,\n    }) : 'No verified School Brain context was supplied.';\n\n    const systemInstruction = `\nYou are the \"AI School Companion\" (الرفيق الدراسي الذكي), a personal AI learning assistant for a ${grade} student named \"${studentName}\".\nCRITICAL PRINCIPLES:\n1. 'Active' : 'Optional'}), clear simple English if English is selected.\n6. SCHOOL BRAIN IS AUTHORITATIVE:\n   - Treat the verified context below as the source of truth for the student's current school day, curriculum track, and active mission.\n   - Do not invent lessons, homework, concepts, assignments, scores, mastery, or school events that are not present in the verified context.\n   - If the context does not contain enough information to answer a school-specific question, say exactly what information is missing and ask for it or direct the student to record today's school information.\n   - Never silently substitute another lesson or another subject.\n   - When discussing learning, stay grounded in the active mission/day record when one exists.\n7. VERIFIED SCHOOL BRAIN CONTEXT:\n${contextJson}\n8. SPECIAL INTENT HANDLING:\n   - If the student says \"I don't understand\" / \"مش فاهم\": Reassure them warmly that learning takes time, normalize confusion, and invite them gently to say which part was confusing.\n   - If the student says \"explain differently\" / \"اشرح بطريقة تانية\": Offer a simple everyday analogy or relatable example suited for an 11-year-old.\n   - If the student says \"test me\" / \"اختبرني\": Provide a single, friendly, low-stakes practice question to build confidence, and encourage them to take their time.\n   - Note: Do NOT trigger a rigid tutor escalation ladder yet; keep replies conversational, supportive, and grounded.\n`.trim();\n\n    // Prepare contents array for Gemini\n    let started = false;\n    const contents = (Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : [])\n      .filter((m: any) => m && typeof m.content === 'string' && m.content.trim())\n      .slice(-12)\n      .map((m: { role: string; content: string }) => ({\n        role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user',\n        parts: [{ text: m.content.slice(0, 2000) }],\n      }))\n      .filter((c: { role: string }) => {\n        if (!started && c.role === 'model') return false; // history must start with a user turn\n        started = true;\n        return true;\n      });\n    if (contents.length === 0) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No messages', degraded: true });\n    }\n\n    // Generate response using SDK default model\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents,\n      config: {\n        systemInstruction,\n        temperature: 0.7,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const reply = response.text || (isArabic ? 'أنا معاك، نقدر نكمل!' : \"I'm with you, let's continue!\");\n    res.json({\n      reply,\n      source: 'gemini',\n      detectedIntent: isDontUnderstand ? 'dont_understand' : isExplainDifferently ? 'explain_differently' : isTestMe ? 'test_me' : 'general',\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    handleAiError('chat', error);\n    const isArabic = req.body?.language !== 'en';\n    const errorFallback = isArabic\n      ? 'أنا هنا معاك. واجهت ثانية بطء في الاتصال، بس نقدر نواصل تنظيم يومنا بدون أي مشكلة.'\n      : \"I'm right here with you. Had a momentary connection blip, but we can keep planning your day without issue.\";\n    res.json({ reply: errorFallback, source: 'error_fallback' });\n  }\n});\n\n// STT (Speech-to-Text) API endpoint (Tier 2 fallback)\napp.post('/api/stt', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { audioBase64, mimeType = 'audio/webm', language = 'ar' } = req.body;\n\n    if (!audioBase64) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing audio data', transcript: '' });\n    }\n\n    if (!ai) {\n      return res.json({\n        transcript: '',\n        error: 'Gemini STT requires API key',\n        tier: 'fallback_unavailable',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const promptText = isArabic\n      ? 'استمع إلى التسجيل الصوتي المرفق وقم بتفريغه نصياً بدقة كما نطق الطالب باللغة العربية (اللهجة المصرية أو الفصحى). أرجع فقط النص الدقيق بدون أي مقدمات أو تحيات أو إضافات.'\n      : 'Listen to the audio recording and transcribe it accurately as spoken. Return only the exact transcription without any commentary.';\n\n    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n      model: process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      contents: [\n        {\n          role: 'user',\n          parts: [\n            {\n              inlineData: {\n                data: audioBase64,\n                mimeType,\n              },\n            },\n            {\n              text: promptText,\n            },\n          ],\n        },\n      ],\n      config: {\n        temperature: 0.1,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const transcript = (response.text || '').trim();\n    res.json({\n      transcript,\n      tier: 'gemini_stt',\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('STT API Error:', error);\n    res.json({\n      transcript: '',\n      error: error.message || 'STT failed',\n      tier: 'gemini_stt_error',\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// TTS in-memory cache\nconst ttsCache = new Map<string, string>();\n\n// TTS (Text-to-Speech) API endpoint powered by Gemini Flash Lite TTS\napp.post('/api/tts', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { text = '', language = 'ar' } = req.body;\n    if (!text || !text.trim()) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing text' });\n    }\n\n    const cleanText = text\n      .replace(/[*#_~`]/g, '')\n      .replace(/\\s+/g, ' ')\n      .trim()\n      .slice(0, 450); // Safe length for natural speech delivery\n\n    const langKey = language === 'fr' ? 'fr' : language === 'en' ? 'en' : 'ar';\n    const cacheKey = `${langKey}:${cleanText}`;\n\n    // 1. Serve from in-memory cache if previously generated\n    if (ttsCache.has(cacheKey)) {\n      return res.json({\n        success: true,\n        audioBase64: ttsCache.get(cacheKey),\n        mimeType: 'audio/wav',\n        fromCache: true,\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (!ai) {\n      return res.json({\n        success: false,\n        useBrowserSpeech: true,\n        text: cleanText,\n        language: langKey,\n      });\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const voiceName = langKey === 'ar' ? 'Puck' : langKey === 'fr' ? 'Kore' : 'Kore';\n      const response = await ai.models.generateContent({\n        model: 'gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts',\n        contents: [\n          {\n            role: 'user',\n            parts: [{ text: cleanText }],\n          },\n        ],\n        config: {\n          responseModalities: ['AUDIO'],\n          speechConfig: {\n            voiceConfig: {\n              prebuiltVoiceConfig: { voiceName },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      const base64Audio = response.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.inlineData?.data;\n      if (base64Audio) {\n        ttsCache.set(cacheKey, base64Audio);\n        return res.json({\n          success: true,\n          audioBase64: base64Audio,\n          mimeType: 'audio/wav',\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (genErr: any) {\n      console.warn('Gemini TTS generation issue:', genErr?.message || genErr);\n    }\n\n    // Graceful browser speech fallback if server TTS encountered an issue\n    res.json({\n      success: false,\n      useBrowserSpeech: true,\n      text: cleanText,\n      language: langKey,\n    });\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    res.json({\n      success: false,\n      useBrowserSpeech: true,\n      text: req.body?.text || '',\n      language: req.body?.language || 'ar',\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// Dynamic Lesson Explanation Generation (Miss Nour Deep Explanation)\napp.post('/api/tutor-explain', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const {\n      lessonTitle = 'الدرس',\n      subjectName = 'المادة',\n      lessonText = '',\n      studentName = 'أمينة',\n      language = 'ar',\n      mode = 'full_hook_story',\n    } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const isFrench = language === 'fr';\n\n    if (!ai || Date.now() < globalQuotaCooldownUntil) {\n      // Local pedagogic explanations fallback\n      const fallbackExplanations: Record<string, string> = {\n        full_hook_story: isArabic\n          ? `يا أهلاً يا ${studentName}! تعالي أحكي لك سر مشوق عن درس «${lessonTitle}» في ${subjectName}. تخيلي لو إنتي عالمة أو مستكشفة صغيرة بتواجه لغز كبير؛ الدرس ده بيعلمنا إزاي نفكر بذكاء ونحل أصعب التحديات خطوة بخطوة. يلا نفتح عيوننا وتركيزنا ونبدأ المغامرة سوا!`\n          : isFrench\n          ? This lesson will show us how to think critically and solve big puzzles step by step!`,\n        core_concepts: isArabic\n          ? `ركزي معايا يا ${studentName} في أهم ثلاث نقاط في درس «${lessonTitle}»: أولاً: الفكرة المركزية اللي بيبني عليها كتاب الوزارة. ثانياً: المصطلحات الجديدة اللي بنقابلها. ثالثاً: القاعدة الأساسية اللي بتخلينا نحل أي تمرين بكل سهولة.`\n          : isFrench\n          ? `Retiens bien ces points clés pour «${lessonTitle}», ${studentName}: D'abord, l'idée principale du manuel.
