Take a look and tell me what you see!`,\n        sourceRef: lesson.sourceRef,\n        modalityUsed: 'structured_visual',\n        visualData,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n\n      const updatedSession: TeachingSession = {\n        ...session,\n        lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        activeVisual: visualData,\n        modalityHistory: [...session.modalityHistory, 'structured_visual'],\n        turnHistory: [...updatedTurns, visualTurn],\n        currentStep: 'adjust',\n      };\n\n      return { session: updatedSession, newTutorTurn: visualTurn, shouldTriggerVisual: true };\n    }\n\n    // 3. Main Step Sequence Router\n    let nextStep: SessionStep = session.currentStep;\n    let replyText = '';\n    let modalityUsed: TeachingModality | undefined;\n    let visualData: StructuredVisualData | undefined;\n    let masteryUpdate: AdvanceSessionResult['masteryUpdate'] | undefined;\n    let isSessionCompleted = false;\n\n    switch (session.currentStep) {\n      case 'greet': {\n        // Step 1 -> Step 2: Warm-up\n        nextStep = 'warmup';\n        replyText = isFr\n          ? `Formidable ! Avant de commencer, échauffons nos méninges avec une petite question : Te rappelles-tu d'un moment où tu as aidé quelqu'un ou économisé une ressource précieuse ? (Juste un petit échauffement pour réveiller notre esprit !)`\n          : isAr\n          ? `ممتاز! قبل أن ندخل في الدرس، لنسخن أذهاننا بسؤال بسيط وخفيف: هل تذكر متى احتجت لترشيد شيء أو مساعدة شخص آخر في حياتك؟ (لا تقلق، هذا سؤال تنشيطي فقط لنبدأ به!)`\n          : `Awesome! Before we jump in, let's warm up with a simple thought: Do you remember a time you helped someone or saved something precious? (Just a quick warm-up to get our minds ready!)`;\n        break;\n      }\n\n      case 'warmup': {\n        // Step 2 -> Step 3: Teach Concept from Source\n        nextStep = 'teach';\n        modalityUsed = 'source_explanation';\n        replyText = isFr\n          ? `Très bien ! Ouvrons notre manuel (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}) pour notre première notion : «${currentConcept.titleEn}».\\n\\n📖 Texte du manuel :\\n\"${currentConcept.sourceText}\"\\n\\n📌 Points clés :\\n${currentConcept.keyPoints.map((p) => `• ${p}`).join('\\n')}\\n\\nPrends le temps d'assimiler ceci, et dis-moi quand tu es prêt !`\n          : isAr\n          ? `رائع جداً! الآن لنفتح كتابنا (${lesson.sourceRef.bookAr}) ونبدأ بالفكرة الأولى: «${currentConcept.titleAr}».\\n\\n📖 من نص الكتاب المدرسي:\\n\"${currentConcept.sourceText}\"\\n\\n📌 النقاط الجوهرية:\\n${currentConcept.keyPoints.map((p) => `• ${p}`).join('\\n')}\\n\\n(خذ نفساً هادئاً، وعندما تكون مستعداً اخبرني لننتقل للخطوة التالية!)`\n          : `Great! Now let’s open our textbook (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}) to our first concept: \"${currentConcept.titleEn}\".\\n\\n📖 From the textbook:\\n\"${currentConcept.sourceText}\"\\n\\n📌 Key Points:\\n${currentConcept.keyPoints.map((p) => `• ${p}`).join('\\n')}\\n\\nTake your time to absorb this! Tell me when you're ready to continue.`;\n        break;\n      }\n\n      case 'teach': {\n        // Step 3 -> Step 4: Ask Open-Ended Check\n        nextStep = 'ask';\n        replyText = isFr\n          ? `Maintenant cher ami, avec tes propres mots et sans mémorisation : qu'as-tu compris de «${currentConcept.titleEn}» ? (Explique-moi librement, je t'écoute !)`\n          : isAr\n          ? `الآن يا صديقي، بكلماتك البسيطة الخاصة وبدون حفظ حرفي: ما الذي فهمته من كلامنا عن «${currentConcept.titleAr}»؟ (احكِ لي بحرية، لا توجد إجابة خطأ هنا!)`\n          : `Now friend, in your own words without memorization: what did you understand about \"${currentConcept.titleEn}\"? (Tell me freely, I am listening!)`;\n        break;\n      }\n\n      case 'ask': {\n        // Evaluate student's understanding\n        const evalScore = this.evaluateStudentUnderstanding(studentInput, currentConcept);\n\n        if (evalScore >= 0.7) {\n          // Good grasp! Proceed to Step 7: Mandatory Explain-it-back\n          nextStep = 'explain_back';\n          replyText = isFr\n            ? `Excellente compréhension ! 👍\\n\\nEt maintenant, voici le vrai test du maître :\\n«À ton tour de m'enseigner ! Explique-moi la notion de '${currentConcept.titleEn}' comme si j'étais un nouvel élève qui ne sait absolument rien !»`\n            : isAr\n            ? `استيعاب رائع وتفكير سليم يا بطل! 👍\\n\\nوالآن جاء الاختبار الحقيقي للمعلم الماهر:\\n«دورك الآن لتعلمني! اشرح لي فكرة \"${currentConcept.titleAr}\" وكأني طالب جديد لا أعرف أي شيء عنها على الإطلاق!»`\n            : `Spot-on understanding! 👍\\n\\nNow comes the true test of a master:\\n\"Now you teach me! Explain '${currentConcept.titleEn}' as if I know absolutely nothing about it!\"`;\n        } else {\n          // Needs escalation: Step 5 Adjust via Escalation Ladder\n          nextStep = 'adjust';\n          const attempt = session.currentAttemptCount + 1;\n          const escalation = this.getEscalationResponse(attempt, currentConcept, lesson, effectiveLang);\n          modalityUsed = escalation.modality;\n          visualData = escalation.visualData;\n          replyText = escalation.text;\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n\n      case 'adjust': {\n        // Check student's response to the escalated explanation\n        const evalScore = this.evaluateStudentUnderstanding(studentInput, currentConcept);\n\n        if (evalScore >= 0.65) {\n          // Understood through the ladder! Advance to mandatory explain-it-back\n          nextStep = 'explain_back';\n          replyText = isFr\n            ? `Formidable ! Maintenant l'idée est limpide. 🎯\\n\\nÀ ton tour de m'enseigner ! Explique-moi «${currentConcept.titleEn}» avec tes propres mots comme si je n'avais pas lu le manuel !`\n            : isAr\n            ? `ممتاز جداً! الآن وصلت الفكرة بوضوح. 🎯\\n\\nوكما اتفقنا، لا يكتمل فهم درس إلا عندما تشرحه:\\n«دورك الآن لتعلمني! اشرح لي فكرة \"${currentConcept.titleAr}\" بطريقتك الخاصة وكأني صديقك الذي لم يقرأ الدرس بعد!»`\n            : `Terrific! Now the concept is crystal clear. 🎯\\n\\nNow you teach me! Explain \"${currentConcept.titleEn}\" in your own words as if I haven't read the textbook yet!`;\n        } else if (session.currentAttemptCount >= 5) {\n          // Reached Attempt 6: Flag for review gently\n          nextStep = 'celebrate';\n          modalityUsed = 'flag_for_review';\n          replyText = isFr\n            ? `Bravo pour tes efforts persévérants ! 🌟 Nous avons noté «${currentConcept.titleEn}» pour une révision calme demain sans surcharge. Ton confort passe avant tout !`\n            : isAr\n            ? `أحسنت المحاولة والجهد الكبير يا بطل! 🌟 وضعنا مفهوم «${currentConcept.titleAr}» في بطاقة (المراجعة اللاحقة) لنمر عليه غداً بروقان وبدون أي إجهاد. صحتك وراحتك هي الأهم دائماً!`\n            : `Wonderful effort and persistence! 🌟 We flagged \"${currentConcept.titleEn}\" for a calm review tomorrow so you never feel overloaded. Your comfort always comes first!`;\n        } else {\n          // Continue climbing the escalation ladder\n          const attempt = session.currentAttemptCount + 1;\n          const escalation = this.getEscalationResponse(attempt, currentConcept, lesson, effectiveLang);\n          modalityUsed = escalation.modality;\n          visualData = escalation.visualData;\n          replyText = escalation.text;\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n\n      case 'explain_back': {\n        // Explain-back is the recheck/evaluation gate. Length alone is never enough.\n        const explanation = studentInput.trim();\n        const analysis = this.evaluateExplainBack(explanation, currentConcept);\n\n        const evidence = {\n          text: explanation,\n          quality: analysis.quality,\n          conceptKeywordMatches: analysis.conceptKeywordMatches,\n          keyPointMatches: analysis.keyPointMatches,\n          confidence: analysis.confidence,\n          capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        } as TeachingSession['explainBackEvidence'];\n\n        if (analysis.quality === 'sound') {\n          nextStep = 'celebrate';\n          masteryUpdate = {\n            conceptId: currentConcept.id,\n            correctness: 'full',\n            independence: session.currentAttemptCount === 0 ? 'unassisted' : 'hinted',\n            modality: 'quiz',\n          };\n\n          replyText = isFr\n            ? `Excellente explication de «${currentConcept.titleEn}» ! 🌟 Tu as relié l'idée aux points essentiels du cours.`\n            : isAr\n            ? `شرح قوي ومبني على الفكرة الأساسية في «${currentConcept.titleAr}»! 🌟 دلوقتي عندنا دليل حقيقي على الفهم، مش مجرد إجابة صحيحة.`\n            : `Strong explanation of \"${currentConcept.titleEn}\"! 🌟 You connected the idea to the key points, so we have real evidence of understanding.`;\n\n          if (session.currentConceptIndex < lesson.concepts.length - 1) {\n            const nextConcept = lesson.concepts[session.currentConceptIndex + 1];\n            replyText += isFr\n              ? `\\n\\n✨ Passons maintenant à «${nextConcept.titleEn}» ?`\n              : isAr\n              ? `\\n\\n✨ والآن ننتقل للمفهوم التالي: «${nextConcept.titleAr}»؟`\n              : `\\n\\n✨ Shall we move to the next concept: \"${nextConcept.titleEn}\"?`;\n          } else {\n            isSessionCompleted = true;\n            nextStep = 'close';\n            replyText += isFr\n              ? `\\n\\n🎉 Félicitations ! Toutes les notions de «${lesson.titleEn}» sont maintenant vérifiées.`\n              : isAr\n              ? `\\n\\n🎉 ممتاز! تم التحقق من فهم جميع مفاهيم درس «${lesson.titleAr}».`\n              : `\\n\\n🎉 Excellent! All concepts in \"${lesson.titleEn}\" have now been verified.`;\n          }\n        } else {\n          // Weak/guessing explain-back: no mastery evidence. Return to targeted practice.\n          nextStep = 'adjust';\n          const attempt = session.currentAttemptCount + 1;\n          const escalation = this.getEscalationResponse(attempt, currentConcept, lesson, effectiveLang);\n          modalityUsed = escalation.modality;\n          visualData = escalation.visualData;\n          replyText = isFr\n            ? `Ton idée est encore partielle. Je ne vais pas compter cela comme une maîtrise tout de suite. Reprenons avec une autre façon d'expliquer, puis tu réessaieras.\\n\\n${escalation.text}`\n            : isAr\n            ? `لسه محتاجين دليل أوضح على الفهم، فمش هاعتبر المفهوم متقن دلوقتي. هنغيّر طريقة الشرح ونجرّب تاني.\\n\\n${escalation.text}`\n            : `We need stronger evidence of understanding, so I won't mark this mastered yet. Let's change the teaching strategy and try again.\\n\\n${escalation.text}`;\n        }\n\n        const evidenceTurn: TutorTurn = {\n          id: `turn_evidence_${Date.now()}`,\n          role: 'system',\n          step: nextStep,\n          text: '',\n          isExplainBack: true,\n          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        };\n\n        const updatedSessionWithEvidence: TeachingSession = {\n          ...session,\n          explainBackEvidence: evidence,\n          explainBackDone: analysis.quality === 'sound',\n          lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          turnHistory: [...updatedTurns, evidenceTurn],\n        };\n\n        // Continue through the common final session update below.\n        session = updatedSessionWithEvidence;\n        break;\n      }\n\n      case 'celebrate': {\n        if (session.currentConceptIndex < lesson.concepts.length - 1) {\n          // Advance to next concept\n          const nextConceptIdx = session.currentConceptIndex + 1;\n          const nextConcept = lesson.concepts[nextConceptIdx];\n          nextStep = 'teach';\n          modalityUsed = 'source_explanation';\n\n          replyText = isFr\n            ? `En route ! La notion suivante dans notre manuel (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}) est : «${nextConcept.titleEn}».\\n\\n📖 Texte :\\n\"${nextConcept.sourceText}\"\\n\\n📌 Points clés :\\n${nextConcept.keyPoints.map((p) => `• ${p}`).join('\\n')}\\n\\nQu'en penses-tu ?`\n            : isAr\n            ? `على بركة الله! المفهوم التالي في كتابنا (${lesson.sourceRef.bookAr}) هو: «${nextConcept.titleAr}».\\n\\n📖 من نص الدرس:\\n\"${nextConcept.sourceText}\"\\n\\n📌 النقاط الرئيسية:\\n${nextConcept.keyPoints.map((p) => `• ${p}`).join('\\n')}\\n\\nما رأيك في هذه النقطة؟`\n            : `Let's proceed! The next concept in our textbook (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}) is: \"${nextConcept.titleEn}\".\\n\\n📖 Text:\\n\"${nextConcept.sourceText}\"\\n\\n📌 Key Points:\\n${nextConcept.keyPoints.map((p) => `• ${p}`).join('\\n')}\\n\\nWhat are your thoughts on this?`;\n\n          const tutorTurn: TutorTurn = {\n            id: `turn_tut_${Date.now()}`,\n            role: 'tutor',\n            step: nextStep,\n            text: replyText,\n            sourceRef: lesson.sourceRef,\n            modalityUsed,\n            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n          };\n\n          const updatedSession: TeachingSession = {\n            ...session,\n            currentConceptIndex: nextConceptIdx,\n            currentStep: nextStep,\n            currentAttemptCount: 0,\n            explainBackDone: false,\n            lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            turnHistory: [...updatedTurns, tutorTurn],\n          };\n\n          return { session: updatedSession, newTutorTurn: tutorTurn };\n        } else {\n          nextStep = 'close';\n          isSessionCompleted = true;\n          replyText = isFr\n            ? `La séance d'aujourd'hui est terminée avec brio et sérénité. Je suis fier de ta concentration ! Veux-tu faire une petite pause maintenant ?`\n            : isAr\n            ? `لقد انتهت جلسة اليوم بنجاح هادئ ومثمر. أنا فخور بك وبتركيزك! هل ترغب في أخذ استراحة الآن؟`\n            : `Today's session is successfully complete. I am so proud of your focus! Ready for a restful break?`;\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n\n      case 'close': {\n        replyText = isFr\n          ? `La séance est terminée et enregistrée. À demain pour une nouvelle aventure d'apprentissage !`\n          : isAr\n          ? `الجلسة مكتملة ومحفوظة. نلتقي غداً في درس جديد ومغامرة تعليمية ممتعة!`\n          : `Session is complete and saved. See you tomorrow for our next learning journey!`;\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const tutorTurn: TutorTurn = {\n      id: `turn_tut_${Date.now()}`,\n      role: 'tutor',\n      step: nextStep,\n      text: replyText,\n      sourceRef: lesson.sourceRef,\n      modalityUsed,\n      visualData,\n      isExplainBack: nextStep === 'explain_back',\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    const updatedSession: TeachingSession = {\n      ...session,\n      currentStep: nextStep,\n      currentAttemptCount: nextStep === 'adjust' ? session.currentAttemptCount + 1 : session.currentAttemptCount,\n      explainBackDone: nextStep === 'celebrate' || session.explainBackDone,\n      modalityHistory: modalityUsed ? [...session.modalityHistory, modalityUsed] : session.modalityHistory,\n      turnHistory: [...updatedTurns, tutorTurn],\n      activeVisual: visualData || session.activeVisual,\n      lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      completedAt: isSessionCompleted ? new Date().toISOString() : session.completedAt,\n      status: isSessionCompleted ? 'completed' : 'in_progress',\n    };\n\n    return {\n      session: updatedSession,\n      newTutorTurn: tutorTurn,\n      masteryUpdate,\n      shouldTriggerVisual: Boolean(visualData),\n      isSessionCompleted,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private evaluateExplainBack(\n    input: string,\n    concept: CurriculumLessonConcept\n  ): {\n    quality: 'sound' | 'partial' | 'guessing' | 'unclear';\n    conceptKeywordMatches: number;\n    keyPointMatches: number;\n    confidence: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';\n  } {\n    const text = (input || '').trim();\n    if (!text) return { quality: 'unclear', conceptKeywordMatches: 0, keyPointMatches: 0, confidence: 'low' };\n\n    const student = tokens(text);\n    const conceptTerms = new Set([...tokens(concept.titleAr), ...tokens(concept.titleEn)]);\n    const keyPointTerms = new Set(concept.keyPoints.flatMap((p) => [...tokens(p)]));\n    const conceptKeywordMatches = [...conceptTerms].filter((t) => student.has(t)).length;\n    const keyPointMatches = [...keyPointTerms].filter((t) => student.has(t)).length;\n\n    // Guessing: whole-word phrases only. Hedging (\"maybe\") is NOT guessing.\n    const GUESS = ['تخمين', 'حظ', 'مش متأكد', 'مش متأكدة', 'مش عارف', 'مش عارفة',\n                   'guess', 'not sure', 'lucky', 'au hasard', 'pas sure', 'pas sûre'];\n    if (GUESS.some((p) => hasPhrase(text, p))) {\n      return { quality: 'guessing', conceptKeywordMatches, keyPointMatches, confidence: 'high' };\n    }\n\n    const CAUSAL = ['لأن', 'عشان', 'علشان', 'بسبب', 'يعني', 'كلما', 'لذلك',\n                    'because', 'since', 'therefore', 'means', 'parce que', 'donc', 'cela signifie'];\n    const causal = CAUSAL.some((p) => hasPhrase(text, p));\n\n    // Parroting: almost none of the child's words are her own (they all come from the source).\n    const sourceTokens = new Set([\n      ...conceptTerms, ...keyPointTerms, ...tokens(concept.sourceText || ''),\n    ]);\n    const own = [...student].filter((t) => !sourceTokens.has(t)).length;\n    // ponytail: 0.15 own-word ratio is a heuristic; upgrade: grade explain-back with the model + rubric\n    const parroting = student.size > 0 && own / student.size < 0.15;\n    if (parroting) {\n      return { quality: 'partial', conceptKeywordMatches, keyPointMatches, confidence: 'medium' };\n    }\n\n    const len = normalizeText(text).length;\n    if (len >= 25 && keyPointMatches >= 2 && (conceptKeywordMatches >= 1 || causal)) {\n      return { quality: 'sound', conceptKeywordMatches, keyPointMatches, confidence: 'high' };\n    }\n    if (len >= 10 && (keyPointMatches >= 1 || conceptKeywordMatches >= 1 || causal)) {\n      return { quality: 'partial', conceptKeywordMatches, keyPointMatches, confidence: 'medium' };\n    }\n    return { quality: 'unclear', conceptKeywordMatches, keyPointMatches, confidence: 'low' };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Escalation Ladder (Sub-Phase 9.3)\n   * Attempt 1: Normal explanation (from sourceRef)\n   * Attempt 2: Simpler example (child's daily life)\n   * Attempt 3: Story / analogy / metaphor\n   * Attempt 4: Visual (SVG diagram or labeled picture)\n   * Attempt 5: Break it into smaller pieces (teach prerequisite)\n   * Attempt 6: Flag for review gently; no pressure\n   */\n  private getEscalationResponse(\n    attempt: number,\n    concept: CurriculumLessonConcept,\n    lesson: OfficialCurriculumLesson,\n    effectiveLang: 'ar' | 'en' | 'fr'\n  ): { text: string; modality: TeachingModality; visualData?: StructuredVisualData } {\n    const isAr = effectiveLang === 'ar';\n    const isFr = effectiveLang === 'fr';\n\n    switch (attempt) {\n      case 1: {\n        return {\n          modality: 'source_explanation',\n          text: isFr\n            ? `Pas de souci ! Regardons cela directement à partir du texte de ton manuel (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}) :\\n\"${concept.sourceText}\"\\n\\nEn clair : ${concept.keyPoints[0]}. Est-ce plus compréhensible ainsi ?`\n            : isAr\n            ? `لا بأس يا بطل، دعنا ننظر إليها من زاوية أوضح من نص الكتاب المدرسي (${lesson.sourceRef.bookAr}):\\n\"${concept.sourceText}\"\\n\\nالمقصود هنا ببساطة: ${concept.keyPoints[0]}. هل يبدو هذا أوضح؟`\n            : `No problem at all! Let's examine it straight from the textbook text (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}):\\n\"${concept.sourceText}\"\\n\\nSimply put: ${concept.keyPoints[0]}. Does that make more sense?`,\n        };\n      }\n\n      case 2: {\n        return {\n          modality: 'daily_life_example',\n          text: isFr\n            ? `Prenons un exemple de la vie quotidienne :\\n${concept.dailyLifeExampleEn}\\n\\nTu vois ? C'est exactement ce que signifie «${concept.titleEn}». Qu'en penses-tu ?`\n            : isAr\n            ? `دعنا نأخذ مثالاً من حياتك اليومية:\\n${concept.dailyLifeExampleAr}\\n\\nأرأيت؟ هذا بالضبط ما يقصده درس «${concept.titleAr}». ما رأيك في هذا المثال؟`\n            : `Let's connect this to real daily life:\\n${concept.dailyLifeExampleEn}\\n\\nSee? That is exactly what \"${concept.titleEn}\" is talking about. How does that sound?`,\n        };\n      }\n\n      case 3: {\n        return {\n          modality: 'story_analogy',\n          text: isFr\n            ? `Imagine cette petite histoire et cette comparaison :\\n${concept.storyAnalogyEn}\\n\\nArrives-tu à visualiser la scène ? C'est ainsi que cela fonctionne en réalité !`\n            : isAr\n            ? `تخيل معي هذه القصة الصغيرة والتشبيه الممتع:\\n${concept.storyAnalogyAr}\\n\\nهل تخيلت الموقف؟ هكذا تماماً تعمل هذه الفكرة في الواقع!`\n            : `Picture this vivid little story and analogy:\\n${concept.storyAnalogyEn}\\n\\nCan you picture that scene? That is precisely how this idea works!`,\n        };\n      }\n\n      case 4: {\n        const visualData = this.buildStructuredVisual(concept, lesson);\n        return {\n          modality: 'structured_visual',\n          visualData,\n          text: isFr\n            ? `Une image vaut mille mots ! J'ai tracé ce schéma visuel tiré de ton manuel (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}) :\\n«${visualData.titleEn}».\\n\\nObserve le schéma : que remarques-tu ?`\n            : isAr\n            ? `الصورة بألف كلمة! رسمت لك هذا المخطط البصري من كتابك المدرسي (${lesson.sourceRef.bookAr}):\\n«${visualData.titleAr}».\\n\\nتأمل الرسم المعروض أمامك وقل لي ماذا ترى؟`\n            : `A picture is worth a thousand words! I rendered this structured diagram from your textbook (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}):\\n\"${visualData.titleEn}\".\\n\\nLook at the diagram and tell me what stands out to you?`,\n        };\n      }\n\n      case 5: {\n        return {\n          modality: 'break_prerequisite',\n          text: isFr\n            ? `Décomposons cela en une étape préparatoire plus simple :\\n${concept.prerequisiteEn}\\n\\nUne fois ce socle bien compris, la suite devient facile. Est-ce clair pour toi ?`\n            : isAr\n            ? `تعال نبسط المسألة أكثر ونفهم الخطوة التمهيدية الأولى:\\n${concept.prerequisiteAr}\\n\\nإذا ضبطنا هذه النقطة البسيطة، ستجد كل ما يليها سهلاً للغاية. هل هذه النقطة الأساسية واضحة لديك؟`\n            : `Let's break this down into a simpler prerequisite building block:\\n${concept.prerequisiteEn}\\n\\nOnce we anchor this foundational piece, the rest clicks easily. Does this make sense to you?`,\n        };\n      }\n\n      case 6:\n      default: {\n        return {\n          modality: 'flag_for_review',\n          text: isFr\n            ? `Tu es remarquable et tu as donné le meilleur de toi-même ! 🌟 Nous programmons «${concept.titleEn}» pour une révision calme demain, en toute sérénité. Ton bien-être passe toujours en premier !`\n            : isAr\n            ? `أنت رائع وبذلت وسعك اليوم! 🌟 سنضع مفهوم «${concept.titleAr}» في المراجعة الهادئة غداً لنعود إليها براحة ودون أي ضغط. راحتك وصحتك أهم من أي شيء!`\n            : `You did great and gave it your honest effort! 🌟 We will flag \"${concept.titleEn}\" for a calm spaced review tomorrow so you can rest. Your well-being comes first!`,\n        };\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Simple semantic check for open-ended answers\n   */\n  private evaluateStudentUnderstanding(input: string, concept: CurriculumLessonConcept): number {\n    const text = input.trim().toLowerCase();\n    if (!text || text.length < 4) return 0.2;\n\n    const keywords = [\n      ...concept.titleAr.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/),\n      ...concept.keyPoints.flatMap((k) => k.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/)),\n    ].filter((w) => w.length > 2);\n\n    const matches = keywords.filter((k) => text.includes(k));\n    const score = Math.min(1.0, 0.4 + (matches.length / Math.max(3, keywords.length)) * 0.8);\n    return score;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Helper to detect off-book questions (Sub-Phase 9.3 rule)\n   */\n  private checkIsOffBook(\n    input: string,\n    lesson: OfficialCurriculumLesson,\n    concept: CurriculumLessonConcept\n  ): boolean {\n    const text = input.toLowerCase().trim();\n    if (!text.includes('?') && !text.includes('هل') && !text.includes('لماذا') && !text.includes('ليه') && !text.includes('why') && !text.includes('pourquoi')) {\n      return false;\n    }\n\n    const offKeywords = [\n      'فضاء', 'ديناصور', 'كوكب المريخ', 'كرة القدم', 'رونالدو', 'ميسي', 'بلايستيشن',\n      'space', 'mars', 'dinosaurs', 'football', 'messi', 'ronaldo', 'video game',\n      'minecraft', 'roblox', 'الطقس في اليابان', 'سعر الدولار', 'espace', 'dinosaures'\n    ];\n\n    return offKeywords.some((k) => text.includes(k));\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Determine effective turn language based on lesson default and child's dominant input\n   */\n  public resolveLanguage(\n    explicitLang?: 'ar' | 'en' | 'fr',\n    lessonLang?: 'ar' | 'en' | 'fr',\n    studentInput?: string\n  ): 'ar' | 'en' | 'fr' {\n    if (studentInput && studentInput.trim().length > 3) {\n      const text = studentInput.trim().toLowerCase();\n      // Check Arabic characters\n      const arabicMatches = (text.match(/[\\u0600-\\u06FF]/g) || []).length;\n      // Check French specific characters or common words\n      const frenchMatches = (text.match(/[éèêëàâôûùçîï]|(bonjour|oui|non|merci|j'ai|c'est|leçon|livre|pourquoi)/g) || []).length;\n      const totalChars = text.length;\n\n      if (arabicMatches > totalChars * 0.3) {\n        return 'ar';\n      }\n      if (frenchMatches > 0 || (lessonLang === 'fr' && !text.match(/[\\u0600-\\u06FF]/))) {\n        return 'fr';\n      }\n      if (lessonLang === 'en' || explicitLang === 'en') {\n        return 'en';\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (lessonLang) return lessonLang;\n    if (explicitLang) return explicitLang;\n    return 'ar';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Construct structured visual data matching the concept\n   */\n  public buildStructuredVisual(\n    concept: CurriculumLessonConcept,\n    lesson: OfficialCurriculumLesson\n  ): StructuredVisualData {\n    return {\n      type: concept.visualType || 'diagram',\n      titleAr: concept.titleAr,\n      titleEn: concept.titleEn,\n      captionAr: `مصدر الشكل: ${lesson.sourceRef.bookAr}`,\n      captionEn: `Source: ${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}`,\n      sourceRef: lesson.sourceRef,\n      elements: {\n        conceptId: concept.id,\n        lessonTitle: lesson.titleAr,\n        keyPoints: concept.keyPoints,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n}\n\nexport const teachingSessionEngine = new TeachingSessionEngine();\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport {\n  TeachingSession,\n  SessionStep,\n  TeachingModality,\n  TutorTurn,\n  OfficialCurriculumLesson,\n  CurriculumLessonConcept,\n  StructuredVisualData,\n} from '../../types/teachingSession';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../curriculum/curriculumService';\n\nconst DIACRITICS = /[\\u064B-\\u065F\\u0670\\u0640]/g;\n\nexport function normalizeText(s: string): string {\n  return (s || '')\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(DIACRITICS, '')\n    .replace(/[\\u0622\\u0623\\u0625]/g, '\\u0627') // آأإ -> ا\n    .replace(/\\u0649/g, '\\u064A')               // ى -> ي\n    .replace(/\\u0629/g, '\\u0647')               // ة -> ه\n    .replace(/[^\\p{L}\\p{N}\\s]/gu, ' ')\n    .replace(/\\s+/g, ' ')\n    .trim();\n}\n\nconst STOP = new Set(\n  ['التي', 'الذي', 'هذا', 'هذه', 'ذلك', 'على', 'الى', 'عن',\n   'the', 'and', 'that', 'this', 'with', 'for', 'are', 'was', 'from',\n   'les', 'des', 'une', 'est', 'que', 'qui', 'dans', 'pour', 'par', 'sur', 'avec', 'pas'\n  ].map((w) => normalizeText(w))\n);\n\nconst stem = (w: string) => w.replace(/^ال/, '');\n\nfunction tokens(s: string): Set<string> {\n  return new Set(\n    normalizeText(s).split(' ').filter((w) => w.length > 2 && !STOP.has(w)).map(stem)\n  );\n}\n\nfunction hasPhrase(haystack: string, phrase: string): boolean {\n  return ` ${normalizeText(haystack)} `.includes(` ${normalizeText(phrase)} `);\n}\n\nexport interface AdvanceSessionInput {\n  session: TeachingSession;\n  studentInput?: string;\n  isAudio?: boolean;\n  language?: 'ar' | 'en' | 'fr';\n  forceVisual?: boolean;\n}\n\nexport interface AdvanceSessionResult {\n  session: TeachingSession;\n  newTutorTurn: TutorTurn;\n  masteryUpdate?: {\n    conceptId: string;\n    correctness: 'full' | 'partial' | 'wrong';\n    independence: 'unassisted' | 'hinted' | 'revealed';\n    modality: 'reel_check' | 'quiz';\n  };\n  shouldTriggerVisual?: boolean;\n  isSessionCompleted?: boolean;\n}\n\n/**\n * Pure TypeScript, decoupled Teaching Session State Machine & Tutor Engine.\n * Enforces the strict 9-step Teaching Loop, 6-attempt Escalation Ladder,\n * mandatory Explain-it-back verification, and Source-Grounding rules.\n */\nexport class TeachingSessionEngine {\n  /**\n   * Initialize a brand new session or resume an existing one\n   */\n  public initializeSession(params: {\n    studentId: string;\n    lessonId: string;\n    existingSession?: TeachingSession | null;\n    language?: 'ar' | 'en' | 'fr';\n  }): { session: TeachingSession; greetingTurn: TutorTurn } {\n    const { studentId, lessonId, existingSession, language } = params;\n\n    const lesson = curriculumService.getLessonById(lessonId);\n    if (!lesson) {\n      throw new Error(`Lesson ${lessonId} not found in official curriculum.`);\n    }\n\n    const effectiveLang = this.resolveLanguage(language, lesson.language);\n    const isAr = effectiveLang === 'ar';\n    const isFr = effectiveLang === 'fr';\n\n    // Check if resuming an unfinished session\n    if (existingSession && existingSession.status === 'in_progress') {\n      const currentConcept = lesson.concepts[existingSession.currentConceptIndex] || lesson.concepts[0];\n      const resumeGreeting = isFr\n        ? `Rebonjour cher ami ! La dernière fois, nous explorions «${currentConcept.titleEn}» de la leçon «${lesson.titleEn}» (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}). Es-tu prêt à continuer ?`\n        : isAr\n        ? `أهلاً بك مجدداً يا بطل! في المرة السابقة كنا ندرس معاً «${currentConcept.titleAr}» من درس «${lesson.titleAr}» (${lesson.sourceRef.bookAr}). هل تحب أن نكمل من حيث توقفنا؟`\n        : `Welcome back, friend! Last time we were exploring \"${currentConcept.titleEn}\" from \"${lesson.titleEn}\" (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}). Ready to pick up right where we left off?`;\n\n      const greetingTurn: TutorTurn = {\n        id: `turn_greet_${Date.now()}`,\n        role: 'tutor',\n        step: 'greet',\n        text: resumeGreeting,\n        sourceRef: lesson.sourceRef,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n\n      const resumedSession: TeachingSession = {\n        ...existingSession,\n        lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        turnHistory: [...existingSession.turnHistory, greetingTurn],\n      };\n\n      return { session: resumedSession, greetingTurn };\n    }\n\n    // Create a brand new session\n    const sessionId = `teach_sess_${lessonId}_${Date.now()}`;\n\n    const greetingText = isFr\n      ? `Bonjour cher ami ! Je suis ton tuteur et compagnon d'apprentissage. Aujourd'hui, nous allons étudier ensemble une belle leçon de ton manuel : «${lesson.titleEn}» (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}). Prêt à commencer ?`\n      : isAr\n      ? `أهلاً بك يا بطل! أنا رفيقك التعليمي ومعلمك الخصوصي. اليوم سنجلس معاً لنتعلم بهدوء درساً ممتعاً من كتابك المدرسي: «${lesson.titleAr}» (${lesson.sourceRef.bookAr}). جاهز لنبدأ؟`\n      : `Hello there! I am your personal study companion and tutor. Today we will sit down together to explore a great lesson from your textbook: \"${lesson.titleEn}\" (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}). Ready to begin?`;\n\n    const greetingTurn: TutorTurn = {\n      id: `turn_greet_${Date.now()}`,\n      role: 'tutor',\n      step: 'greet',\n      text: greetingText,\n      sourceRef: lesson.sourceRef,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    const newSession: TeachingSession = {\n      sessionId,\n      studentId,\n      lessonId,\n      subjectId: lesson.subjectId,\n      startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      currentConceptIndex: 0,\n      totalConcepts: lesson.concepts.length,\n      currentStep: 'greet',\n      currentAttemptCount: 0,\n      modalityHistory: [],\n      turnHistory: [greetingTurn],\n      explainBackDone: false,\n      offBookQuestions: [],\n      status: 'in_progress',\n    };\n\n    return { session: newSession, greetingTurn };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Advance the teaching loop based on student response\n   */\n  public advanceSession(input: AdvanceSessionInput): AdvanceSessionResult {\n    let { session } = input;\n    const { studentInput = '', isAudio = false, language, forceVisual = false } = input;\n\n    const lesson = curriculumService.getLessonById(session.lessonId);\n    if (!lesson) {\n      throw new Error(`Lesson ${session.lessonId} not found.`);\n    }\n\n    const effectiveLang = this.resolveLanguage(language, lesson.language, studentInput);\n    const isAr = effectiveLang === 'ar';\n    const isFr = effectiveLang === 'fr';\n\n    const currentConcept: CurriculumLessonConcept | undefined =\n      lesson.concepts[session.currentConceptIndex] || lesson.concepts[0];\n\n    // Record student turn if text provided\n    const updatedTurns = [...session.turnHistory];\n    if (studentInput.trim()) {\n      updatedTurns.push({\n        id: `turn_stu_${Date.now()}`,\n        role: 'student',\n        step: session.currentStep,\n        text: studentInput.trim(),\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 1. Check for off-book questions (Sub-Phase 9.3 rule)\n    const isOffBook = this.checkIsOffBook(studentInput, lesson, currentConcept);\n    if (isOffBook && studentInput.trim().length > 5) {\n      const offBookReply = isFr\n        ? `C'est une excellente question très curieuse ! Cependant, elle n'est pas dans notre leçon d'aujourd'hui. Concentrons-nous sur ce que ton enseignant va évaluer dans (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}), et j'ai noté ta belle question pour en discuter plus tard !`\n        : isAr\n        ? `سؤال ذكي وفضولي جداً! لكنه خارج كتابنا لدرس اليوم. دعني أركز معك على ما يختبرك فيه المعلم من (${lesson.sourceRef.bookAr})، وسجلت سؤالك الجميل هذا لنتحدث عنه لاحقاً مع والديك!`\n        : `That’s a brilliant curious question! It’s not in our textbook lesson today though. Let’s focus on what your teacher will test you on from (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}), and I saved your great question for later!`;\n\n      const tutorTurn: TutorTurn = {\n        id: `turn_tut_${Date.now()}`,\n        role: 'tutor',\n        step: session.currentStep,\n        text: offBookReply,\n        sourceRef: lesson.sourceRef,\n        offBookDetected: true,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n\n      const updatedSession: TeachingSession = {\n        ...session,\n        lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        turnHistory: [...updatedTurns, tutorTurn],\n        offBookQuestions: [\n          ...session.offBookQuestions,\n          {\n            question: studentInput.trim(),\n            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n            parentNote: isFr\n              ? `L'élève a posé une question exploratoire hors programme : \"${studentInput.trim()}\".`\n              : isAr\n              ? `سأل الطالب سؤالاً استكشافياً خارج المقرر: \"${studentInput.trim()}\".`\n              : `Student asked an exploratory off-book question: \"${studentInput.trim()}\".`,\n          },\n        ],\n      };\n\n      return { session: updatedSession, newTutorTurn: tutorTurn };\n    }\n\n    // 2. Handle on-demand visual request\n    if (forceVisual) {\n      const visualData = this.buildStructuredVisual(currentConcept, lesson);\n      const visualTurn: TutorTurn = {\n        id: `turn_tut_vis_${Date.now()}`,\n        role: 'tutor',\n        step: 'visual',\n        text: isFr\n          ? `Voici un schéma visuel tiré de ton livre (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}) pour rendre l'idée parfaitement claire. Regarde et dis-moi ce que tu remarques !`\n          : isAr\n          ? `تفضل يا بطل! أعددت لك هذا الرسم التوضيحي من كتابك المدرسي (${lesson.sourceRef.bookAr}) ليسهل عليك استيعاب الفكرة تماماً. ألقِ نظرة عليه وقل لي ما الذي لاحظته؟`\n          : `Here you go! I prepared this structured visual straight from your textbook (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}) to make the idea crystal clear. Take a look and tell me what you see!`,\n        sourceRef: lesson.sourceRef,\n        modalityUsed: 'structured_visual',\n        visualData,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n\n      const updatedSession: TeachingSession = {\n        ...session,\n        lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        activeVisual: visualData,\n        modalityHistory: [...session.modalityHistory, 'structured_visual'],\n        turnHistory: [...updatedTurns, visualTurn],\n        currentStep: 'adjust',\n      };\n\n      return { session: updatedSession, newTutorTurn: visualTurn, shouldTriggerVisual: true };\n    }\n\n    // 3. Main Step Sequence Router\n    let nextStep: SessionStep = session.currentStep;\n    let replyText = '';\n    let modalityUsed: TeachingModality | undefined;\n    let visualData: StructuredVisualData | undefined;\n    let masteryUpdate: AdvanceSessionResult['masteryUpdate'] | undefined;\n    let isSessionCompleted = false;\n\n    switch (session.currentStep) {\n      case 'greet': {\n        // Step 1 -> Step 2: Warm-up\n        nextStep = 'warmup';\n        replyText = isFr\n          ? `Formidable ! Avant de commencer, échauffons nos méninges avec une petite question : Te rappelles-tu d'un moment où tu as aidé quelqu'un ou économisé une ressource précieuse ? (Juste un petit échauffement pour réveiller notre esprit !)`\n          : isAr\n          ? `ممتاز! قبل أن ندخل في الدرس، لنسخن أذهاننا بسؤال بسيط وخفيف: هل تذكر متى احتجت لترشيد شيء أو مساعدة شخص آخر في حياتك؟ (لا تقلق، هذا سؤال تنشيطي فقط لنبدأ به!)`\n          : `Awesome! Before we jump in, let's warm up with a simple thought: Do you remember a time you helped someone or saved something precious? (Just a quick warm-up to get our minds ready!)`;\n        break;\n      }\n\n      case 'warmup': {\n        // Step 2 -> Step 3: Teach Concept from Source\n        nextStep = 'teach';\n        modalityUsed = 'source_explanation';\n        replyText = isFr\n          ? `Très bien ! Ouvrons notre manuel (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}) pour notre première notion : «${currentConcept.titleEn}».\\n\\n📖 Texte du manuel :\\n\"${currentConcept.sourceText}\"\\n\\n📌 Points clés :\\n${currentConcept.keyPoints.map((p) => `• ${p}`).join('\\n')}\\n\\nPrends le temps d'assimiler ceci, et dis-moi quand tu es prêt !`\n          : isAr\n          ? `رائع جداً! الآن لنفتح كتابنا (${lesson.sourceRef.bookAr}) ونبدأ بالفكرة الأولى: «${currentConcept.titleAr}».\\n\\n📖 من نص الكتاب المدرسي:\\n\"${currentConcept.sourceText}\"\\n\\n📌 النقاط الجوهرية:\\n${currentConcept.keyPoints.map((p) => `• ${p}`).join('\\n')}\\n\\n(خذ نفساً هادئاً، وعندما تكون مستعداً اخبرني لننتقل للخطوة التالية!)`\n          : `Great! Now let’s open our textbook (${lesson.sourceRef.bookEn}) to our first concept: \"${currentConcept.titleEn}\".\\n\\n📖 From the textbook:\\n\"${currentConcept.sourceText}\"\\n\\n📌 Key Points:\\n${currentConcept.keyPoints.map((p) => `• ${p}`).join('\\n')}\\n\\nTake your time to absorb this! Tell me when you're ready to continue.`;\n        break;\n      }\n\n      case 'teach': {\n        // Step 3 -> Step 4: Ask Open-Ended Check\n        nextStep = 'ask';\n        replyText = isFr\n          ? `Maintenant cher ami, avec tes propres mots et sans mémorisation : qu'as-tu compris de «${currentConcept.titleEn}» ? (Explique-moi librement, je t'écoute !)`\n          : isAr\n          ? `الآن يا صديقي، بكلماتك البسيطة الخاصة وبدون حفظ حرفي: ما الذي فهمته من كلامنا عن «${currentConcept.titleAr}»؟ (احكِ لي بحرية، لا توجد إجابة خطأ هنا!)`\n          : `Now friend, in your own words without memorization: what did you understand about \"${currentConcept.titleEn}\"? (Tell me freely, I am listening!)`;\n        break;\n      }\n\n      case 'ask': {\n        // Evaluate student's understanding\n        const evalScore = this.evaluateStudentUnderstanding(studentInput, currentConcept);\n\n        if (evalScore >= 0.7) {\n          // Good grasp! Proceed to Step 7: Mandatory Explain-it-back\n          nextStep = 'explain_back';\n          replyText = isFr\n            ? `Excellente compréhension ! 👍\\n\\nEt maintenant, voici le vrai test du maître :\\n«À ton tour de m'enseigner ! Explique-moi la notion de '${currentConcept.titleEn}' comme si j'étais un nouvel élève qui ne sait absolument rien !»`\n            : isAr\n            ? `استيعاب رائع وتفكير سليم يا بطل! 👍\\n\\nوالآن جاء الاختبار الحقيقي للمعلم الماهر:\\n«دورك الآن لتعلمني! اشرح لي فكرة \"${currentConcept.titleAr}\" وكأني طالب جديد لا أعرف أي شيء عنها على الإطلاق!»`\n            : `Spot-on understanding! 👍\\n\\nNow comes the true test of a master:\\n\"Now you teach me! Explain '${currentConcept.titleEn}' as if I know absolutely nothing about it!\"`;\n        } else {\n          // Needs escalation: Step 5 Adjust via Escalation Ladder\n          nextStep = 'adjust';\n          const attempt = session.currentAttemptCount + 1;\n          const escalation = this.getEscalationResponse(attempt, currentConcept, lesson, effectiveLang);\n          modalityUsed = escalation.modality;\n          visualData = escalation.visualData;\n          replyText = escalation.text;\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n\n      case 'adjust': {\n        // Check student's response to the escalated explanation\n        const evalScore = this.evaluateStudentUnderstanding(studentInput, currentConcept);\n\n        if (evalScore >= 0.65) {\n          // Understood through the ladder! Advance to mandatory explain-it-back\n          nextStep = 'explain_back';\n          replyText = isFr\n            ? `Formidable ! Maintenant l'idée est limpide. 🎯\\n\\nÀ ton tour de m'enseigner ! Explique-moi «${currentConcept.titleEn}» avec tes propres mots comme si je n'avais pas lu le manuel !`\n            : isAr\n            ? `ممتاز جداً! الآن وصلت الفكرة بوضوح. 🎯\\n\\nوكما اتفقنا، لا يكتمل فهم درس إلا عندما تشرحه:\\n«دورك الآن لتعلمني! اشرح لي فكرة \"${currentConcept.titleAr}\" بطريقتك الخاصة وكأني صديقك الذي لم يقرأ الدرس بعد!»`\n            : `Terrific! Now the concept is crystal clear. 🎯\\n\\nNow you teach me! Explain \"${currentConcept.titleEn}\" in your own words as if I haven't read the textbook yet!`;\n        } else if (session.currentAttemptCount >= 5) {\n          // Reached Attempt 6: Flag for review gently\n          nextStep = 'celebrate';\n          modalityUsed = 'flag_for_review';\n          replyText = isFr\n            ? `Bravo pour tes efforts persévérants ! 🌟 Nous avons noté «${currentConcept.titleEn}» pour une révision calme demain sans surcharge. Ton confort passe avant tout !`\n            : isAr\n            ? `أحسنت المحاولة والجهد الكبير يا بطل! 🌟 وضعنا مفهوم «${currentConcept.titleAr}» في بطاقة (المراجعة اللاحقة) لنمر عليه غداً بروقان وبدون أي إجهاد. صحتك وراحتك هي الأهم دائماً!`\n            : `Wonderful effort and persistence! 🌟 We flagged \"${currentConcept.titleEn}\" for a calm review tomorrow so you never feel overloaded. - advance(practice text) -> explain_back (this is the 'ask' step response)
- advance(final) -> evaluate explain_back

mastery');\n}\n\n// Verify source-grounded sound explain-back is the mastery gate.\n{\n  const initialized = engine.initializeSession({\n    studentId: 'student_test_sound',\n    lessonId,\n    language: 'ar',\n  });\n\n  let session = initialized.session;\n  session = advance(session, 'جاهزة').session;\n  session = advance(session, 'جاهزة').session;\n  session = advance(session, `${sourceConcept.titleAr}: ${sourceKeyPoint}`).session;\n  assert(session.currentStep === 'ask', 'sound-path setup should reach understanding check');\n\n  const practice = advance(\n    session,\n    'القيمة المكانية بعد الفاصلة: الأول أجزاء من عشرة والثاني من مئة والثالث من ألف، وكل رتبة إلى اليمين أصغر بعشر مرات. Chaque rang vers la droite est 10 fois plus petit.'\n  );\n  assert(practice.session.currentStep === 'explain_back', 'successful understanding check should require explain-back');\n  assert(!practice.masteryUpdate, 'practice success must not award mastery before explain-back');\n\n  const paraphrase =\n    \"Plus on va vers la droite apres la virgule, plus le chiffre vaut dix fois moins, parce que un dixieme c'est dix centiemes.\";\n  const final = advance(practice.session, paraphrase);\n  assert(final.session.explainBackEvidence?.quality === 'sound', `sound explain-back must be captured: ${JSON.stringify(final.session.explainBackEvidence)}`);\n  assert(final.masteryUpdate?.correctness === 'full', 'sound explain-back is the mastery gate');\n  assert(final.masteryUpdate?.independence === 'unassisted', 'first successful explain-back remains unassisted');\n}\n\n// Verify pasting the source key point verbatim is not accepted as understanding.\n{\n  const initialized = engine.initializeSession({\n    studentId: 'student_test_paste',\n    lessonId,\n    language: 'ar',\n  });\n\n  let session = initialized.session;\n  session = advance(session, 'جاهزة').session;\n  session = advance(session, 'جاهزة').session;\n  session = advance(session, `${sourceConcept.titleAr}: ${sourceKeyPoint}`).session;\n  assert(session.currentStep === 'ask', 'paste-path setup should reach understanding check');\n\n  const practice = advance(\n    session,\n    'القيمة المكانية بعد الفاصلة: الأول أجزاء من عشرة والثاني من مئة والثالث من ألف، وكل رتبة إلى اليمين أصغر بعشر مرات. Chaque rang vers la droite est 10 fois plus petit.'\n  );\n  assert(practice.session.currentStep === 'explain_back', 'paste-path practice should reach explain-back');\n\n  const pasted = advance(\n    practice.session,\n    `${sourceConcept.titleAr}: ${sourceKeyPoint}. ${sourceConcept.titleEn}: ${sourceKeyPoint}.`\n  );\n  assert(\n    pasted.session.explainBackEvidence?.quality === 'partial',\n    `pasting the source must not be sound: ${JSON.stringify(pasted.session.explainBackEvidence)}`\n  );\n  assert(!pasted.masteryUpdate, 'pasting the source must never award mastery');\n}\n\n// Verify \"لاحظت\" is not read as guessing (\"حظ\" is only matched as a whole word).\n{\n  const initialized = engine.initializeSession({\n    studentId: 'student_test_notguessing',\n    lessonId,\n    language: 'ar',\n  });\n\n  let session = initialized.session;\n  session = advance(session, 'جاهزة').session;\n  session = advance(session, 'جاهزة').session;\n  session = advance(session, `${sourceConcept.titleAr}: ${sourceKeyPoint}`).session;\n\n  const practice = advance(\n    session,\n    'القيمة المكانية بعد الفاصلة: الأول أجزاء من عشرة والثاني من مئة والثالث من ألف، وكل رتبة إلى اليمين أصغر بعشر مرات. Chaque rang vers la droite est 10 fois plus petit.'\n  );\n  assert(practice.session.currentStep === 'explain_back', 'not-guessing setup should reach explain-back');\n\n  const result = advance(\n    practice.session,\n    'لاحظت أن كل رتبة بعد الفاصلة أصغر بعشر مرات لأن العدد يقسم على عشرة'\n  );\n  assert(\n    result.session.explainBackEvidence?.quality !== 'guessing',\n    `hedged explanation must not be read as guessing: ${JSON.stringify(result.session.explainBackEvidence)}`\n  );\n}\n\n// Verify no tutor turn leaks a literal backslash-n.\n{\n  const initialized = engine.initializeSession({\n    studentId: 'student_test_newlines',\n    lessonId,\n    language: 'ar',\n  });\n\n  let session = initialized.session;\n  session = advance(session, 'جاهزة').session;\n  session = advance(session, 'جاهزة').session;\n  session = advance(session, `${sourceConcept.titleAr}: ${sourceKeyPoint}`).session;\n  session = advance(session, 'تخمين وحظ، مش متأكدة ومش عارفة أشرح').session;\n\n  const leaked = session.turnHistory.filter((t: any) => typeof t.text === 'string' && t.text.includes('\\\\n'));\n  assert(leaked.length === 0, `literal \\\\n leaked in ${leaked.length} tutor turn(s)`);\n}\n\nconsole.log('TeachingSession explain-back evidence tests passed.');\n",

{ ...m, status: 'skipped' as const, skippedAt } : m\n    );\n    setMissionsForToday(updatedMissions);\n    await storageService.saveMission({ ...mission, status: 'skipped', skippedAt });\n\n    const outcome: MissionOutcome = {\n      id: `out_${mission.id}_${Date.now()}`,\n      missionId: mission.id,\n      studentId: mission.studentId,\n      completedAt: skippedAt,\n      status: 'skipped',\n    };\n    await storageService.saveMissionOutcome(outcome);\n\n    // Track mission rejection count (Failure mode 1c: \"Mission rejected 3 times -> Companion asks why once gently, planner adapts/drops, no nagging\")\n    const prevCount = missionRejectionCounts[missionId] || 0;\n    const newCount = prevCount + 1;\n    setMissionRejectionCounts((prev) => ({ ...prev, [missionId]: newCount }));\n\n    if (newCount >= 3) {\n      const isArabic = settings.language === 'ar';\n      const nudge = isArabic\n        ? `لاحظت أنك تخطيت مهمة «${mission.title}» ٣ مرات. هل تشعر أنها ثقيلة أو صعبة اليوم؟ أسقطناها من خطة اليوم لتستريح تماماً دون أي إلحاح.`\n        : `I noticed you skipped \"${mission.title}\" 3 times. X,\n  Bot,\n  Play,\n  Calendar,\n  CheckCircle2,\n  Heart,\n  MessageCircle,\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\nexport const HomeScreen: React.FC = () => {\n  const {\n    t,\n    language,\n    student,\n 'جميع كتب وزارة التربية والتعليم الرسمية والداعمة' : 'All official & supplementary curriculum books'}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            onClick={() => setActiveTab('learn')}\n            className=\"text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1\"\n          >\n            <span>{isArabic ? 'دروس' : 'les'}\n                  </span>\n                </div>\n                <h4 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 truncate pt-1\">\n                  {isArabic ? b.subjectNameAr : isFrench && b.subjectNameFr ? b.subjectNameFr : b.subjectNameEn}\n                </h4>\n                <p className=\"text-[9px] text-slate-400 truncate\">\n                  {isArabic ? b.bookTitleAr : b.bookTitleEn}\n                </p>\n              </div>\n\n              <div className=\"pt-2 mt-2 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-700/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400\">\n                <span>{isArabic ? 'افتحي الكتاب' : 'Open'}</span>\n                <span>←</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </section>\n\n      {/* 6.  "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport { Mission, plannerExplanation,\n    startMission,\n    closeMissionRunner,\n    regenerateMissionsForToday,\n    saveDayRecord,\n    setActiveTab,\n    currentDailyReview,\n    isDailyReviewOpen,\n    openDailyReview,\n    closeDailyReview,\n    dueReviewNudges,\n    gentleCompanionNudge,\n    dismissGentleNudge,\n    setCompanionContext,\n  } = useApp();\n\n  const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n  const isFrench = language === 'fr';\n\n  const [showReconstructionModal, setShowReconstructionModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showEditModal, setShowEditModal] = useState(false);\n  const const gradeLabel = student?.grade || (isArabic ? }

 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport { Mission, const isFrench = language === 'fr';\n\n  const [showReconstructionModal, setShowReconstructionModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showEditModal, setShowEditModal] = useState(false);\n  const const gradeLabel = student?.grade || (isArabic ? 'افتحي الكتاب' : 'Open'}</span>\n                <span>←</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </section>\n\n      {/* 6. (nextPendingMission.type === 'homework' ?  "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport { Mission, plannerExplanation,\n    startMission,\n    closeMissionRunner,\n    regenerateMissionsForToday,\n    saveDayRecord,\n    setActiveTab,\n    currentDailyReview,\n    isDailyReviewOpen,\n    openDailyReview,\n    closeDailyReview,\n    dueReviewNudges,\n    gentleCompanionNudge,\n    dismissGentleNudge,\n    setCompanionContext,\n  } = useApp();\n\n  const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n  const isFrench = language === 'fr';\n\n  const [showReconstructionModal, setShowReconstructionModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showEditModal, setShowEditModal] = useState(false);\n  const [selectedDuration, setSelectedDuration] = useState<number>(45);\n  const [isStageOpen, setIsStageOpen] = useState(false);\n  const defaultStageLessonId = curriculumService.getAvailableLessons()[0]?.id const gradeLabel = student?.grade || (isArabic ? const isFrench = language === 'fr';\n\n  const [showReconstructionModal, setShowReconstructionModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showEditModal, setShowEditModal] = useState(false);\n  const const gradeLabel = student?.grade || (isArabic ? '👩‍🏫 شرح درس' : isFrench ? '👩‍🏫 Explication de leçon' : '👩‍🏫 Lesson explanation')\n                    : (isArabic ? '🎯 تطبيق وتدريب' : isFrench ? '🎯 Pratique et entraînement' : '🎯 Practice and drill')}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-200\">\n                  {nextPendingMission.subject}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-300\">\n                <Clock className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n                <span>{nextPendingMission.estimatedMinutes} {isArabic ? 'دقيقة' : 'min'}</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Teacher Voice Dialogue */}\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n              <div className=\"shrink-0 p-1.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/10 border border-white/15\">\n                <NourCharacter state=\"talking\" outfit=\"arabic\" size=\"sm\" />\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n                <h3 className=\"text-sm sm:text-base font-black text-white leading-tight\">\n                  {nextPendingMission.title}\n                </h3>\n                <p className=\"text-[11px] text-indigo-200 leading-snug\">\n                  {nextPendingMission.whyNow ? (\n                    <span>💡 {isArabic ? 'لماذا الآن؟ ' : 'Why now? '}{nextPendingMission.whyNow}</span>\n                  ) : (\n                    <span>💡 {nextPendingMission.type === 'homework'\n                      ? (isArabic ? 'واجب تم تسجيله اليوم ويجب إنهاؤه لتفادي التراكم.' : 'Homework due soon to keep your progress clear.')\n                      : (isArabic ? 'تثبيت هذا المفهوم خطوة حاسمة لفهم الدروس القادمة.' : 'Mastering this concept unlocks upcoming topics.')}\n                    </span>\n                  )}\n                </p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Primary Action Button */}\n            <div className=\"pt-1 flex gap-2\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => startMission(nextPendingMission)}\n                className=\"flex-1 py-3.5 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-linear-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-500 hover:from-amber-300 text-slate-950 font-black text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all active:scale-[0.99] cursor-pointer\"\n              >\n                <Play className=\"w-4 h-4 fill-slate-950\" />\n                <span>{isArabic ? 'ابدئي هذه المهمة الآن 🚀' : 'Start This Mission Now 🚀'}</span>\n              </button>\n\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => {\n                  const todayLessonsStr = currentDayRecord?.lessonsCovered?.map((l) => `${l.subject}: ${l.topic || ''}`).join(', ') || '';\n                  setCompanionContext({\n                    source: nextPendingMission.type === 'homework' ? 'homework' : 'home_next_action',\n                    missionId: nextPendingMission.id,\n                    lessonId: nextPendingMission.lessonId,\n                    conceptId: nextPendingMission.conceptId,\n                    subjectName: nextPendingMission.subject,\n                    topic: nextPendingMission.title,\n                    notes: nextPendingMission.whyNow,\n                    whyNow: nextPendingMission.whyNow,\n                    schoolDaySummary: todayLessonsStr,\n                    reasonWhyRecommended: nextPendingMission.whyNow,\n                  });\n                  setActiveTab('companion');\n                }}\n                className=\"px-3.5 py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/15 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer\"\n                title={isArabic ? 'اسألي مس نور عن أي شيء' : 'Ask Miss Nour'}\n              >\n                <Bot className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        {/* STATE C: All Missions Done for Today */}\n        {allMissionsDone && (\n          <div className=\"rounded-3xl bg-linear-to-br from-emerald-600 via-teal-700 to-indigo-900 text-white p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xl border border-emerald-400/40 space-y-3 text-center\">\n            <div className=\"w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md mx-auto flex items-center justify-center text-3xl shadow-sm\">\n              ⭐\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n              <h3 className=\"text-base font-black\">\n                {isArabic ? `أحسنتِ يا بطلة يا ${studentName}! 🌟` : `Awesome Job ${studentName}! 🌟`}\n              </h3>\n              <p className=\"text-xs text-emerald-100 max-w-sm mx-auto\">\n                {isArabic\n                  ? Ready for our quick daily wrap-up?'}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => openDailyReview()}\n              className=\"py-3 px-6 rounded-2xl bg-white text-emerald-950 font-black text-xs shadow-md hover:bg-emerald-50 transition-all inline-flex items-center gap-2\"\n            >\n              <Sparkles className=\"w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600\" />\n              <span>{isArabic ? 'افتحي المراجعة الهادئة لليوم (Calm Review)' : 'Open Calm Daily Review'}</span>\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </section>\n\n      {/* 3. CONFIRMED DAY SNAPSHOT (WHAT HAPPENED AT SCHOOL) */}\n      {hasConfirmedDayRecord && currentDayRecord && (\n        <ConfirmedDayRecordCard\n          record={currentDayRecord}\n          onEdit={() => setShowEditModal(true)}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {/* 4. 'وقت المذاكرة المتاح اليوم:' : 'Available Study Time:'}\n            </span>\n            <select\n              value={selectedDuration}\n              onChange={(e) => {\n                const val = Number(e.target.value);\n                setSelectedDuration(val);\n                regenerateMissionsForToday(val);\n              }}\n              className=\"bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 focus:outline-hidden\"\n            >\n              <option value={10}>{isArabic ? '١٠ دقائق (أدنى يوم فعال)' : '10 min (MVD)'}</option>\n              <option value={20}>{isArabic ? '٢٠ دقيقة' : '20 min'}</option>\n              <option value={35}>{isArabic ? '٣٥ دقيقة' : '35 min'}</option>\n              <option value={45}>{isArabic ? '٤٥ دقيقة (افتراضي)' : '45 min'}</option>\n              <option value={60}>{isArabic ? '٦٠ دقيقة' : '60 min'}</option>\n            </select>\n          </div>\n\n          <button\n            onClick={() => regenerateMissionsForToday(selectedDuration)}\n            className=\"p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all\"\n            title={isArabic ? 'إعادة جدولة المهام' : 'Re-plan missions'}\n          >\n            <RotateCcw className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n          </button>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Mission List */}\n        <MissionList\n          missions={missionsForToday}\n          onStartMission={(m) => startMission(m)}\n        />\n      </section>\n\n      {/* 5. VIRTUAL BOOKSHELF QUICK ENTRY */}\n      <section className=\"p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-xs space-y-3\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <span className=\"text-xl\">📚</span>\n            <div>\n              <h3 className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n                {isArabic ? 'مدرستي — كتبي المدرسية' : 'My School — Textbooks'}\n              </h3>\n              <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">\n                {isArabic ? 'جميع كتب وزارة التربية والتعليم الرسمية والداعمة' : 'All official & supplementary curriculum books'}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            onClick={() => setActiveTab('learn')}\n            className=\"text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1\"\n          >\n            <span>{isArabic ? 'تصفح الرف كاملاً' : 'View Shelf'}</span>\n            <span>←</span>\n          </button>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Scrollable Bookshelf Row displaying ALL subjects without arbitrarily hiding any */}\n        <div className=\"flex items-stretch gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 pt-0.5 scrollbar-thin\">\n          {curriculumBooks.map((b) => (\n            <div\n              key={b.subjectId}\n              onClick={() => setActiveTab('learn')}\n              className=\"min-w-[125px] w-[125px] p-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-400 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-750 transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between shrink-0 group hover:shadow-md\"\n            >\n              <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n                <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n                  <span className=\"text-2xl group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform\">{b.icon}</span>\n                  <span className=\"text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 shadow-2xs\">\n                    {b.availableLessons} {isArabic ? 'دروس' : 'les'}\n                  </span>\n                </div>\n                <h4 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 truncate pt-1\">\n                  {isArabic ? b.subjectNameAr : isFrench && b.subjectNameFr ? b.subjectNameFr : b.subjectNameEn}\n                </h4>\n                <p className=\"text-[9px] text-slate-400 truncate\">\n                  {isArabic ? b.bookTitleAr : b.bookTitleEn}\n                </p>\n              </div>\n\n              <div className=\"pt-2 mt-2 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-700/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400\">\n                <span>{isArabic ? 'افتحي الكتاب' : 'Open'}</span>\n                <span>←</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </section>\n\n      {/* 6. PERSISTENT TALK TO MISS NOUR ACTION */}\n      <button\n        type=\"button\"\n        onClick={() => {\n          const todayLessonsStr = currentDayRecord?.lessonsCovered?.map((l) => `${l.subject}: ${l.topic || ''}`).join(', ') || '';\n          setCompanionContext({\n            source: nextPendingMission ? (nextPendingMission.type === 'homework' ? 'homework' : 'home_next_action') : 'general',\n            missionId: nextPendingMission?.id,\n            lessonId: nextPendingMission?.lessonId,\n            conceptId: nextPendingMission?.conceptId,\n            subjectName: nextPendingMission?.subject,\n            topic: nextPendingMission?.title,\n            notes: nextPendingMission?.whyNow,\n            whyNow: nextPendingMission?.whyNow,\n            schoolDaySummary: todayLessonsStr,\n            reasonWhyRecommended: nextPendingMission?.whyNow,\n          });\n          setActiveTab('companion');\n        }}\n        className=\"w-full p-4 rounded-3xl bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-600 via-indigo-700 to-purple-700 hover:from-indigo-700 text-white font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm flex items-center justify-between shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/20 transition-all group cursor-pointer\"\n      >\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n          <div className=\"w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform\">\n            <Bot className=\"w-5 h-5 text-white\" />\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"text-left rtl:text-right\">\n            <span className=\"block font-black text-sm\">{isArabic ? 'تحدثي مع المعلمة نور 👩‍🏫' : 'Talk with Miss Nour 👩‍🏫'}</span>\n            <span className=\"block text-[10px] text-indigo-100 font-normal mt-0.5\">\n              {isArabic ? 'اسأليها عن أي درس أو مفهوم، صوتياً أو كتابة في أي وقت' : 'Ask her anything about lessons, voice or text'}\n            </span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        {isArabic ? <ArrowLeft className=\"w-4 h-4\" /> : <ArrowRight className=\"w-4 h-4\" />}\n      </button>\n\n      {/* Modals */}\n      {showReconstructionModal && (\n        <DayRecordFlowModal onClose={() => setShowReconstructionModal(false)} />\n      )}\n\n      {showEditModal && currentDayRecord && (\n        <EditDayRecordModal\n          record={currentDayRecord}\n          onClose={() => setShowEditModal(false)}\n          onSave={async (updated) => {\n            await saveDayRecord(updated);\n            setShowEditModal(false);\n          }}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {activeMissionRunnerOpen && activeMission && (\n        <MissionRunnerModal\n          mission={activeMission}\n          onClose={() => closeMissionRunner()}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {isDailyReviewOpen && currentDailyReview && (\n        <DailyReviewModal\n          review={currentDailyReview}\n          onClose={() => closeDailyReview()}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {isStageOpen && (\n        <StageModal\n          lessonId={activeStageLessonId}\n          onClose={() => setIsStageOpen(false)}\n        />\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",

}

<CheckCircle className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n                  <span>{t.dayRecord.confirmRecord}</span>\n                </button>\n\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n  "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport { DayRecord, SchoolDayKey } from '../../types';\nimport { Badge } from '../common/Badge';\nimport {\n  reconcileDayWithTimetable,\n  ReconciliationResult,\n  ExtractedDayData,\n} from '../../services/reconstruction/dayRecordReconciliation';\nimport { EditDayRecordModal } from './EditDayRecordModal';\nimport { VoiceInputControl } from '../voice/VoiceInputControl';\nimport { VoiceSpeakButton } from '../voice/VoiceSpeakButton';\nimport {\n  Bot,\n  Sparkles,\n  Send,\n  CheckCircle,\n  Edit3,\n  X,\n  AlertTriangle,\n  HelpCircle,\n  Clock,\n  BookOpen,\n} from 'lucide-react';\nimport { localDateStr } from '../../utils/time';\n\ninterface DayRecordFlowModalProps {\n  onClose: () => void;\n}\n\nexport const DayRecordFlowModal: React.FC<DayRecordFlowModalProps> = ({ onClose }) => {\n  const {\n    t,\n    language,\n    student,\n    timetable,\n    saveDayRecord,\n  } = useApp();\n  const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n\n  const [studentInput, setStudentInput] = useState('');\n  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);\n  const [step, setStep] = useState<'input' | 'neutral_followup' | 'readback_confirmation'>('input');\n  const [followUpCount, setFollowUpCount] = useState(0);\n\n  // Extracted proposal state\n  const [proposedRecord, setProposedRecord] = useState<DayRecord | null>(null);\n  const [reconciliation, setReconciliation] = useState<ReconciliationResult | null>(null);\n  const [followUpPrompt, setFollowUpPrompt] = useState<string>('');\n  const [followUpResponse, setFollowUpResponse] = useState<string>('');\n  const [isManualEditing, setIsManualEditing] = useState(false);\n\n  const studentName = student?.name || (isArabic ? 'يا بطل' : 'Friend');\n\n  // Determine current day of week for Egypt timetable\n  const currentDayIndex = new Date().getDay();\n  const dayKeyMap: Record<number, SchoolDayKey> = {\n    0: 'sunday',\n    1: 'monday',\n    2: 'tuesday',\n    3: 'wednesday',\n    4: 'thursday',\n  };\n  const todayKey: SchoolDayKey | null = dayKeyMap[currentDayIndex] ?? null;\n  const todayDate = localDateStr();\n\n  // Pipeline Step 1 -> Step 4\n  const handleProcessInput = async (inputText: string) => {\n    const text = (inputText || studentInput).trim();\n    if (!text || isProcessing || !student?.id) return;\n\n    setIsProcessing(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Step 2 & 3: Send to Gemini via server proxy\n      const response = await fetch('/api/reconstruct-day', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          studentInput: text,\n          studentName,\n          grade: student.grade || 'Grade 5',\n          language,\n          todayTimetableSubjects: timetable?.days.find((d) => d.day === todayKey)?.periods.map((p) => p.subject) || [],\n        }),\n      });\n\n      const extracted: ExtractedDayData = await response.json();\n\n      // Step 4: Pure TypeScript reconciliation with timetable\n      const recon = reconcileDayWithTimetable(extracted, timetable, todayKey, language);\n      setReconciliation(recon);\n\n      const draftRecord: DayRecord = {\n        id: 'dr_' + Date.now(),\n        studentId: student.id,\n        date: todayDate,\n        lessonsCovered: extracted.lessonsCovered,\n        homeworkAssigned: extracted.homeworkAssigned,\n        notes: extracted.notes || text,\n        confirmed: false,\n        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        origin: 'draft',\n        discrepancies: recon.discrepancies,\n        rawStudentInput: text,\n      };\n\n      setProposedRecord(draftRecord);\n\n      // Check failure paths: do we need a neutral follow-up?\n      if (recon.neutralFollowUpPrompt && followUpCount < 3) {\n        setFollowUpPrompt(recon.neutralFollowUpPrompt);\n        setStep('neutral_followup');\n      } else {\n        setStep('readback_confirmation');\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('Reconstruction error:', err);\n      // Safe draft without fabricating unconfirmed lessons\n      const fallbackDraft: DayRecord = {\n        id: 'dr_' + Date.now(),\n        studentId: student.id,\n        date: todayDate,\n        lessonsCovered: [],\n        homeworkAssigned: [],\n        notes: text,\n        rawStudentInput: text,\n        confirmed: false,\n        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        origin: 'draft',\n      };\n      setProposedRecord(fallbackDraft);\n      setStep('readback_confirmation');\n    } finally {\n      setIsProcessing(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Handle student answering the neutral follow-up question\n  const handleFollowUpAnswer = async (answer: string) => {\n    if (!proposedRecord || isProcessing) return;\n    const newCount = followUpCount + 1;\n    setFollowUpCount(newCount);\n\n    const fullDescription = `${proposedRecord.rawStudentInput}. [إجابة الطالب على السؤال]: ${answer}`;\n\n    // If student confirmed change (e.g. \"نعم الجدول اتغير\" or \"العلوم اتلغت\")\n    if (answer.includes('اتغير') || answer.includes('changed') || answer.includes('اتلغت')) {\n      const updated: DayRecord = {\n        ...proposedRecord,\n        notes: fullDescription,\n        discrepancies: {\n          ...proposedRecord.discrepancies,\n          notes: isArabic ? 'أكد الطالب تغيير جدول الحصص في المدرسة اليوم.' : 'Student confirmed timetable changed at school today.',\n        },\n      };\n      setProposedRecord(updated);\n      setStep('readback_confirmation');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Otherwise, re-run reconciliation with the added context or advance to confirmation if limit reached\n    if (newCount >= 3) {\n      setStep('readback_confirmation');\n    } else {\n      await handleProcessInput(fullDescription);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Step 7: Student confirms Day Record\n  const handleConfirmRecord = async () => {\n    if (!proposedRecord || !student) return;\n    const confirmedRecord: DayRecord = {\n      ...proposedRecord,\n      studentId: student.id,\n      confirmed: true,\n      confirmedAt: new      </div>\n\n        {/* Modal Body */}\n        <div className=\"flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 text-xs\">\n          {/* STEP 1: FREE-TEXT DESCRIPTION */}\n          {step === 'input' && (\n          : `Tell me in your own words ${studentName}: what lessons did you have, and did you receive any homework for tomorrow?`}\n                  </p>\n                </div>\n              </div>\n\n              {/* Free Text Input Area */}\n              <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n                <textarea\n                  rows={3}\n                  value={studentInput}\n focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 text-xs\"\n                />\n\n                <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                  <VoiceInputControl\n disabled={!studentInput.trim() || isProcessing}\n                    className=\"flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-40 text-white font-bold flex {reconciliation?.naturalLanguageSummary}\n                  </p>\n                </div>\n              </div>\n\n              {/* Summary Card of Draft Record */}\n              <div
