'إكمال أسئلة المراجعة وتأكيد ثبات المفهوم'\n          : 'Complete review questions and confirm retention',\n        status: 'pending',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY E: General practice for active or weakest subject\n  if (candidatePool.length < 3) {\n    // Find unstarted or learning concepts in active subjects\n    for (const sId of activeSubjectIds) {\n      const pool = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === sId && !usedConceptIds.has(c.id));\n      if (pool.length > 0) {\n        const nextConcept = pool[0];\n        usedConceptIds.add(nextConcept.id);\n        const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n        const conceptName = isAr ? nextConcept.nameAr : nextConcept.nameEn;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 200,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_practice_${date}_${nextConcept.id}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: nextConcept.lessonId,\n            conceptId: nextConcept.id,\n            title: isAr ? `استكشاف وتدريب: ${conceptName}` : `Explore & Practice: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: 'practice',\n            estimatedMinutes: 10,\n            whyNow: isAr\n              ? `تدريب استباقي في مادة ${subjName} لبناء قاعدة معرفية قوية.`\n              : `Proactive practice in ${subjName} to strengthen learning foundations.`,\n            originTag: nextConcept.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? 'خوض جولة تدريبية وتجربة الأسئلة'\n              : 'Engage with practice questions',\n            status: 'pending',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Sort strictly by priorityWeight descending\n  candidatePool.sort((a, b) => b.priorityWeight - a.priorityWeight);\n\n  // Time Budget & Capacity Truncation\n  // Max time allowed is declaredBudget + 10 min\n  const maxAllowedMinutes = declaredBudget + 10;\n\n  let selectedMissions: Mission[] = [];\n  let totalMinutes = 0;\n  let droppedCount = 0;\n\n  if (isMinimumViableDay) {\n    // Pick exactly ONE highest priority mission (5-10 min)\n    if (candidatePool.length > 0) {\n      const top = candidatePool[0].mission;\n      top.estimatedMinutes = Math.min(top.estimatedMinutes, 10);\n      selectedMissions = [top];\n      totalMinutes = top.estimatedMinutes;\n      droppedCount = candidatePool.length - 1;\n    }\n  } else {\n    for (const item of candidatePool) {\n      if (selectedMissions.length >= MAX_MISSIONS_CAP) {\n        droppedCount++;\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Enforce constraint: missions never exceed 20 min without student opt-in\n      const missionMin = Math.min(item.mission.estimatedMinutes, MAX_MISSION_MINUTES);\n      item.mission.estimatedMinutes = missionMin;\n\n      if (totalMinutes + missionMin <= maxAllowedMinutes) {\n        selectedMissions.push(item.mission);\n        totalMinutes += missionMin;\n      } else {\n        droppedCount++;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If candidate pool was completely empty (e.g. initial setup)\n  if (selectedMissions.length === 0 && flatConcepts.length > 0) {\n    const firstConcept = flatConcepts[0];\n    const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(firstConcept.subjectId, language);\n    selectedMissions.push({\n      id: `mis_starter_${date}`,\n      studentId: student.id,\n      date,\n      subject: subjName,\n      lessonId: firstConcept.lessonId,\n      conceptId: firstConcept.id,\n      title: isAr ? `بداية الانطلاق: ${firstConcept.nameAr}` : `Kickoff: ${firstConcept.nameEn}`,\n      type: 'understand_lesson',\n      estimatedMinutes: 8,\n      whyNow: isAr\n        ? 'مهمة ترحيبية خفيفة لبدء التعلم المنظم لليوم.'\n        : 'A light starter mission to initiate your learning day.',\n      originTag: firstConcept.origin,\n      successCriterion: isAr ? 'استكمال الشروع وفحص الفهم' : 'Complete check and build confidence',\n      status: 'pending',\n    });\n    totalMinutes = 8;\n  }\n\n  // Prepare explanation note if items were dropped to honor time budget\n  let droppedMessage: string | undefined;\n  if (droppedCount > 0) {\n    droppedMessage = isAr\n      ? `أسقطنا ${droppedCount} ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'مهمة' : 'مهام'} ذات أولوية أقل للحفاظ على وقتك واقعياً ومريحاً (${totalMinutes} دقيقة).`\n      : `Dropped ${droppedCount} lower-priority ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'mission' : 'missions'} to keep today realistic (${totalMinutes} min).`;\n  }\n\n  return {\n    missions: selectedMissions,\n    explanation: {\n      droppedCount,\n      droppedMessage,\n      isMinimumViableDay,\n      usedTimetableFallback,\n      totalEstimatedMinutes: totalMinutes,\n      budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n      parentOverrideApplied,\n      parentOverrideMessage,\n    },\n  };\n}\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport {\n  Mission,\n  DayRecord,\n  Timetable,\n  MasteryRecord,\n  Student,\n  FlatCurriculumConcept,\n  SchoolDayKey,\n  Language,\n  ParentPreferences,\n} from '../../types';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport { formatMasteryView } from '../mastery/masteryEngine';\nimport { getDueReviewConcepts } from '../review/spacedReviewScheduler';\nimport { localDateStr } from '../../utils/time';\n\nexport interface PlanMissionsParams {\n  student?: Student | null;\n  dayRecord?: DayRecord | null;\n  timetable?: Timetable | null;\n  masteryRecords: Record<string, MasteryRecord>;\n  availableMinutes?: number;\n  sessionHistoryCount?: number;\n  fatigueSignal?: boolean;\n  date?: string; // YYYY-MM-DD\n  language?: Language;\n  parentPreferences?: ParentPreferences | null;\n}\n\nexport interface PlanMissionsResult {\n  missions: Mission[];\n  explanation: {\n    droppedCount: number;\n    droppedMessage?: string;\n    isMinimumViableDay: boolean;\n    usedTimetableFallback: boolean;\n    totalEstimatedMinutes: number;\n    budgetMinutes: number;\n    parentOverrideApplied?: boolean;\n    parentOverrideMessage?: string;\n    needsSchoolInformation?: boolean;\n    emptyReason?: string;\n  };\n}\n\nconst DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAY_BUDGET = 45;\nconst MAX_MISSIONS_CAP = 6;\nconst MAX_MISSION_MINUTES = 20;\n\n/**\n * Maps subject strings across Arabic, French, and English to curriculum subject IDs\n */\nfunction normalizeSubject(subName?: string): string {\n  if (!subName) return '';\n  const s = subName.trim().toLowerCase();\n\n  // Math is the Egyptian national curriculum taught in French.\n  // French wording must never create a second subject identity.\n  if (\n    (s.includes('math') && (s.includes('fr') || s.includes('فرنس'))) ||\n    s.includes('mathématiques') ||\n    s.includes('الرياضيات بالفرنسية')\n  ) {\n    return 'subj_math';\n  }\n\n  // Science is the Egyptian national curriculum taught in French.\n  // French wording must never create a second subject identity.\n  if (\n    (s.includes('sci') && (s.includes('fr') || s.includes('فرنس'))) ||\n    s.includes('sciences fr') ||\n    s.includes('العلوم بالفرنسية')\n  ) {\n    return 'subj_science';\n  }\n\n  // French Language\n  if (s.includes('فرنساوي') || s.includes('فرنسي') || s.includes('french') || s.includes('français')) {\n    return 'subj_french';\n  }\n\n  if (s.includes('عرب') || s.includes('لغة عربية') || s.includes('arabic')) return 'subj_arabic';\n  if (s.includes('رياض') || s.includes('حساب') || s.includes('math')) return 'subj_math';\n  if (s.includes('علوم') || s.includes('science')) return 'subj_science';\n  if (s.includes('دراس') || s.includes('social')) return 'subj_social';\n  if (s.includes('إنجليز') || s.includes('انجليز') || s.includes('english')) return 'subj_english';\n  if (s.includes('تكنولوج') || s.includes('ict')) return 'subj_ict';\n  if (s.includes('دين') || s.includes('islamic') || s.includes('religion')) return 'subj_islamic';\n  if (s.includes('خط') || s.includes('calligraphy')) return 'subj_calligraphy';\n\n  return '';\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets human-readable subject name\n */\nfunction getSubjectDisplayName(subjId: string, lang: Language): string {\n  const isAr = lang === 'ar';\n  const isFr = lang === 'fr';\n\n  switch (subjId) {\n    case 'subj_french':\n      return isAr ? 'اللغة الفرنسية' : isFr ? 'Français' : 'French Language';\n    // Math/Science use canonical subject IDs even when taught in French.\n    case 'subj_arabic':\n      return isAr ? 'اللغة العربية' : isFr ? 'Langue Arabe' : 'Arabic Language';\n    case 'subj_math':\n      return isAr ? 'الرياضيات' : isFr ? 'Maths' : 'Mathematics';\n    case 'subj_science':\n      return isAr ? 'العلوم' : isFr ? 'Sciences' : 'Science';\n    case 'subj_social':\n      return isAr ? 'الدراسات الاجتماعية' : isFr ? 'Études Sociales' : 'Social Studies';\n    case 'subj_english':\n      return isAr ? 'اللغة الإنجليزية' : isFr ? 'Anglais' : 'English Connect 5';\n    case 'subj_ict':\n      return isAr ? 'تكنولوجيا المعلومات والاتصالات' : isFr ? 'TIC' : 'ICT';\n    case 'subj_islamic':\n      return isAr ? 'التربية الدينية الإسلامية' : isFr ? 'Éducation Islamique' : 'Islamic Education';\n    case 'subj_calligraphy':\n      return isAr ? 'الخط العربي' : isFr ? 'Calligraphie' : 'Arabic Calligraphy';\n    default:\n      return isAr ? 'المادة الدراسية' : isFr ? 'Matière Scolaire' : 'School Subject';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Finds curriculum concepts related to a subject or topic text\n */\nfunction findConceptsForSubject(\n  subjectId: string,\n  topicText: string = '',\n  flatConcepts: FlatCurriculumConcept[]\n): FlatCurriculumConcept[] {\n  const subjectConcepts = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === subjectId);\n  if (!topicText || subjectConcepts.length === 0) return subjectConcepts;\n\n  const words = topicText.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 2);\n  const matched = subjectConcepts.filter((c) => {\n    const textAr = (c.nameAr + ' ' + (c.descriptionAr || '')).toLowerCase();\n    const textEn = (c.nameEn + ' ' + (c.descriptionEn || '')).toLowerCase();\n    return words.some((w) => textAr.includes(w) || textEn.includes(w));\n  });\n\n  return matched.length > 0 ? matched : subjectConcepts;\n}\n\n/**\n * Pure TypeScript, decoupled daily mission planner.\n * Follows exact priority ordering:\n *  a. Homework assigned today (per Day Record)\n *  b. Lessons covered today that have concepts with low mastery\n *  c. Concepts flagged needs_review\n *  d. Due-for-spaced-review concepts (stub)\n *  e. General practice for weakest subject\n */\nexport function planDailyMissions(params: PlanMissionsParams): PlanMissionsResult {\n  const {\n    student,\n    dayRecord,\n    timetable,\n    masteryRecords,\n    availableMinutes,\n    fatigueSignal = false,\n    date = localDateStr(),\n    language = 'ar',\n    parentPreferences,\n  } = params;\n\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n\n  if (!student || !student.id) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback: false,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: 0,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'no_student',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لا يوجد ملف طالب نشط حالياً. يرجى إعداد الملف للبدء.'\n          : 'No active student profile found. Please complete onboarding first.',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  const flatConcepts = curriculumService.getFlatConcepts();\n\n  let parentOverrideApplied = false;\n  let parentOverrideMessage: string | undefined;\n\n  // 1. Determine Time Budget\n  // Default is 45 min, or student declared. If fatigue signal is high, adjust downward.\n  let declaredBudget = availableMinutes ?? DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAY_BUDGET;\n  if (declaredBudget < 5) declaredBudget = 10; // minimum sensible budget\n\n  // Check parent override on daily study budget\n  if (parentPreferences?.maxDailyStudyMinutes && parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes < declaredBudget) {\n    declaredBudget = parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes;\n    parentOverrideApplied = true;\n    parentOverrideMessage = isAr\n      ? `تم تعديل وقت المذاكرة اليومي إلى (${parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes} دقيقة) وفقاً للحد المحدد مع ولي الأمر لضمان راحة متوازنة.`\n      : `Daily study time adjusted to (${parentPreferences.maxDailyStudyMinutes} min) per parent settings to ensure healthy rest.`;\n  }\n\n  if (fatigueSignal) {\n    declaredBudget = Math.max(15, Math.floor(declaredBudget * 0.75));\n  }\n\n  // Check parent bedtime constraint\n  let nearBedtime = false;\n  if (parentPreferences?.bedtimeLimit) {\n    try {\n      const [bHour, bMin] = parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit.split(':').map(Number);\n      const now = new Date();\n      const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();\n      const bedtimeMinutes = bHour * 60 + (bMin || 0);\n      if (bedtimeMinutes - currentMinutes <= 45 && bedtimeMinutes - currentMinutes > -60) {\n        nearBedtime = true;\n        parentOverrideApplied = true;\n        parentOverrideMessage = isAr\n          ? `اقترب موعد النوم المحدد مع ولي الأمر (${parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit}). تم تقليص الخطة لمهمة واحدة سريعة لمساعدتك على النوم مبكراً.`\n          : `Approaching bedtime set by parent (${parentPreferences.bedtimeLimit}). Tasks limited to a single quick mission.`;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // Ignore time parse issues\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Failure path A: No time today / under 15 minutes or near bedtime → Offer \"minimum viable day\": ONE mission of 5-10 min\n  const isMinimumViableDay = declaredBudget <= 15 || nearBedtime;\n\n  const candidatePool: Array<{\n    mission: Mission;\n    priorityWeight: number; // Higher number = higher priority\n  }> = [];\n\n  const usedConceptIds = new Set<string>();\n\n  // Determine subjects active today\n  let activeSubjectIds: string[] = [];\n  let usedTimetableFallback = false;\n\n  const isConfirmedDay = Boolean(dayRecord && dayRecord.confirmed);\n\n  if (dayRecord && dayRecord.lessonsCovered && dayRecord.lessonsCovered.length > 0) {\n    // Collect from today's recorded lessons (confirmed or student-logged)\n    dayRecord.lessonsCovered.forEach((l) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(l.subject);\n      if (sId && !activeSubjectIds.includes(sId)) activeSubjectIds.push(sId);\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Fallback to timetable if no confirmed day record or no subjects identified\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && timetable) {\n    usedTimetableFallback = true;\n    const currentDayIndex = new Date().getDay();\n    const dayKeyMap: Record<number, SchoolDayKey> = {\n      0: 'sunday',\n      1: 'monday',\n      2: 'tuesday',\n      3: 'wednesday',\n      4: 'thursday',\n    };\n    const todayKey: SchoolDayKey | null = dayKeyMap[currentDayIndex] ?? null;\n    const daySched = todayKey ? timetable.days.find((d) => d.day === todayKey) : undefined;\n    if (daySched) {\n      daySched.periods.forEach((p) => {\n        if (!p.isBreak) {\n          const sId = normalizeSubject(p.subject);\n          if (sId && !activeSubjectIds.includes(sId)) activeSubjectIds.push(sId);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Identify subjects with due reviews or low mastery\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0) {\n    const dueReviews = getDueReviewConcepts(student.id, masteryRecords, { language });\n    for (const r of dueReviews) {\n      const c = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.id === r.conceptId);\n      if (c && !activeSubjectIds.includes(c.subjectId)) {\n        activeSubjectIds.push(c.subjectId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If no reliable learning signal exists (no confirmed day record, no timetable for today, no due reviews, no mastery history):\n  // Safe fallback: Return explicit safe onboarding / needs-school-info state without fabricating priorities!\n  const hasLearningSignal =\n    (isConfirmedDay && ((dayRecord?.lessonsCovered?.length || 0) > 0 || (dayRecord?.homeworkAssigned?.length || 0) > 0)) ||\n    usedTimetableFallback ||\n    activeSubjectIds.length > 0 ||\n    Object.keys(masteryRecords).length > 0;\n\n  if (!hasLearningSignal) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback: false,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'needs_school_info',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لم يتم تسجيل يوم مدرسي أو جدول حصص بعد. سجلي ما تم دراسته اليوم في المدرسة لنضع لكِ خطة مذاكرة ذكية ودقيقة!'\n          : 'No school day record or timetable yet. Please log today\\'s school lessons so we can build your personalized learning plan!',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Existing mastery is a learning signal only for the subjects represented by\n  // those authoritative concepts. Never expand an otherwise unscoped state to\n  // every curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0 && Object.keys(masteryRecords).length > 0) {\n    for (const conceptId of Object.keys(masteryRecords)) {\n      const concept = flatConcepts.find((fc) => fc.id === conceptId);\n      if (concept && !activeSubjectIds.includes(concept.subjectId)) {\n        activeSubjectIds.push(concept.subjectId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If we still cannot identify a reliable subject, ask for school information\n  // instead of choosing an arbitrary curriculum subject.\n  if (activeSubjectIds.length === 0) {\n    return {\n      missions: [],\n      explanation: {\n        droppedCount: 0,\n        isMinimumViableDay: false,\n        usedTimetableFallback,\n        totalEstimatedMinutes: 0,\n        budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n        needsSchoolInformation: true,\n        emptyReason: 'needs_school_info',\n        droppedMessage: isAr\n          ? 'لم نتمكن من تحديد مادة دراسية موثوقة لهذا اليوم. سجلي ما تم دراسته أو جدول الحصص لنضع خطة دقيقة.'\n          : 'No reliable subject is available for today. Please log today’s lessons or timetable so we can build an accurate plan.',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY A: Homework assigned today (per Day Record)\n  if (isConfirmedDay && dayRecord && dayRecord.homeworkAssigned?.length > 0) {\n    const authoritativeFallbackSubj = curriculumService.getSubjectsSummary()[0]?.subjectId || 'subj_arabic';\n    dayRecord.homeworkAssigned.forEach((hw, idx) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(hw.subject) || activeSubjectIds[0] || authoritativeFallbackSubj;\n      const matched = findConceptsForSubject(sId, hw.description, flatConcepts);\n      const targetConcept = matched[0];\n      const conceptId = targetConcept?.id;\n\n      if (conceptId) usedConceptIds.add(conceptId);\n\n      const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n      const missionTitle = isAr\n        ? `تثبيت وتطبيق واجب: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`\n        : `Homework Practice: ${hw.description.slice(0, 32)}${hw.description.length > 32 ? '...' : ''}`;\n\n      const whyNow = isAr\n        ? `واجب تم تسجيله في مدرسة اليوم بمادة ${subjName}.`\n        : `Homework logged for ${subjName} in today's school record.`;\n\n      candidatePool.push({\n        priorityWeight: 1000 - idx,\n        mission: {\n          id: `mis_hw_${date}_${idx}`,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          date,\n          subject: subjName,\n          lessonId: targetConcept?.lessonId,\n          conceptId,\n          homeworkItemId: hw.id || `hw_${student.id}_${date}_${idx}`,\n          homeworkDescription: hw.description,\n          title: missionTitle,\n          type: 'homework',\n          estimatedMinutes: 10,\n          whyNow,\n          originTag: targetConcept?.origin || 'official',\n          successCriterion: isAr\n            ? 'حل أسئلة الواجب والتحقق من الاستيعاب'\n            : 'Complete homework questions and verify comprehension',\n          status: 'pending',\n        },\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY B: Lessons covered today that have concepts with low mastery\n  if (isConfirmedDay && dayRecord && dayRecord.lessonsCovered?.length > 0) {\n    dayRecord.lessonsCovered.forEach((les, idx) => {\n      const sId = normalizeSubject(les.subject);\n      if (!sId) return;\n\n      const matched = findConceptsForSubject(sId, les.topic || '', flatConcepts);\n      // Find concept with lowest mastery or unstarted\n      let candidate = matched.find((c) => !usedConceptIds.has(c.id));\n      if (!candidate && matched.length > 0) candidate = matched[0];\n\n      if (candidate) {\n        usedConceptIds.add(candidate.id);\n        const mastery = masteryRecords[candidate.id];\n        const masteryView = formatMasteryView(mastery, language);\n        const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n\n        const isUnstartedOrLow = !masteryView.hasEvidence || (mastery?.score ?? 0.5) < 0.7;\n        const missionType = isUnstartedOrLow ? 'understand_lesson' : 'quiz';\n        const estMin = missionType === 'understand_lesson' ? 10 : 8;\n\n        const conceptName = isAr ? candidate.nameAr : candidate.nameEn;\n        const whyNow = isAr\n          ? `درس تم تناوله اليوم في المدرسة (${conceptName}) لتثبيت الفهم فوراً.`\n          : `Covered at school today (${conceptName}) to reinforce comprehension immediately.`;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 800 - idx,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_lesson_${date}_${idx}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: candidate.lessonId,\n            conceptId: candidate.id,\n            title: isAr ? `فهم واستيعاب: ${conceptName}` : `Understand: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: missionType,\n            estimatedMinutes: estMin,\n            whyNow,\n            originTag: candidate.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? 'مشاهدة الشرح والإجابة على فحص الاستيعاب السريع'\n              : 'Watch explanation and pass quick check',\n            status: 'pending',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  // PRIORITY C: Concepts flagged needs_review (from Phase 4 mastery records)\n  flatConcepts.forEach((concept) => {\n    if (usedConceptIds.has(concept.id)) return;\n    const rec = masteryRecords[concept.id];\n    if (!rec) return;\n\n    const view = formatMasteryView(rec, language);\n    if (view.threshold === 'needs_review') {\n      usedConceptIds.add(concept.id);\n      const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(concept.subjectId, language);\n      const conceptName = isAr ? concept.nameAr : concept.nameEn;\n\n      candidatePool.push({\n        priorityWeight: 600,\n        mission: {\n          id: `mis_review_${date}_${concept.id}`,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          date,\n          subject: subjName,\n          lessonId: concept.lessonId,\n          conceptId: concept.id,\n          title: isAr ? `مراجعة داعمة: ${conceptName}` : `Review: ${conceptName}`,\n          type: 'review',\n          estimatedMinutes: 8,\n          whyNow: isAr\n            ? `مفهوم علمي انخفض استيعابه أو يحتاج دعماً إضافياً (${view.compositeLabel}).`\n            : `Concept flagged as needs review based on mastery records (${view.compositeLabel}).`,\n          originTag: concept.origin,\n          successCriterion: isAr\n            ? 'الإجابة على أسئلة المراجعة واستعادة الثقة'\n            : 'Answer review questions and restore confidence',\n          status: 'pending',\n        },\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY D: Due-for-spaced-review concepts (Phase 7 Spaced Revision Scheduler)\n  const dueSpacedReviews = getDueReviewConcepts(student.id, masteryRecords, {\n    currentDate: new Date(),\n    language,\n  });\n\n  dueSpacedReviews.forEach((item, idx) => {\n    if (usedConceptIds.has(item.conceptId)) return;\n    usedConceptIds.add(item.conceptId);\n\n    const conceptMeta = flatConcepts.find((c) => c.id === item.conceptId);\n    const conceptName = isAr ? item.conceptNameAr : item.conceptNameEn;\n\n    candidatePool.push({\n      priorityWeight: 450 - idx,\n      mission: {\n        id: `mis_spaced_${date}_${item.conceptId}`,\n        studentId: student.id,\n        date,\n        subject: item.subjectName,\n        lessonId: conceptMeta?.lessonId,\n        conceptId: item.conceptId,\n        title: isAr ? `مراجعة متباعدة: ${conceptName}` : `Spaced Review: ${conceptName}`,\n        type: 'review',\n        estimatedMinutes: 8,\n        whyNow: isAr\n          ? `حان موعد المراجعة المتباعدة (${item.reason}).`\n          : `Spaced review interval reached (${item.reason}).`,\n        originTag: conceptMeta?.origin || 'official',\n        successCriterion: isAr\n          ? 'إكمال أسئلة المراجعة وتأكيد ثبات المفهوم'\n          : 'Complete review questions and confirm retention',\n        status: 'pending',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  // PRIORITY E: General practice for active or weakest subject\n  if (candidatePool.length < 3) {\n    // Find unstarted or learning concepts in active subjects\n    for (const sId of activeSubjectIds) {\n      const pool = flatConcepts.filter((c) => c.subjectId === sId && !usedConceptIds.has(c.id));\n      if (pool.length > 0) {\n        const nextConcept = pool[0];\n        usedConceptIds.add(nextConcept.id);\n        const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(sId, language);\n        const conceptName = isAr ? nextConcept.nameAr : nextConcept.nameEn;\n\n        candidatePool.push({\n          priorityWeight: 200,\n          mission: {\n            id: `mis_practice_${date}_${nextConcept.id}`,\n            studentId: student.id,\n            date,\n            subject: subjName,\n            lessonId: nextConcept.lessonId,\n            conceptId: nextConcept.id,\n            title: isAr ? `استكشاف وتدريب: ${conceptName}` : `Explore & Practice: ${conceptName}`,\n            type: 'practice',\n            estimatedMinutes: 10,\n            whyNow: isAr\n              ? `تدريب استباقي في مادة ${subjName} لبناء قاعدة معرفية قوية.`\n              : `Proactive practice in ${subjName} to strengthen learning foundations.`,\n            originTag: nextConcept.origin,\n            successCriterion: isAr\n              ? 'خوض جولة تدريبية وتجربة الأسئلة'\n              : 'Engage with practice questions',\n            status: 'pending',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Sort strictly by priorityWeight descending\n  candidatePool.sort((a, b) => b.priorityWeight - a.priorityWeight);\n\n  // Time Budget & Capacity Truncation\n  // Max time allowed is declaredBudget + 10 min\n  const maxAllowedMinutes = declaredBudget + 10;\n\n  let selectedMissions: Mission[] = [];\n  let totalMinutes = 0;\n  let droppedCount = 0;\n\n  if (isMinimumViableDay) {\n    // Pick exactly ONE highest priority mission (5-10 min)\n    if (candidatePool.length > 0) {\n      const top = candidatePool[0].mission;\n      top.estimatedMinutes = Math.min(top.estimatedMinutes, 10);\n      selectedMissions = [top];\n      totalMinutes = top.estimatedMinutes;\n      droppedCount = candidatePool.length - 1;\n    }\n  } else {\n    for (const item of candidatePool) {\n      if (selectedMissions.length >= MAX_MISSIONS_CAP) {\n        droppedCount++;\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Enforce constraint: missions never exceed 20 min without student opt-in\n      const missionMin = Math.min(item.mission.estimatedMinutes, MAX_MISSION_MINUTES);\n      item.mission.estimatedMinutes = missionMin;\n\n      if (totalMinutes + missionMin <= maxAllowedMinutes) {\n        selectedMissions.push(item.mission);\n        totalMinutes += missionMin;\n      } else {\n        droppedCount++;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If candidate pool was completely empty (e.g. initial setup)\n  if (selectedMissions.length === 0 && flatConcepts.length > 0) {\n    const firstConcept = flatConcepts[0];\n    const subjName = getSubjectDisplayName(firstConcept.subjectId, language);\n    selectedMissions.push({\n      id: `mis_starter_${date}`,\n      studentId: student.id,\n      date,\n      subject: subjName,\n      lessonId: firstConcept.lessonId,\n      conceptId: firstConcept.id,\n      title: isAr ? `بداية الانطلاق: ${firstConcept.nameAr}` : `Kickoff: ${firstConcept.nameEn}`,\n      type: 'understand_lesson',\n      estimatedMinutes: 8,\n      whyNow: isAr\n        ? 'مهمة ترحيبية خفيفة لبدء التعلم المنظم لليوم.'\n        : 'A light starter mission to initiate your learning day.',\n      originTag: firstConcept.origin,\n      successCriterion: isAr ? 'استكمال الشروع وفحص الفهم' : 'Complete check and build confidence',\n      status: 'pending',\n    });\n    totalMinutes = 8;\n  }\n\n  // Prepare explanation note if items were dropped to honor time budget\n  let droppedMessage: string | undefined;\n  if (droppedCount > 0) {\n    droppedMessage = isAr\n      ? `أسقطنا ${droppedCount} ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'مهمة' : 'مهام'} ذات أولوية أقل للحفاظ على وقتك واقعياً ومريحاً (${totalMinutes} دقيقة).`\n      : `Dropped ${droppedCount} lower-priority ${droppedCount === 1 ? 'mission' : 'missions'} to keep today realistic (${totalMinutes} min).`;\n  }\n\n  return {\n    missions: selectedMissions,\n    explanation: {\n      droppedCount,\n      droppedMessage,\n      isMinimumViableDay,\n      usedTimetableFallback,\n      totalEstimatedMinutes: totalMinutes,\n      budgetMinutes: declaredBudget,\n      parentOverrideApplied,\n      parentOverrideMessage,\n    },\n  };\n}\n",
 "kind": "FileEditorObservation"
}

'درجة جيدة ولكن الثقة ما زالت منخفضة لقلة المحاولات؛ مراجعة سريعة.'\n        : 'Good score but low confidence due to limited samples; quick check in 3 days.';\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Calculate next review timestamp\n  const nextReviewTime = lastPracticedTime + intervalDays * 24 * 3600 * 1000;\n  const nextReviewAt = new Date(nextReviewTime).toISOString();\n  const isDue = nowTime >= nextReviewTime;\n  const overdueDays = Math.max(0, Math.floor(daysSincePractice - intervalDays));\n  const isOverdue = overdueDays >= 3;\n\n  if (isOverdue) {\n    status = 'overdue';\n  } else if (isDue && status !== 'just_revealed') {\n    status = 'due';\n  }\n\n  const subjectMeta = curriculumService.getAminaSubject(concept.subjectId);\n  const subjectName = isAr\n    ? 'text-indigo-200' : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500'\n                  }`}\n                >\n                  <span>{msg.timestamp}</span>\n                  {!isUser && (\n                    <VoiceSpeakButton\n                      text={msg.content}\n                      size=\"sm\"\n                      className=\"ml-auto rtl:ml-0 rtl:mr-auto\"\n                    />\n                  )}\n                </div>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          );\n        })}\n\n        {isSending && (\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-400 italic\">\n            <div className=\"w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950 flex items-center justify-center\">\n              <Bot className=\"w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600\" />\n            </div>\n            <span>{t.companion.typing}</span>\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        <div ref={messagesEndRef} />\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Quick Prompts */}\n      <div className=\"px-3 pb-2\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-1\">\n          {samplePrompts.map((p, idx) => (\n            <button\n              key={idx}\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => handleSendMessage(p)}\n              disabled={isSending}\n              className=\"px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-[11px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 transition-colors\"\n            >\n              {p}\n            </button>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Input Bar */}\n      <div className=\"p-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900\">\n        <form\n          onSubmit={(e) => {\n            e.preventDefault();\n            handleSendMessage();\n          }}\n          className=\"flex items-center gap-2\"\n        >\n          <VoiceInputControl\n            buttonSize=\"md\"\n            onTranscriptConfirmed={(confirmedText) => {\n              handleSendMessage(confirmedText);\n            }}\n            onFallbackToText={() => {\n              inputRef.current?.focus();\n            }}\n          />\n\n          <input\n            ref={inputRef}\n            type=\"text\"\n            value={inputText}\n            onChange={(e) => setInputText(e.target.value)}\n            placeholder={t.companion.inputPlaceholder}\n            disabled={isSending}\n            className=\"flex-1 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 font-medium disabled:opacity-50\"\n          />\n\n          <button\n            type=\"submit\"\n            disabled={!inputText.trim() || isSending}\n            className=\"px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-40 text-white font-semibold text-xs shadow-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center shrink-0\"\n          >\n            <Send className=\"w-4 h-4 rtl:rotate-180\" />\n          </button>\n        </form>\n      </div>\n\n      {showReconstructModal && (\n        <DayRecordFlowModal onClose={() => setShowReconstructModal(false)} />\n      )}\n\n      {isDailyReviewOpen && currentDailyReview && (\n        <DailyReviewModal\n          review={currentDailyReview}\n          onClose={closeDailyReview}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {/* PHASE 11: The Stage Modal */}\n      {showStage && (\n        <StageModal\n          lessonId=\"off_ar_u1_l2\"\n          onClose={() => setShowStage(false)}\n        />\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport { ChatMessage, AIConversation } from '../../types';\nimport { storageService } from '../../services/storage';\nimport { voiceService } from '../../services/voice/voiceService';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../../services/curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport { isEscalationTrigger, advanceTutorEscalation } from '../../services/tutor/tutorEngine';\nimport { Badge } from '../common/Badge';\nimport { DayRecordFlowModal } from '../dayRecord/DayRecordFlowModal';\nimport { DailyReviewModal } from '../home/DailyReviewModal';\nimport { StageModal } from '../stage/StageModal';\nimport { VoiceInputControl } from '../voice/VoiceInputControl';\nimport { VoiceSpeakButton } from '../voice/VoiceSpeakButton';\nimport { costLatencyService } from '../../services/telemetry/costLatencyService';\nimport {\n  Bot,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Sparkles,\n  AlertCircle,\n  CalendarCheck,\n  HelpCircle,\n  PlayCircle,\n  CheckCircle2,\n  Trash2,\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\nfunction isWhatShouldIDoIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ماذا') ||\n    s.includes('أعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('اعمل ايه') ||\n    s.includes('نعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('نعلم ايه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدأ بإيه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدا بايه') ||\n    s.includes('المطلوب مني') ||\n    s.includes('what should i do') ||\n    s.includes('what to do') ||\n    s.includes('what now') ||\n    s.includes('next task')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFinishedIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('خلصت') ||\n    s.includes('أنهيت') ||\n    s.includes('انهيت') ||\n    s.includes('تم الانتهاء') ||\n    s.includes('انتهيت') ||\n    s.includes('finished') ||\n    s.includes('i finished') ||\n    s.includes('done') ||\n    s.includes('completed')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isSkipIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تخطي') ||\n    s.includes('تخطى') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز دي') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز دي') ||\n    s.includes('تأجيل') ||\n    s.includes('skip') ||\n    s.includes('skip this') ||\n    s.includes('skip mission')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWrapUpIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص يومي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('إنهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('انهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('مراجعة اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up today') ||\n    s.includes('daily review') ||\n    s.includes('review my day')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWeeklyReviewIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الأسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الاسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('show my week') ||\n    s.includes('weekly review') ||\n    s.includes('my week')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFrustrationIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تعبت') ||\n    s.includes('زهقت') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادر') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادرة') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('صعب جدا') ||\n    s.includes('صعبة جدا') ||\n    s.includes('tired') ||\n    s.includes('exhausted') ||\n    s.includes('too hard') ||\n    s.includes('i want to stop') ||\n    s.includes('give up') ||\n    s.includes('frustrated')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isParentOverrideIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ليه وقت المذاكرة اتغير') ||\n    s.includes('ليه خطتي اتغيرت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه المهام قلت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('إشعار توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('اشعار توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('why parent') ||\n    s.includes('why was my study time changed') ||\n    s.includes('why did study time change') ||\n    s.includes('why did my plan change')\n  );\n}\n\nexport const CompanionChatScreen: React.FC = () => {\n  const {\n    t,\n    language,\n    student,\n    settings,\n    currentDayRecord,\n    missionsForToday,\n    activeMission,\n    startMission,\n    completeMission,\n    skipMission,\n    setActiveTab,\n    currentDailyReview,\n    isDailyReviewOpen,\n    openDailyReview,\n    closeDailyReview,\n    generateAndOpenWeeklyReview,\n    plannerExplanation,\n    recordEvidence,\n  } = useApp();\n  const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);\n  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');\n  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);\n  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [showReconstructModal, setShowReconstructModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showClearConfirmModal, setShowClearConfirmModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showStage, setShowStage] = useState(false);\n\n  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n\n  const studentName = student?.name || (isArabic ? 'صديقي' : 'Friend');\n\n  // Load existing conversation or initialize with introductory message\n  useEffect(() => {\n    async function loadChat() {\n      try {\n        const storedConv = student?.id ? await storageService.getConversation(student.id) : null;\n        if (storedConv && storedConv.messages.length > 0) {\n          setMessages(storedConv.messages);\n        } else {\n          // Welcome message directly adhering to the prompt rules\n          const initialGreeting: ChatMessage = {\n            id: 'msg_welcome_' + Date.now(),\n            role: 'assistant',\n            content: isArabic\n              ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا «الرفيق الدراسي الذكي». أنا نظام ذكاء اصطناعي للتعلم، لست معلماً بشرياً ولست هنا لتقييمك أو معاتبتك. وظيفتي هي تنظيم يومك الدراسي، ومساعدتك لفهم المواد بهدوء وبدون ضغط. كيف كان يومك أو ما الذي تود التحدث عنه؟`\n              : `Hello ${studentName}! I am your AI School Companion. I am an AI system, not a human teacher, and I am not here to judge or scold you. My purpose is to help structure your school day, untangle difficult topics, and ensure you study effectively without burnout. How is your day going?`,\n            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n          };\n          setMessages([initialGreeting]);\n          if (student?.id) {\n            const newConv: AIConversation = {\n              id: 'conv_' + student.id,\n              studentId: student.id,\n              messages: [initialGreeting],\n              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            };\n            await storageService.saveConversation(newConv);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.error('Failed to load conversation:', e);\n      }\n    }\n\n    loadChat();\n  }, [studentName, isArabic, student?.id]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n  }, [messages, isSending]);\n\n  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);\n\n  const handleSendMessage = async (textToSend?: string) => {\n    const content = (textToSend || inputText).trim();\n    if (!content || isSending) return;\n\n    setErrorMessage(null);\n    setInputText('');\n\n    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {\n      id: 'msg_u_' + Date.now(),\n      role: 'user',\n      content,\n      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n    };\n\n    const updatedHistory = [...messages, userMessage];\n    setMessages(updatedHistory);\n    setIsSending(true);\n\n    try {\n      let replyContent = '';\n\n      // 1. Check Mission Intent: \"What should I do now?\"\n      if (isWhatShouldIDoIntent(content)) {\n        const topPending =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending' || m.status === 'started');\n\n        if (topPending) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `المهمة المقترحة لك الآن بأعلى أولوية هي:\\n🎯 «${topPending.title}»\\n📚 المادة: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} دقيقة\\n💡 لماذا الآن؟ ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ المصدر: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nهل نتوكل على الله ونبدأها الآن؟`\n            : `Your highest priority mission right now is:\\n🎯 \"${topPending.title}\"\\n📚 Subject: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} min\\n💡 Why now? ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ Origin: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nReady to get started?`;\n        } else if (missionsForToday.length > 0 && missionsForToday.every((m) => m.status === 'completed')) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ما شاء الله عليك يا ${studentName}! 🌟 لقد أكملت جميع مهام اليوم بنجاح (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). استرح واستمتع بوقتك، لقد أنجزت يومك بامتياز!`\n            : `Fantastic job ${studentName}! 🌟 You completed all your daily missions (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). Take a restful break!`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهام مجدولة حالياً. يمكنك الانتقال إلى الشاشة الرئيسية وضبط وقت المذاكرة المتاح لنرتب لك مهام اليوم فوراً.`\n            : `No missions are planned yet. You can check the Home screen and adjust your available time to generate today's missions.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 2. Check Mission Intent: \"I finished\"\n      else if (isFinishedIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ممتاز يا بطلة! لتسجيل إتمام مهمة «${targetMission.title}» رسمياً في سجل إتقانك، تعالي نفتح تمرين المهمة السريع لنتأكد من تثبيت الفكرة ونمنحك نجوم الإنجاز! ⭐`\n            : `Great job! To record completion of \"${targetMission.title}\" in your mastery records, let's open the quick mission check to verify understanding and earn your stars! ⭐`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `رائع جداً! كل مهام اليوم مسجلة كمكتملة، ولا توجد مهمة قيد التنفيذ الآن.`\n            : `Great! All missions are already completed, no active mission pending right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 3. Check Mission Intent: \"Skip this\"\n      else if (isSkipIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          await skipMission(targetMission.id, 'Student skipped via companion chat');\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `تم تخطي مهمة «${targetMission.title}» بناءً على رغبتك.\\n\\n📌 الملاحظة والأثر الأكاديمي:\\nلا تقلق إطلاقاً يا ${studentName}! هذا ليس تقصيراً. سنقوم فقط بإعادة إدراج هذه المفاهيم في خطة قادمة بهدوء حتى لا تفوتك أساسيات المادة، وبدون أي إرهاق لوقتك اليوم.`\n            : `Mission \"${targetMission.title}\" has been skipped per your request.\\n\\n📌 Consequence & Note:\\nNo worries at all, ${studentName}! This is not a failure. We will simply reschedule these concepts in a future study session so you stay on track, keeping your schedule stress-free.`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهمة نشطة لتخطيها حالياً.`\n            : `There is no active mission to skip right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 4. Check Daily Review Intent: \"wrap up today\" / \"لخص يومي\"\n      else if (isWrapUpIntent(content)) {\n        const review = await openDailyReview();\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `حاضر يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد المراجعة اليومية الهادئة:\\n\\n✨ إنجاز اليوم: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 الخطوة القادمة: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nتم فتح نافذة المراجعة التفصيلية لتطّلع عليها بارتياح.`\n          : `Sure thing, ${studentName}! I have prepared your calm daily review:\\n\\n✨ Win Today: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 Next Step: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nYour Daily Review card has been opened for you.`;\n      }\n      // 4b. Check Weekly Review Intent: \"show my week\" / \"لخص أسبوعي\"\n      else if (isWeeklyReviewIntent(content)) {\n        const wkReview = await generateAndOpenWeeklyReview(true);\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `بكل سرور يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد ملخص أسبوعك الدراسي:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageAr}\\n\\n📊 إنجاز الواجبات: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}٪)\\n🎯 التركيز المقترح للأسبوع القادم: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleAr}\\n\\nتم فتح تبويب المراجعة لتتصفح كامل تفاصيل أسبوعك بهدوء.`\n          : `With pleasure, ${studentName}! I have prepared your weekly summary:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageEn}\\n\\n📊 Homework: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}%)\\n🎯 Recommended focus: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleEn}\\n\\nI have switched to the Review tab for you to see all the details!`;\n      }\n      // 5. Check AI Tutor Escalation Ladder (\"I don't understand\" / \"Explain differently\")\n      else if (isEscalationTrigger(content)) {\n        const targetConceptId =\n          activeMission?.conceptId ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.conceptId)?.conceptId ||\n          '';\n\n        if (!student?.id || !targetConceptId) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? 'أحتاج أولاً إلى تحديد الطالب والمفهوم الذي نعمل عليه. افتحي مهمة اليوم أو اختاري درساً من المنهج، ثم قولي لي «اشرحي بطريقة تانية».'\n            : 'I first need the active student and the concept we are working on. Open today’s mission or choose a curriculum lesson, then ask me to explain it differently.';\n        } else {\n          const tutorResponse = advanceTutorEscalation({\n          studentId: student?.id || '',\n          conceptId: targetConceptId,\n          sessionId: 'companion_session',\n          language,\n        });\n\n        const label = isArabic ? tutorResponse.modalityLabelAr : tutorResponse.modalityLabelEn;\n        const attemptLabel = isArabic\n          ? `(المحاولة ${tutorResponse.state.attemptCount} من ٥)`\n          : `(Attempt ${tutorResponse.state.attemptCount} of 5)`;\n\n        replyContent = `[${label} ${attemptLabel}]\\n\\n${tutorResponse.text}`;\n\n        if (tutorResponse.checkQuestion) {\n          const q = tutorResponse.checkQuestion;\n          replyContent += isArabic\n            ? `\\n\\n❓ سؤال فحص فهم تشجيعي:\\n${q.question}\\n• الخيارات: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`\n            : `\\n\\n❓ Comprehension Check Question:\\n${q.question}\\n• Options: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`;\n        }\n\n        if (tutorResponse.modality === 'flag_for_review') {\n          replyContent += isArabic\n            ? `\\n\\n📌 ملحوظة: تم وسم المفهوم لخانة (المراجعة اللاحقة) لحمايتك من الإرهاق. ما رأيك أن ننتقل لنشاط آخر خفيف؟`\n            : `\\n\\n📌 Note: Concept marked for (Later Review) to prevent fatigue. Would you like to move on to a lighter activity?`;\n        }\n        }\n      }\n      // 6. Check Student Frustration / Disengagement (Failure mode 1g)\n      // \"Signal detected (session drop, skip streak, tone) -> Companion offers a break or lighter load -> No guilt\"\n      else if (isFrustrationIntent(content)) {\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سلامتك يا ${studentName}! لما تحس بالتعب أو الزهق، أحسن قرار هو إنك تاخد راحة (10 إلى 15 دقيقة) وتفصل خالص. راحتك وصحتك أهم من أي مذاكرة.\\n\\n✨ تحب نخفف خطة اليوم ونكتفي بما أنجزته، ولا نوقف خالص دلوقتي وتستريح؟ مفيش أي مشكلة إطلاقاً، والأيام جاية!`\n          : `Take a deep breath and a gentle pause, ${studentName}! When fatigue or frustration hits, taking a 10-15 minute screen break is the best move. Your well-being comes first.\\n\\n✨ Would you like to lighten today's missions or call it a day? Zero guilt either way!`;\n      }\n      // 6b. Check Parent Override Intent (Failure mode 1h: Student asks why)\n      else if (isParentOverrideIntent(content)) {\n        const msg = plannerExplanation?.parentOverrideMessage;\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سؤال في محله يا ${studentName}! تم ضبط خطة المذاكرة اليوم لتراعي توجيه ولي أمرك:\\n\\n🛡️ «${msg || 'تم وضع حد زمني مناسب أو موعد نوم هادئ'}»\\n\\nالهدف مش تقليل قدراتك، بل حمايتك من السهر والإرهاق عشان تستمتع بيومك وتصحى بكامل نشاطك. وظيفتي أساعدك تنجز الأساسيات في هذا الوقت بدون أي ضغط!`\n          : `Great question, ${studentName}! className=\"w-4 h-4 rtl:rotate-180\" />\n          </button>\n        </form>\n      </div>\n\n      {showReconstructModal && (\n        <DayRecordFlowModal onClose={() => onClose={closeDailyReview}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {/* PHASE 11: The Stage Modal */}\n      {showStage && (\n        <StageModal\n          lessonId=\"off_ar_u1_l2\"\n          onClose={() => setShowStage(false)}\n        />\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../home/DailyReviewModal';\nimport { StageModal } from '../stage/StageModal';\nimport { VoiceInputControl } from '../voice/VoiceInputControl';\nimport { VoiceSpeakButton } from HelpCircle,\n  PlayCircle,\n  CheckCircle2,\n  Trash2,\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\nfunction isWhatShouldIDoIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ماذا') ||\n    s.includes('أعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('اعمل ايه') ||\n    s.includes('نعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('نعلم ايه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدأ بإيه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدا بايه') ||\n    s.includes('المطلوب مني') ||\n    s.includes('what should i do') ||\n    s.includes('what to do') ||\n    s.includes('what now') ||\n    s.includes('next task')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFinishedIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('خلصت') ||\n    s.includes('أنهيت') ||\n    s.includes('انهيت') ||\n    s.includes('تم الانتهاء') ||\n    s.includes('انتهيت') ||\n    s.includes('finished') ||\n    s.includes('i finished') ||\n    s.includes('done') ||\n    s.includes('completed')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isSkipIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تخطي') ||\n    s.includes('تخطى') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز دي') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز دي') ||\n    s.includes('تأجيل') ||\n    s.includes('skip') ||\n    s.includes('skip this') ||\n    s.includes('skip mission')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWrapUpIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص يومي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('إنهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('انهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('مراجعة اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up today') ||\n    s.includes('daily review') ||\n    s.includes('review my day')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWeeklyReviewIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الأسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الاسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('show my week') ||\n    s.includes('weekly review') ||\n    s.includes('my week')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFrustrationIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تعبت') ||\n    s.includes('زهقت') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادر') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادرة') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('صعب جدا') ||\n    s.includes('صعبة جدا') ||\n    s.includes('tired') ||\n    s.includes('exhausted') ||\n    s.includes('too hard') ||\n    s.includes('i want to stop') ||\n    s.includes('give up') ||\n    s.includes('frustrated')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isParentOverrideIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ليه وقت المذاكرة اتغير') ||\n    s.includes('ليه خطتي اتغيرت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه المهام قلت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('إشعار توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('اشعار توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('why parent') ||\n    s.includes('why was my study time changed') ||\n    s.includes('why did study time change') ||\n    s.includes('why did my plan change')\n  );\n}\n\nexport const CompanionChatScreen: React.FC = () => {\n  const {\n    t,\n    language,\n    student,\n    settings,\n    currentDayRecord,\n    missionsForToday,\n    activeMission,\n    startMission,\n    completeMission,\n    skipMission,\n    setActiveTab,\n    currentDailyReview,\n    isDailyReviewOpen,\n    openDailyReview,\n    closeDailyReview,\n    generateAndOpenWeeklyReview,\n    plannerExplanation,\n    recordEvidence,\n  } = useApp();\n  const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);\n  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');\n  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);\n  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [showReconstructModal, setShowReconstructModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showClearConfirmModal, setShowClearConfirmModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showStage, setShowStage] = useState(false);\n\n  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n  const flaggedRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());\n\n  const studentName = student?.name || (isArabic ? 'صديقي' : 'Friend');\n\n  // Load existing conversation or initialize with introductory message\n  useEffect(() => {\n    async function loadChat() {\n      try {\n        const storedConv = student?.id ? await storageService.getConversation(student.id) : null;\n        if (storedConv && storedConv.messages.length > 0) {\n          setMessages(storedConv.messages);\n        } else {\n          // Welcome message directly adhering to the prompt rules\n          const initialGreeting: ChatMessage = {\n            id: 'msg_welcome_' + Date.now(),\n            role: 'assistant',\n            content: isArabic\n              ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا «الرفيق الدراسي الذكي». أنا نظام ذكاء اصطناعي للتعلم، لست معلماً بشرياً ولست هنا لتقييمك أو معاتبتك. وظيفتي هي تنظيم يومك الدراسي، ومساعدتك لفهم المواد بهدوء وبدون ضغط. كيف كان يومك أو ما الذي تود التحدث عنه؟`\n              : `Hello ${studentName}! I am your AI School Companion. I am an AI system, not a human teacher, and I am not here to judge or scold you. My purpose is to help structure your school day, untangle difficult topics, and ensure you study effectively without burnout. How is your day going?`,\n            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n          };\n          setMessages([initialGreeting]);\n          if (student?.id) {\n            const newConv: AIConversation = {\n              id: 'conv_' + student.id,\n              studentId: student.id,\n              messages: [initialGreeting],\n              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            };\n            await storageService.saveConversation(newConv);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.error('Failed to load conversation:', e);\n      }\n    }\n\n    loadChat();\n  }, [studentName, isArabic, student?.id]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n  }, [messages, isSending]);\n\n  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);\n\n  const handleSendMessage = async (textToSend?: string) => {\n    const content = (textToSend || inputText).trim();\n    if (!content || isSending) return;\n\n    setErrorMessage(null);\n    setInputText('');\n\n    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {\n      id: 'msg_u_' + Date.now(),\n      role: 'user',\n      content,\n      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n    };\n\n    const updatedHistory = [...messages, userMessage];\n    setMessages(updatedHistory);\n    setIsSending(true);\n\n    try {\n      let replyContent = '';\n\n      // 1. Check Mission Intent: \"What should I do now?\"\n      if (isWhatShouldIDoIntent(content)) {\n        const topPending =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending' || m.status === 'started');\n\n        if (topPending) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `المهمة المقترحة لك الآن بأعلى أولوية هي:\\n🎯 «${topPending.title}»\\n📚 المادة: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} دقيقة\\n💡 لماذا الآن؟ ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ المصدر: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nهل نتوكل على الله ونبدأها الآن؟`\n            : `Your highest priority mission right now is:\\n🎯 \"${topPending.title}\"\\n📚 Subject: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} min\\n💡 Why now? ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ Origin: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nReady to get started?`;\n        } else if (missionsForToday.length > 0 && missionsForToday.every((m) => m.status === 'completed')) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ما شاء الله عليك يا ${studentName}! 🌟 لقد أكملت جميع مهام اليوم بنجاح (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). استرح واستمتع بوقتك، لقد أنجزت يومك بامتياز!`\n            : `Fantastic job ${studentName}! 🌟 You completed all your daily missions (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). Take a restful break!`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهام مجدولة حالياً. يمكنك الانتقال إلى الشاشة الرئيسية وضبط وقت المذاكرة المتاح لنرتب لك مهام اليوم فوراً.`\n            : `No missions are planned yet. You can check the Home screen and adjust your available time to generate today's missions.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 2. Check Mission Intent: \"I finished\"\n      else if (isFinishedIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ممتاز يا بطلة! لتسجيل إتمام مهمة «${targetMission.title}» رسمياً في سجل إتقانك، تعالي نفتح تمرين المهمة السريع لنتأكد من تثبيت الفكرة ونمنحك نجوم الإنجاز! ⭐`\n            : `Great job! To record completion of \"${targetMission.title}\" in your mastery records, let's open the quick mission check to verify understanding and earn your stars! ⭐`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `رائع جداً! كل مهام اليوم مسجلة كمكتملة، ولا توجد مهمة قيد التنفيذ الآن.`\n            : `Great! All missions are already completed, no active mission pending right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 3. Check Mission Intent: \"Skip this\"\n      else if (isSkipIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          await skipMission(targetMission.id, 'Student skipped via companion chat');\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `تم تخطي مهمة «${targetMission.title}» بناءً على رغبتك.\\n\\n📌 الملاحظة والأثر الأكاديمي:\\nلا تقلق إطلاقاً يا ${studentName}! هذا ليس تقصيراً. سنقوم فقط بإعادة إدراج هذه المفاهيم في خطة قادمة بهدوء حتى لا تفوتك أساسيات المادة، وبدون أي إرهاق لوقتك اليوم.`\n            : `Mission \"${targetMission.title}\" has been skipped per your request.\\n\\n📌 Consequence & Note:\\nNo worries at all, ${studentName}! This is not a failure. We will simply reschedule these concepts in a future study session so you stay on track, keeping your schedule stress-free.`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهمة نشطة لتخطيها حالياً.`\n            : `There is no active mission to skip right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 4. Check Daily Review Intent: \"wrap up today\" / \"لخص يومي\"\n      else if (isWrapUpIntent(content)) {\n        const review = await openDailyReview();\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `حاضر يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد المراجعة اليومية الهادئة:\\n\\n✨ إنجاز اليوم: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 الخطوة القادمة: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nتم فتح نافذة المراجعة التفصيلية لتطّلع عليها بارتياح.`\n          : `Sure thing, ${studentName}! I have prepared your calm daily review:\\n\\n✨ Win Today: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 Next Step: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nYour Daily Review card has been opened for you.`;\n      }\n      // 4b. Check Weekly Review Intent: \"show my week\" / \"لخص أسبوعي\"\n      else if (isWeeklyReviewIntent(content)) {\n        const wkReview = await generateAndOpenWeeklyReview(true);\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `بكل سرور يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد ملخص أسبوعك الدراسي:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageAr}\\n\\n📊 إنجاز الواجبات: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}٪)\\n🎯 التركيز المقترح للأسبوع القادم: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleAr}\\n\\nتم فتح تبويب المراجعة لتتصفح كامل تفاصيل أسبوعك بهدوء.`\n          : `With pleasure, ${studentName}! I have prepared your weekly summary:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageEn}\\n\\n📊 Homework: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}%)\\n🎯 Recommended focus: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleEn}\\n\\nI have switched to the Review tab for you to see all the details!`;\n      }\n      // 5. Check AI Tutor Escalation Ladder (\"I don't understand\" / \"Explain differently\")\n      else if (isEscalationTrigger(content)) {\n        const targetConceptId =\n          activeMission?.conceptId ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.conceptId)?.conceptId ||\n          '';\n\n        if (!student?.id || !targetConceptId) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? 'أحتاج أولاً إلى تحديد الطالب والمفهوم الذي نعمل عليه. افتحي مهمة اليوم أو اختاري درساً من المنهج، ثم قولي لي «اشرحي بطريقة تانية».'\n            : 'I first need the active student and the concept we are working on. Open today’s mission or choose a curriculum lesson, then ask me to explain it differently.';\n        } else {\n          const tutorResponse = advanceTutorEscalation({\n          studentId: student?.id || '',\n          conceptId: targetConceptId,\n          sessionId: 'companion_session',\n          language,\n        });\n\n        const label = isArabic ? tutorResponse.modalityLabelAr : tutorResponse.modalityLabelEn;\n        const attemptLabel = isArabic\n          ? `(المحاولة ${tutorResponse.state.attemptCount} من ٥)`\n          : `(Attempt ${tutorResponse.state.attemptCount} of 5)`;\n\n        replyContent = `[${label} ${attemptLabel}]\\n\\n${tutorResponse.text}`;\n\n        if (tutorResponse.checkQuestion) {\n          const q = tutorResponse.checkQuestion;\n          replyContent += isArabic\n            ? `\\n\\n❓ سؤال فحص فهم تشجيعي:\\n${q.question}\\n• الخيارات: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`\n            : `\\n\\n❓ Comprehension Check Question:\\n${q.question}\\n• Options: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`;\n        }\n\n        if (tutorResponse.modality === 'flag_for_review') {\n          replyContent += isArabic\n            ? `\\n\\n📌 ملحوظة: تم وسم المفهوم لخانة (المراجعة اللاحقة) لحمايتك من الإرهاق. ما رأيك أن ننتقل لنشاط آخر خفيف؟`\n            : `\\n\\n📌 Note: Concept marked for (Later Review) to prevent fatigue. Would you like to move on to a lighter activity?`;\n        }\n        }\n      }\n      // 6. Check Student Frustration / Disengagement (Failure mode 1g)\n      // \"Signal detected (session drop, skip streak, tone) -> Companion offers a break or lighter load -> No guilt\"\n      else if (isFrustrationIntent(content)) {\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سلامتك يا ${studentName}! لما تحس بالتعب أو الزهق، أحسن قرار هو إنك تاخد راحة (10 إلى 15 دقيقة) وتفصل خالص. راحتك وصحتك أهم من أي مذاكرة.\\n\\n✨ تحب نخفف خطة اليوم ونكتفي بما أنجزته، ولا نوقف خالص دلوقتي وتستريح؟ مفيش أي مشكلة إطلاقاً، والأيام جاية!`\n          : `Take a deep breath and a gentle pause, ${studentName}! When fatigue or frustration hits, taking a 10-15 minute screen break is the best move. Your well-being comes first.\\n\\n✨ Would you like to lighten today's missions or call it a day? Zero guilt either way!`;\n      }\n      // 6b. Check Parent Override Intent (Failure mode 1h: Student asks why)\n      else if (isParentOverrideIntent(content)) {\n        const msg = plannerExplanation?.parentOverrideMessage;\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سؤال في محله يا ${studentName}! تم ضبط خطة المذاكرة اليوم لتراعي توجيه ولي أمرك:\\n\\n🛡️ «${msg || 'تم وضع حد زمني مناسب أو موعد نوم هادئ'}»\\n\\nالهدف مش تقليل قدراتك، بل حمايتك من السهر والإرهاق عشان تستمتع بيومك وتصحى بكامل نشاطك. وظيفتي أساعدك تنجز الأساسيات في هذا الوقت بدون أي ضغط!`\n          : `Great question, ${studentName}! Your study plan was adapted to respect your parent's settings:\\n\\n🛡️ \"${msg || 'Daily study limit or bedtime set by parent'}\"\\n\\nThis isn't a restriction, but a healthy safeguard against fatigue and late nights so you can rest. I'm here to ensure you get the most out of your focused study time comfortably!`;\n      }\n      // 7. General Chat via server proxy with 15s timeout & telemetry\n      else {\n        const { data } = await costLatencyService.instrumentedFetch(\n          '/api/chat',\n          {\n            messages: updatedHistory.slice(-8).map((m) => ({\n              role: m.role,\n              content: m.content,\n            })),\n            studentName,\n            grade: student?.grade || 'Grade 5',\n            language,\n            schoolBrainContext: {\n              studentId: student?.id,\n              school: student?.school,\n              location: student?.location,\n              curriculumTrack: student?.curriculumTrack,\n              dayRecord: currentDayRecord\n                ? {\n                    date: currentDayRecord.date,\n                    confirmed: currentDayRecord.confirmed,\n                    lessons: currentDayRecord.lessonsCovered,\n                    homework: currentDayRecord.homeworkAssigned.map((h) => ({\n                      subject: h.subject,\n                      description: h.description,\n                      status: h.status,\n                    })),\n                    notes: currentDayRecord.notes,\n                  }\n                : null,\n              activeMission: activeMission\n                ? {\n                    id: activeMission.id,\n                    subject: activeMission.subject,\n                    lessonId: activeMission.lessonId,\n                    conceptId: activeMission.conceptId,\n                    title: activeMission.title,\n                    status: activeMission.status,\n                    whyNow: activeMission.whyNow,\n                  }\n                : null,\n            },\n          },\n          {\n            studentId: student?.id,\n            language: isArabic ? 'ar' : 'en',\n            timeoutMs: 15000,\n          }\n        );\n\n        replyContent =\n          data.reply ||\n          (isArabic ? 'أنا معاك، نقدر نكمل!' : \"I'm with you, let's continue!\");\n      }\n\n      const assistantMessage: ChatMessage = {\n        id: 'msg_a_' + Date.now(),\n        role: 'assistant',\n        content: replyContent,\n        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n      };\n\n      const finalMessages = [...updatedHistory, assistantMessage];\n      setMessages(finalMessages);\n\n      // Auto-voice if enabled in settings\n      if (settings?.companionVoiceEnabled) {\n        voiceService.speak(replyContent, language);\n      }\n\n      // Persist to storage\n      if (student?.id) {\n        await storageService.saveConversation({\n          id: 'conv_' + student.id,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          messages: finalMessages,\n          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      console.error('Chat error:', err);\n      const assistantFallback: ChatMessage = {\n        id: 'msg_fallback_' + Date.now(),\n        role: 'assistant',\n        content: isArabic\n          ? 'مش قادرة أوصل للمساعد دلوقتي. جرّبي كمان شوية، وممكن نكمل بالمهام من الصفحة الرئيسية.'\n          : \"I can't reach the assistant right now. Try again in a moment; you can keep going with your missions from Home.\",\n        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n      };\n      const finalMessages = [...updatedHistory, assistantFallback];\n      setMessages(finalMessages);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSending(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleClearChat = async () => {\n    if (!confirm(isArabic ?  "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from
