HelpCircle,\n  PlayCircle,\n  CheckCircle2,\n  Trash2,\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\nfunction isWhatShouldIDoIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ماذا') ||\n    s.includes('أعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('اعمل ايه') ||\n    s.includes('نعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('نعلم ايه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدأ بإيه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدا بايه') ||\n    s.includes('المطلوب مني') ||\n    s.includes('what should i do') ||\n    s.includes('what to do') ||\n    s.includes('what now') ||\n    s.includes('next task')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFinishedIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('خلصت') ||\n    s.includes('أنهيت') ||\n    s.includes('انهيت') ||\n    s.includes('تم الانتهاء') ||\n    s.includes('انتهيت') ||\n    s.includes('finished') ||\n    s.includes('i finished') ||\n    s.includes('done') ||\n    s.includes('completed')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isSkipIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تخطي') ||\n    s.includes('تخطى') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز دي') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز دي') ||\n    s.includes('تأجيل') ||\n    s.includes('skip') ||\n    s.includes('skip this') ||\n    s.includes('skip mission')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWrapUpIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص يومي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('إنهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('انهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('مراجعة اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up today') ||\n    s.includes('daily review') ||\n    s.includes('review my day')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWeeklyReviewIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الأسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الاسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('show my week') ||\n    s.includes('weekly review') ||\n    s.includes('my week')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFrustrationIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تعبت') ||\n    s.includes('زهقت') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادر') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادرة') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('صعب جدا') ||\n    s.includes('صعبة جدا') ||\n    s.includes('tired') ||\n    s.includes('exhausted') ||\n    s.includes('too hard') ||\n    s.includes('i want to stop') ||\n    s.includes('give up') ||\n    s.includes('frustrated')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isParentOverrideIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ليه وقت المذاكرة اتغير') ||\n    s.includes('ليه خطتي اتغيرت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه المهام قلت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('إشعار توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('اشعار توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('why parent') ||\n    s.includes('why was my study time changed') ||\n    s.includes('why did study time change') ||\n    s.includes('why did my plan change')\n  );\n}\n\nexport const CompanionChatScreen: React.FC = () => {\n  const {\n    t,\n    language,\n    student,\n    settings,\n    currentDayRecord,\n    missionsForToday,\n    activeMission,\n    startMission,\n    completeMission,\n    skipMission,\n    setActiveTab,\n    currentDailyReview,\n    isDailyReviewOpen,\n    openDailyReview,\n    closeDailyReview,\n    generateAndOpenWeeklyReview,\n    plannerExplanation,\n    recordEvidence,\n  } = useApp();\n  const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);\n  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');\n  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);\n  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [showReconstructModal, setShowReconstructModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showClearConfirmModal, setShowClearConfirmModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showStage, setShowStage] = useState(false);\n\n  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n  const flaggedRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());\n\n  const studentName = student?.name || (isArabic ? 'صديقي' : 'Friend');\n\n  // Load existing conversation or initialize with introductory message\n  useEffect(() => {\n    async function loadChat() {\n      try {\n        const storedConv = student?.id ? await storageService.getConversation(student.id) : null;\n        if (storedConv && storedConv.messages.length > 0) {\n          setMessages(storedConv.messages);\n        } else {\n          // Welcome message directly adhering to the prompt rules\n          const initialGreeting: ChatMessage = {\n            id: 'msg_welcome_' + Date.now(),\n            role: 'assistant',\n            content: isArabic\n              ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا «الرفيق الدراسي الذكي». أنا نظام ذكاء اصطناعي للتعلم، لست معلماً بشرياً ولست هنا لتقييمك أو معاتبتك. وظيفتي هي تنظيم يومك الدراسي، ومساعدتك لفهم المواد بهدوء وبدون ضغط. كيف كان يومك أو ما الذي تود التحدث عنه؟`\n              : `Hello ${studentName}! I am your AI School Companion. I am an AI system, not a human teacher, and I am not here to judge or scold you. My purpose is to help structure your school day, untangle difficult topics, and ensure you study effectively without burnout. How is your day going?`,\n            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n          };\n          setMessages([initialGreeting]);\n          if (student?.id) {\n            const newConv: AIConversation = {\n              id: 'conv_' + student.id,\n              studentId: student.id,\n              messages: [initialGreeting],\n              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            };\n            await storageService.saveConversation(newConv);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.error('Failed to load conversation:', e);\n      }\n    }\n\n    loadChat();\n  }, [studentName, isArabic, student?.id]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n  }, [messages, isSending]);\n\n  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);\n\n  const handleSendMessage = async (textToSend?: string) => {\n    const content = (textToSend || inputText).trim();\n    if (!content || isSending) return;\n\n    setErrorMessage(null);\n    setInputText('');\n\n    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {\n      id: 'msg_u_' + Date.now(),\n      role: 'user',\n      content,\n      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n    };\n\n    const updatedHistory = [...messages, userMessage];\n    setMessages(updatedHistory);\n    setIsSending(true);\n\n    try {\n      let replyContent = '';\n\n      // 1. Check Mission Intent: \"What should I do now?\"\n      if (isWhatShouldIDoIntent(content)) {\n        const topPending =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending' || m.status === 'started');\n\n        if (topPending) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `المهمة المقترحة لك الآن بأعلى أولوية هي:\\n🎯 «${topPending.title}»\\n📚 المادة: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} دقيقة\\n💡 لماذا الآن؟ ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ المصدر: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nهل نتوكل على الله ونبدأها الآن؟`\n            : `Your highest priority mission right now is:\\n🎯 \"${topPending.title}\"\\n📚 Subject: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} min\\n💡 Why now? ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ Origin: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nReady to get started?`;\n        } else if (missionsForToday.length > 0 && missionsForToday.every((m) => m.status === 'completed')) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ما شاء الله عليك يا ${studentName}! 🌟 لقد أكملت جميع مهام اليوم بنجاح (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). استرح واستمتع بوقتك، لقد أنجزت يومك بامتياز!`\n            : `Fantastic job ${studentName}! 🌟 You completed all your daily missions (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). Take a restful break!`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهام مجدولة حالياً. يمكنك الانتقال إلى الشاشة الرئيسية وضبط وقت المذاكرة المتاح لنرتب لك مهام اليوم فوراً.`\n            : `No missions are planned yet. You can check the Home screen and adjust your available time to generate today's missions.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 2. Check Mission Intent: \"I finished\"\n      else if (isFinishedIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ممتاز يا بطلة! لتسجيل إتمام مهمة «${targetMission.title}» رسمياً في سجل إتقانك، تعالي نفتح تمرين المهمة السريع لنتأكد من تثبيت الفكرة ونمنحك نجوم الإنجاز! ⭐`\n            : `Great job! To record completion of \"${targetMission.title}\" in your mastery records, let's open the quick mission check to verify understanding and earn your stars! ⭐`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `رائع جداً! كل مهام اليوم مسجلة كمكتملة، ولا توجد مهمة قيد التنفيذ الآن.`\n            : `Great! All missions are already completed, no active mission pending right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 3. Check Mission Intent: \"Skip this\"\n      else if (isSkipIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          await skipMission(targetMission.id, 'Student skipped via companion chat');\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `تم تخطي مهمة «${targetMission.title}» بناءً على رغبتك.\\n\\n📌 الملاحظة والأثر الأكاديمي:\\nلا تقلق إطلاقاً يا ${studentName}! هذا ليس تقصيراً. سنقوم فقط بإعادة إدراج هذه المفاهيم في خطة قادمة بهدوء حتى لا تفوتك أساسيات المادة، وبدون أي إرهاق لوقتك اليوم.`\n            : `Mission \"${targetMission.title}\" has been skipped per your request.\\n\\n📌 Consequence & Note:\\nNo worries at all, ${studentName}! This is not a failure. We will simply reschedule these concepts in a future study session so you stay on track, keeping your schedule stress-free.`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهمة نشطة لتخطيها حالياً.`\n            : `There is no active mission to skip right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 4. Check Daily Review Intent: \"wrap up today\" / \"لخص يومي\"\n      else if (isWrapUpIntent(content)) {\n        const review = await openDailyReview();\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `حاضر يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد المراجعة اليومية الهادئة:\\n\\n✨ إنجاز اليوم: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 الخطوة القادمة: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nتم فتح نافذة المراجعة التفصيلية لتطّلع عليها بارتياح.`\n          : `Sure thing, ${studentName}! I have prepared your calm daily review:\\n\\n✨ Win Today: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 Next Step: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nYour Daily Review card has been opened for you.`;\n      }\n      // 4b. Check Weekly Review Intent: \"show my week\" / \"لخص أسبوعي\"\n      else if (isWeeklyReviewIntent(content)) {\n        const wkReview = await generateAndOpenWeeklyReview(true);\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `بكل سرور يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد ملخص أسبوعك الدراسي:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageAr}\\n\\n📊 إنجاز الواجبات: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}٪)\\n🎯 التركيز المقترح للأسبوع القادم: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleAr}\\n\\nتم فتح تبويب المراجعة لتتصفح كامل تفاصيل أسبوعك بهدوء.`\n          : `With pleasure, ${studentName}! I have prepared your weekly summary:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageEn}\\n\\n📊 Homework: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}%)\\n🎯 Recommended focus: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleEn}\\n\\nI have switched to the Review tab for you to see all the details!`;\n      }\n      // 5. Check AI Tutor Escalation Ladder (\"I don't understand\" / \"Explain differently\")\n      else if (isEscalationTrigger(content)) {\n        const targetConceptId =\n          activeMission?.conceptId ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.conceptId)?.conceptId ||\n          '';\n\n        if (!student?.id || !targetConceptId) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? 'أحتاج أولاً إلى تحديد الطالب والمفهوم الذي نعمل عليه. افتحي مهمة اليوم أو اختاري درساً من المنهج، ثم قولي لي «اشرحي بطريقة تانية».'\n            : 'I first need the active student and the concept we are working on. Open today’s mission or choose a curriculum lesson, then ask me to explain it differently.';\n        } else {\n          const tutorResponse = advanceTutorEscalation({\n          studentId: student?.id || '',\n          conceptId: targetConceptId,\n          sessionId: 'companion_session',\n          language,\n        });\n\n        const label = isArabic ? tutorResponse.modalityLabelAr : tutorResponse.modalityLabelEn;\n        const attemptLabel = isArabic\n          ? `(المحاولة ${Math.min(tutorResponse.state.attemptCount, 5)} من ٥)`\n          : `(Attempt ${Math.min(tutorResponse.state.attemptCount, 5)} of 5)`;\n\n        replyContent = `[${label} ${attemptLabel}]\\n\\n${tutorResponse.text}`;\n\n        if (tutorResponse.checkQuestion) {\n          const q = tutorResponse.checkQuestion;\n          replyContent += isArabic\n            ? `\\n\\n❓ سؤال فحص فهم تشجيعي:\\n${q.question}\\n• الخيارات: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`\n            : `\\n\\n❓ Comprehension Check Question:\\n${q.question}\\n• Options: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`;\n        }\n\n        if (tutorResponse.modality === 'flag_for_review') {\n          replyContent += isArabic\n            ? `\\n\\n📌 ملحوظة: تم وسم المفهوم لخانة (المراجعة اللاحقة) لحمايتك من الإرهاق. ما رأيك أن ننتقل لنشاط آخر خفيف؟`\n            : `\\n\\n📌 Note: Concept marked for (Later Review) to prevent fatigue. Would you like to move on to a lighter activity?`;\n        }\n        }\n      }\n      // 6. Check Student Frustration / Disengagement (Failure mode 1g)\n      // \"Signal detected (session drop, skip streak, tone) -> Companion offers a break or lighter load -> No guilt\"\n      else if (isFrustrationIntent(content)) {\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سلامتك يا ${studentName}! لما تحس بالتعب أو الزهق، أحسن قرار هو إنك تاخد راحة (10 إلى 15 دقيقة) وتفصل خالص. راحتك وصحتك أهم من أي مذاكرة.\\n\\n✨ تحب نخفف خطة اليوم ونكتفي بما أنجزته، ولا نوقف خالص دلوقتي وتستريح؟ مفيش أي مشكلة إطلاقاً، والأيام جاية!`\n          : `Take a deep breath and a gentle pause, ${studentName}! When fatigue or frustration hits, taking a 10-15 minute screen break is the best move. Your well-being comes first.\\n\\n✨ Would you like to lighten today's missions or call it a day? Zero guilt either way!`;\n      }\n      // 6b. Check Parent Override Intent (Failure mode 1h: Student asks why)\n      else if (isParentOverrideIntent(content)) {\n        const msg = plannerExplanation?.parentOverrideMessage;\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سؤال في محله يا ${studentName}! تم ضبط خطة المذاكرة اليوم لتراعي توجيه ولي أمرك:\\n\\n🛡️ «${msg || 'تم وضع حد زمني مناسب أو موعد نوم هادئ'}»\\n\\nالهدف مش تقليل قدراتك، بل حمايتك من السهر والإرهاق عشان تستمتع بيومك وتصحى بكامل نشاطك. وظيفتي أساعدك تنجز الأساسيات في هذا الوقت بدون أي ضغط!`\n          : `Great question, ${studentName}! Your study plan was adapted to respect your parent's settings:\\n\\n🛡️ \"${msg || 'Daily study limit or bedtime set by parent'}\"\\n\\nThis isn't a restriction, but a healthy safeguard against fatigue and late nights so you can rest. I'm here to ensure you get the most out of your focused study time comfortably!`;\n      }\n      // 7. General Chat via server proxy with 15s timeout & telemetry\n      else {\n        const { data } = await costLatencyService.instrumentedFetch(\n          '/api/chat',\n          {\n            messages: updatedHistory.slice(-8).map((m) => ({\n              role: m.role,\n              content: m.content,\n            })),\n            studentName,\n            grade: student?.grade || 'Grade 5',\n            language,\n            schoolBrainContext: {\n              studentId: student?.id,\n              school: student?.school,\n              location: student?.location,\n              curriculumTrack: student?.curriculumTrack,\n              dayRecord: currentDayRecord\n                ? {\n                    date: currentDayRecord.date,\n                    confirmed: currentDayRecord.confirmed,\n                    lessons: currentDayRecord.lessonsCovered,\n                    homework: currentDayRecord.homeworkAssigned.map((h) => ({\n                      subject: h.subject,\n                      description: h.description,\n                      status: h.status,\n                    })),\n                    notes: currentDayRecord.notes,\n                  }\n                : null,\n              activeMission: activeMission\n                ? {\n                    id: activeMission.id,\n                    subject: activeMission.subject,\n                    lessonId: activeMission.lessonId,\n                    conceptId: activeMission.conceptId,\n                    title: activeMission.title,\n                    status: activeMission.status,\n                    whyNow: activeMission.whyNow,\n                  }\n                : null,\n            },\n          },\n          {\n            studentId: student?.id,\n            language: isArabic ? 'ar' : 'en',\n            timeoutMs: 15000,\n          }\n        );\n\n        replyContent =\n          data.reply ||\n          (isArabic ? 'أنا معاك، نقدر نكمل!' : \"I'm with you, let's continue!\");\n      }\n\n      const assistantMessage: ChatMessage = {\n        id: 'msg_a_' + Date.now(),\n        role: 'assistant',\n        content: replyContent,\n        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n      };\n\n      const finalMessages = [...updatedHistory, assistantMessage];\n      setMessages(finalMessages);\n\n      // Auto-voice if enabled in settings\n      if (settings?.companionVoiceEnabled) {\n        voiceService.speak(replyContent, language);\n      }\n\n      // Persist to storage\n      if (student?.id) {\n        await storageService.saveConversation({\n          id: 'conv_' + student.id,\n          studentId: student.id,\n          messages: finalMessages,\n          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      console.error('Chat error:', err);\n      const assistantFallback: ChatMessage = {\n        id: 'msg_fallback_' + Date.now(),\n        role: 'assistant',\n        content: isArabic\n          ? 'مش قادرة أوصل للمساعد دلوقتي. جرّبي كمان شوية، وممكن نكمل بالمهام من الصفحة الرئيسية.'\n          : \"I can't reach the assistant right now. Try again in a moment; you can keep going with your missions from Home.\",\n        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n      };\n      const finalMessages = [...updatedHistory, assistantFallback];\n      setMessages(finalMessages);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSending(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleClearChat = async () => {\n    if (!confirm(isArabic ? 'هل تريد مسح سجل المحادثة بالكامل؟' : 'Clear entire conversation transcript?')) return;\n    const initialGreeting: ChatMessage = {\n      id: 'msg_welcome_' + Date.now(),\n      role: 'assistant',\n      content: isArabic\n        ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! تم مسح سجل المحادثة السابق. أنا رفيقك التعليمي، هنا لمساعدتك في أي وقت بهدوء وبدون أي ضغط.`\n        : `Hello ${studentName}! font-medium disabled:opacity-50\"\n          />\n\n          <button\n            type=\"submit\"\n            disabled={!inputText.trim() || isSending}\n            className=\"px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-40 text-white font-semibold text-xs shadow-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center shrink-0\"\n          >\n            <Send className=\"w-4 h-4 rtl:rotate-180\" />\n          </button>\n        </form>\n      </div>\n\n      {showReconstructModal && (\n        <DayRecordFlowModal onClose={() => setShowReconstructModal(false)} />\n      )}\n\n      {isDailyReviewOpen && currentDailyReview && (\n        <DailyReviewModal\n          review={currentDailyReview}\n          onClose={closeDailyReview}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {/* PHASE 11: The Stage Modal */}\n      {showStage && (\n        <StageModal\n          lessonId=\"off_ar_u1_l2\"\n          onClose={() => setShowStage(false)}\n        />\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../services/voice/voiceService';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../../services/curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport { isEscalationTrigger, advanceTutorEscalation } from '../../services/tutor/tutorEngine';\nimport { Badge } from '../common/Badge';\nimport { DayRecordFlowModal } from '../dayRecord/DayRecordFlowModal';\nimport { DailyReviewModal } from '../home/DailyReviewModal';\nimport { StageModal } from '../stage/StageModal';\nimport { VoiceInputControl } from '../voice/VoiceInputControl';\nimport { VoiceSpeakButton } from '../voice/VoiceSpeakButton';\nimport { costLatencyService } from '../../services/telemetry/costLatencyService';\nimport {\n  Bot,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Sparkles,\n  AlertCircle,\n  CalendarCheck,\n  HelpCircle,\n  PlayCircle,\n  CheckCircle2,\n  Trash2,\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\nfunction isWhatShouldIDoIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ماذا') ||\n    s.includes('أعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('اعمل ايه') ||\n    s.includes('نعمل إيه') ||\n    s.includes('نعلم ايه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدأ بإيه') ||\n    s.includes('ابدا بايه') ||\n    s.includes('المطلوب مني') ||\n    s.includes('what should i do') ||\n    s.includes('what to do') ||\n    s.includes('what now') ||\n    s.includes('next task')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFinishedIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('خلصت') ||\n    s.includes('أنهيت') ||\n    s.includes('انهيت') ||\n    s.includes('تم الانتهاء') ||\n    s.includes('انتهيت') ||\n    s.includes('finished') ||\n    s.includes('i finished') ||\n    s.includes('done') ||\n    s.includes('completed')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isSkipIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تخطي') ||\n    s.includes('تخطى') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز دي') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز دي') ||\n    s.includes('تأجيل') ||\n    s.includes('skip') ||\n    s.includes('skip this') ||\n    s.includes('skip mission')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWrapUpIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص يومي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('إنهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('انهاء اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('مراجعة اليوم') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up') ||\n    s.includes('wrap up today') ||\n    s.includes('daily review') ||\n    s.includes('review my day')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isWeeklyReviewIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('لخص أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('لخص اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير أسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('تقرير اسبوعي') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الأسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('ملخص الاسبوع') ||\n    s.includes('show my week') ||\n    s.includes('weekly review') ||\n    s.includes('my week')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isFrustrationIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('تعبت') ||\n    s.includes('زهقت') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادر') ||\n    s.includes('مش قادرة') ||\n    s.includes('مش عايز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('مش عاوز اذاكر') ||\n    s.includes('صعب جدا') ||\n    s.includes('صعبة جدا') ||\n    s.includes('tired') ||\n    s.includes('exhausted') ||\n    s.includes('too hard') ||\n    s.includes('i want to stop') ||\n    s.includes('give up') ||\n    s.includes('frustrated')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction isParentOverrideIntent(text: string): boolean {\n  const s = text.toLowerCase().trim();\n  return (\n    s.includes('ليه وقت المذاكرة اتغير') ||\n    s.includes('ليه خطتي اتغيرت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه المهام قلت') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('ليه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('إشعار توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('اشعار توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الأمر') ||\n    s.includes('توجيه ولي الامر') ||\n    s.includes('why parent') ||\n    s.includes('why was my study time changed') ||\n    s.includes('why did study time change') ||\n    s.includes('why did my plan change')\n  );\n}\n\nexport const CompanionChatScreen: React.FC = () => {\n  const {\n    t,\n    language,\n    student,\n    settings,\n    currentDayRecord,\n    missionsForToday,\n    activeMission,\n    startMission,\n    completeMission,\n    skipMission,\n    setActiveTab,\n    currentDailyReview,\n    isDailyReviewOpen,\n    openDailyReview,\n    closeDailyReview,\n    generateAndOpenWeeklyReview,\n    plannerExplanation,\n    recordEvidence,\n  } = useApp();\n  const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);\n  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');\n  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);\n  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [showReconstructModal, setShowReconstructModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showClearConfirmModal, setShowClearConfirmModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showStage, setShowStage] = useState(false);\n\n  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n  const flaggedRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());\n\n  const studentName = student?.name || (isArabic ? 'صديقي' : 'Friend');\n\n  // Load existing conversation or initialize with introductory message\n  useEffect(() => {\n    async function loadChat() {\n      try {\n        const storedConv = student?.id ? await storageService.getConversation(student.id) : null;\n        if (storedConv && storedConv.messages.length > 0) {\n          setMessages(storedConv.messages);\n        } else {\n          // Welcome message directly adhering to the prompt rules\n          const initialGreeting: ChatMessage = {\n            id: 'msg_welcome_' + Date.now(),\n            role: 'assistant',\n            content: isArabic\n              ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا «الرفيق الدراسي الذكي». أنا نظام ذكاء اصطناعي للتعلم، لست معلماً بشرياً ولست هنا لتقييمك أو معاتبتك. وظيفتي هي تنظيم يومك الدراسي، ومساعدتك لفهم المواد بهدوء وبدون ضغط. كيف كان يومك أو ما الذي تود التحدث عنه؟`\n              : `Hello ${studentName}! I am your AI School Companion. I am an AI system, not a human teacher, and I am not here to judge or scold you. My purpose is to help structure your school day, untangle difficult topics, and ensure you study effectively without burnout. How is your day going?`,\n            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n          };\n          setMessages([initialGreeting]);\n          if (student?.id) {\n            const newConv: AIConversation = {\n              id: 'conv_' + student.id,\n              studentId: student.id,\n              messages: [initialGreeting],\n              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            };\n            await storageService.saveConversation(newConv);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.error('Failed to load conversation:', e);\n      }\n    }\n\n    loadChat();\n  }, [studentName, isArabic, student?.id]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n  }, [messages, isSending]);\n\n  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);\n\n  const handleSendMessage = async (textToSend?: string) => {\n    const content = (textToSend || inputText).trim();\n    if (!content || isSending) return;\n\n    setErrorMessage(null);\n    setInputText('');\n\n    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {\n      id: 'msg_u_' + Date.now(),\n      role: 'user',\n      content,\n      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),\n    };\n\n    const updatedHistory = [...messages, userMessage];\n    setMessages(updatedHistory);\n    setIsSending(true);\n\n    try {\n      let replyContent = '';\n\n      // 1. Check Mission Intent: \"What should I do now?\"\n      if (isWhatShouldIDoIntent(content)) {\n        const topPending =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending' || m.status === 'started');\n\n        if (topPending) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `المهمة المقترحة لك الآن بأعلى أولوية هي:\\n🎯 «${topPending.title}»\\n📚 المادة: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} دقيقة\\n💡 لماذا الآن؟ ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ المصدر: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nهل نتوكل على الله ونبدأها الآن؟`\n            : `Your highest priority mission right now is:\\n🎯 \"${topPending.title}\"\\n📚 Subject: ${topPending.subject} • ⏱️ ${topPending.estimatedMinutes} min\\n💡 Why now? ${topPending.whyNow}\\n🏷️ Origin: [${topPending.originTag}]\\n\\nReady to get started?`;\n        } else if (missionsForToday.length > 0 && missionsForToday.every((m) => m.status === 'completed')) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ما شاء الله عليك يا ${studentName}! 🌟 لقد أكملت جميع مهام اليوم بنجاح (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). استرح واستمتع بوقتك، لقد أنجزت يومك بامتياز!`\n            : `Fantastic job ${studentName}! 🌟 You completed all your daily missions (${missionsForToday.length}/${missionsForToday.length}). Take a restful break!`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهام مجدولة حالياً. يمكنك الانتقال إلى الشاشة الرئيسية وضبط وقت المذاكرة المتاح لنرتب لك مهام اليوم فوراً.`\n            : `No missions are planned yet. You can check the Home screen and adjust your available time to generate today's missions.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 2. Check Mission Intent: \"I finished\"\n      else if (isFinishedIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `ممتاز يا بطلة! لتسجيل إتمام مهمة «${targetMission.title}» رسمياً في سجل إتقانك، تعالي نفتح تمرين المهمة السريع لنتأكد من تثبيت الفكرة ونمنحك نجوم الإنجاز! ⭐`\n            : `Great job! To record completion of \"${targetMission.title}\" in your mastery records, let's open the quick mission check to verify understanding and earn your stars! ⭐`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `رائع جداً! كل مهام اليوم مسجلة كمكتملة، ولا توجد مهمة قيد التنفيذ الآن.`\n            : `Great! All missions are already completed, no active mission pending right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 3. Check Mission Intent: \"Skip this\"\n      else if (isSkipIntent(content)) {\n        const targetMission =\n          activeMission ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'started') ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.status === 'pending');\n\n        if (targetMission) {\n          await skipMission(targetMission.id, 'Student skipped via companion chat');\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `تم تخطي مهمة «${targetMission.title}» بناءً على رغبتك.\\n\\n📌 الملاحظة والأثر الأكاديمي:\\nلا تقلق إطلاقاً يا ${studentName}! هذا ليس تقصيراً. سنقوم فقط بإعادة إدراج هذه المفاهيم في خطة قادمة بهدوء حتى لا تفوتك أساسيات المادة، وبدون أي إرهاق لوقتك اليوم.`\n            : `Mission \"${targetMission.title}\" has been skipped per your request.\\n\\n📌 Consequence & Note:\\nNo worries at all, ${studentName}! This is not a failure. We will simply reschedule these concepts in a future study session so you stay on track, keeping your schedule stress-free.`;\n        } else {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? `لا توجد مهمة نشطة لتخطيها حالياً.`\n            : `There is no active mission to skip right now.`;\n        }\n      }\n      // 4. Check Daily Review Intent: \"wrap up today\" / \"لخص يومي\"\n      else if (isWrapUpIntent(content)) {\n        const review = await openDailyReview();\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `حاضر يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد المراجعة اليومية الهادئة:\\n\\n✨ إنجاز اليوم: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 الخطوة القادمة: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nتم فتح نافذة المراجعة التفصيلية لتطّلع عليها بارتياح.`\n          : `Sure thing, ${studentName}! I have prepared your calm daily review:\\n\\n✨ Win Today: ${review.tonePraise}\\n🧭 Next Step: ${review.uncompletedActionNote}\\n\\nYour Daily Review card has been opened for you.`;\n      }\n      // 4b. Check Weekly Review Intent: \"show my week\" / \"لخص أسبوعي\"\n      else if (isWeeklyReviewIntent(content)) {\n        const wkReview = await generateAndOpenWeeklyReview(true);\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `بكل سرور يا ${studentName}! قمت بإعداد ملخص أسبوعك الدراسي:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageAr}\\n\\n📊 إنجاز الواجبات: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}٪)\\n🎯 التركيز المقترح للأسبوع القادم: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleAr}\\n\\nتم فتح تبويب المراجعة لتتصفح كامل تفاصيل أسبوعك بهدوء.`\n          : `With pleasure, ${studentName}! I have prepared your weekly summary:\\n\\n🌟 ${wkReview.toneMessageEn}\\n\\n📊 Homework: ${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.completed}/${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.total} (${wkReview.homeworkCompletion.percentage}%)\\n🎯 Recommended focus: ${wkReview.recommendedFocus.rationaleEn}\\n\\nI have switched to the Review tab for you to see all the details!`;\n      }\n      // 5. Check AI Tutor Escalation Ladder (\"I don't understand\" / \"Explain differently\")\n      else if (isEscalationTrigger(content)) {\n        const targetConceptId =\n          activeMission?.conceptId ||\n          missionsForToday.find((m) => m.conceptId)?.conceptId ||\n          '';\n\n        if (!student?.id || !targetConceptId) {\n          replyContent = isArabic\n            ? 'أحتاج أولاً إلى تحديد الطالب والمفهوم الذي نعمل عليه. افتحي مهمة اليوم أو اختاري درساً من المنهج، ثم قولي لي «اشرحي بطريقة تانية».'\n            : 'I first need the active student and the concept we are working on. Open today’s mission or choose a curriculum lesson, then ask me to explain it differently.';\n        } else {\n          const tutorResponse = advanceTutorEscalation({\n          studentId: student?.id || '',\n          conceptId: targetConceptId,\n          sessionId: 'companion_session',\n          language,\n        });\n\n        const label = isArabic ? tutorResponse.modalityLabelAr : tutorResponse.modalityLabelEn;\n        const attemptLabel = isArabic\n          ? `(المحاولة ${Math.min(tutorResponse.state.attemptCount, 5)} من ٥)`\n          : `(Attempt ${Math.min(tutorResponse.state.attemptCount, 5)} of 5)`;\n\n        replyContent = `[${label} ${attemptLabel}]\\n\\n${tutorResponse.text}`;\n\n        if (tutorResponse.checkQuestion) {\n          const q = tutorResponse.checkQuestion;\n          replyContent += isArabic\n            ? `\\n\\n❓ سؤال فحص فهم تشجيعي:\\n${q.question}\\n• الخيارات: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`\n            : `\\n\\n❓ Comprehension Check Question:\\n${q.question}\\n• Options: ${q.options?.join(' | ')}`;\n        }\n\n        if (tutorResponse.modality === 'flag_for_review') {\n          let saved = false;\n          if (targetConceptId && !flaggedRef.current.has(targetConceptId)) {\n            try {\n              const recorded = await recordEvidence(targetConceptId, {\n                correctness: 'wrong',\n                difficulty: 0.5,\n                independence: 'revealed',\n                modality: 'reel_check',\n                notes: 'Flagged for review after repeated explanation attempts',\n              });\n              // recordEvidence resolves to null (not throw) when it could not persist.\n              if (recorded) {\n                flaggedRef.current.add(targetConceptId);\n                saved = true;\n              }\n            } catch { /* leave saved=false */ }\n          } else if (targetConceptId) {\n            saved = true; // already flagged this session\n          }\n\n          if (saved) {\n            replyContent += isArabic\n              ? `\\n\\n📌 ملحوظة: تم وسم المفهوم لخانة (المراجعة اللاحقة) لحمايتك من الإرهاق. ما رأيك أن ننتقل لنشاط آخر خفيف؟`\n              : `\\n\\n📌 Note: Concept marked for (Later Review) to prevent fatigue. Would you like to move on to a lighter activity?`;\n          }\n        }\n        }\n      }\n      // 6. Check Student Frustration / Disengagement (Failure mode 1g)\n      // \"Signal detected (session drop, skip streak, tone) -> Companion offers a break or lighter load -> No guilt\"\n      else if (isFrustrationIntent(content)) {\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سلامتك يا ${studentName}! لما تحس بالتعب أو الزهق، أحسن قرار هو إنك تاخد راحة (10 إلى 15 دقيقة) وتفصل خالص. راحتك وصحتك أهم من أي مذاكرة.\\n\\n✨ تحب نخفف خطة اليوم ونكتفي بما أنجزته، ولا نوقف خالص دلوقتي وتستريح؟ مفيش أي مشكلة إطلاقاً، والأيام جاية!`\n          : `Take a deep breath and a gentle pause, ${studentName}! When fatigue or frustration hits, taking a 10-15 minute screen break is the best move. Your well-being comes first.\\n\\n✨ Would you like to lighten today's missions or call it a day? Zero guilt either way!`;\n      }\n      // 6b. Check Parent Override Intent (Failure mode 1h: Student asks why)\n      else if (isParentOverrideIntent(content)) {\n        const msg = plannerExplanation?.parentOverrideMessage;\n        replyContent = isArabic\n          ? `سؤال في محله يا ${studentName}! تم ضبط خطة المذاكرة اليوم لتراعي توجيه ولي أمرك:\\n\\n🛡️ «${msg || 'تم وضع حد زمني مناسب أو موعد نوم هادئ'}»\\n\\nالهدف مش تقليل قدراتك، بل حمايتك من السهر والإرهاق عشان تستمتع بيومك وتصحى بكامل نشاطك. وظيفتي أساعدك تنجز الأساسيات في هذا الوقت بدون أي ضغط!`\n          : `Great question, ${studentName}! Your study plan was adapted to respect your parent's settings:\\n\\n🛡️ \"${msg || 'Daily study limit or bedtime set by parent'}\"\\n\\nThis isn't a restriction, but a healthy safeguard against fatigue and late nights so you can rest. I'm here to ensure you get the most out of your focused study time comfortably!`;\n      }\n      // 7. General Chat via server proxy with 15s timeout & telemetry\n      else {\n        const { data } = await costLatencyService.instrumentedFetch(\n          '/api/chat',\n          {\n            messages: updatedHistory.slice(-8).map((m) => ({\n              role: m.role,\n              content: m.content,\n            })),\n            studentName,\n            grade: student?.grade || 'Grade 5',\n            language,\n            schoolBrainContext: {\n              studentId: student?.id,\n              school: student?.school,\n              location: student?.location,\n              curriculumTrack: student?.curriculumTrack,\n              dayRecord: currentDayRecord\n                ? {\n                    date: currentDayRecord.date,\n                    confirmed: currentDayRecord.confirmed,\n                    lessons: currentDayRecord.lessonsCovered,\n                    homework: currentDayRecord.homeworkAssigned.map((h) => ({\n                      subject: h.subject,\n                      description: h.description,\n                      status: h.status,\n                    })),\n                    notes: currentDayRecord.notes,\n                  }\n                : null,\n              activeMission: activeMission\n                ? {\n                    id: activeMission.id,\n                    subject: activeMission.subject,\n                    lessonId: activeMission.lessonId,\n                    conceptId: activeMission.conceptId,\n                    title: activeMission.title,\n                    status: activeMission.status,\n                    whyNow: activeMission.whyNow,\n                  }\n                : null,\n            },\n          },\n          {\n            studentId: student?.id,\n            language: isArabic ? 'ar' : 'en',\n            timeoutMs: 15000,\n          }\n        );\n\n        replyContent =\n          data.reply ||\n          (isArabic ? async function probe(base) {
  const ac = new AbortController();
  const t = setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), 2500);
  try {
    const r = await fetch(base.replace(/\/$/,'') + '/api/health', { signal: ac.signal, cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return null;
    const j = await r.json();
    if (j && j.status === 'ok') return { base, hasApiKey: !!j.hasApiKey };
  } catch(e) {}
  finally { clearTimeout(t); }
  return null;
}

### ObservationEvent — tool: `finish` — source: `environment` — id: `d01aab49-e01e-43ae-83af-3a8c1560f38b` — 2026-10-16T03:35:08.312172

```
Done. Here's the launcher.

## Open it now

**https://work-1-mwnnzkjqbczyldsa.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/open-app.html**

That page is live and already reports: *"Server running on https://work-1-…all-hands.dev. No API key — AI routes use truthful degraded fallbacks."* The **Open App ↗** button is enabled.

## What it is

`public/open-app.html` — one self-contained HTML file, no build step, no dependencies:

- **Live status dot** — probes the server and shows whether it's up, and whether a Gemini key is present.
- **Open App ↗** / **Open API health ↗** buttons.
- **App address** field — defaults to the origin that served the page, so it works both on the public tunnel and on `localhost:3000`.
- **Copy buttons** for the four start steps (`cd`, `npm install`, `npm run build && npm start`).
- An honest note that without `GEMINI_API_KEY` the AI routes return truthful degraded fallbacks.
- Polls every 8 s, so it flips to green by itself when the server comes up.

## Verified, not assumed

- Served through the public tunnel: launcher **HTTP 200**, app root **HTTP 200**, `/api/health` returns `{"status":"ok","hasApiKey":false,…}`.
- Opened in a real browser at the public URL: the app SPA loads inside the probe iframe and the status line reads green with the correct key state.
- HTML tags balanced (24/24 divs), inline JS passes `node --check`.

## Two things worth knowing

1. **I had to switch the server to production mode on port 12000.** Vite's dev middleware blocked the tunnel host with `403 Blocked request. This host is not allowed` — it wants `server.allowedHosts` in `vite.config.ts`. Production mode (`NODE_ENV=production`) serves the prebuilt `dist/` and has no host check. So I did **not** touch `vite.config.ts` or `server.ts`; the app code is unchanged.

2. **It is not committed or pushed.** Adding the file to `public/` means it gets copied into `dist/` and would ride along on the next GitHub Pages build. Given your standing "do not deploy / do not push without confirmation" rule, I left it untracked. Say the word and I'll commit it to the `fix/truth-pass-1` branch (or keep it local-only).

One caveat: the tunnel URL is tied to this workspace session, so it works while this session is alive. For a permanent entry point, the `public/open-app.html` file is the thing to keep — running `npm run build && npm start` reproduces it on any machine at `/open-app.html`.
```

Confirmed in a real browser: green status, app SPA loaded in the probe iframe. Here is the straight answer to your question.

## Yes — it is running now. But it was NOT running when you sent that screenshot.

You were right to check. That `502 Bad Gateway` was real. I ran the diagnostics and here is exactly what I found:

```
/tmp/amina: GONE          <- the working copy did not exist
server.ts process: none   <- no server running
port 12000: nothing listening
public URL: HTTP 502 Bad Gateway
```

**My mistake.** I built it in `/tmp/amina`, and `/tmp` is throw-away scratch space in this environment. The workspace got recycled between my message and yours, so the server, the build, and even the launcher file were wiped. I handed you a link without making it survive a restart. That is on me.

## Fixed and re-verified

I moved everything into **persistent** storage at `/workspace/project/Amina` and rebuilt:

| Check | Result now |
|---|---|
| Local `/open-app.html` | **HTTP 200** |
| Local app root `/` | **HTTP 200** |
| `/api/health` | `{"status":"ok","hasApiKey":false,...}` |
| Public launcher URL | **HTTP 200** |
| Loaded in real browser | status dot **green**, app SPA renders |

**The link works again:** https://work-1-mwnnzkjqbczyldsa.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/open-app.html

## One thing I must be honest about

{
 "command": "create",
 "path": "/workspace/project/Amina/public/sw.js",
 "file_text": "/* Amina service worker.\n *\n * Two jobs:\n *  1. Make the app installable (an installable app needs a service worker).\n *  2. Keep the shell working offline.\n *\n * It never caches /api/* . AI answers must be live or honestly degraded; a\n * cached answer presented as fresh would be the exact lying this project is\n * removing. Cross-origin requests (fonts) are left to the browser.\n */\n\nconst VERSION = 'amina-v1';\nconst SHELL = `${VERSION}-shell`;\nconst ASSETS = `${VERSION}-assets`;\n\nconst CORE = ['/', '/index.html', '/manifest.webmanifest', '/icon.svg'];\n\nself.addEventListener('install', (event) => {\n  event.waitUntil(\n    caches.open(SHELL).then((c) => c.addAll(CORE)).then(() => self.skipWaiting())\n  );\n});\n\nself.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {\n  event.waitUntil(\n    caches.keys()\n      .then((keys) => Promise.all(\n        keys.filter((k) => !k.startsWith(VERSION)).map((k) => caches.delete(k))\n      ))\n      .then(() => self.clients.claim())\n  );\n});\n\nself.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {\n  const { request } = event;\n\n  // Only GET. Never touch the API: live data or nothing.\n  if (request.method !== 'GET') return;\n\n  const url = new URL(request.url);\n  if (url.origin !== self.location.origin) return;\n  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return;\n\n  // Navigations: network first, fall back to the cached shell offline.\n  if (request.mode === 'navigate') {\n    event.respondWith(\n      fetch(request)\n        .then((res) => {\n          const copy = res.clone();\n          caches.open(SHELL).then((c) => c.put('/index.html', copy)).catch(() => {});\n          return res;\n        })\n        .catch(() => caches.match('/index.html').then((r) => r || caches.match('/')))\n    );\n    return;\n  }\n\n  // Hashed build assets: cache first, they never change under one name.\n  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/assets/')) {\n    event.respondWith(\n      caches.match(request).then((hit) => hit || fetch(request).then((res) => {\n        const copy = res.clone();\n        caches.open(ASSETS).then((c) => c.put(request, copy)).catch(() => {});\n        return res;\n      }))\n    );\n    return;\n  }\n\n  // Everything else: try network, fall back to cache.\n  event.respondWith(\n    fetch(request)\n      .then((res) => {\n        const copy = res.clone();\n        caches.open(SHELL).then((c) => c.put(request, copy)).catch(() => {});\n        return res;\n      })\n      .catch(() => caches.match(request))\n  );\n});\n",

Everything verified. Here's the honest picture.

## You were right — and it's fixed properly now

A link that dies with a session is not an app. I've replaced it with real, permanent infrastructure.

## The permanent URL already existed — nobody had made it an app

GitHub Pages is configured for this repo and is **live right now**:

**https://madnessgate44-debug.github.io/Amina/**

It returns HTTP 200 today. But it served only the pre-PWA build — openable, not installable. That's the gap I closed.

## What I built

**Installable app** — manifest, SVG + PNG + maskable icons, and a service worker. Amina now installs to a phone home screen or desktop and opens in its own window, like ChatGPT's app.

**Permanent hosting for the full app** — `render.yaml` and a `Dockerfile`, so the AI routes can run on an always-on host, not a sandbox.

**Launcher + SPA fallback** — `public/open-app.html` and `public/404.html`.

## One deliberate choice

**The service worker never caches `/api/*`.** Caching an AI answer and serving it as fresh would be precisely the dishonesty this whole project exists to remove. The shell is cached; AI answers are always live or honestly degraded.

## Verified, not claimed

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm run build` | exit 0 |
| `npm run lint` | 12 errors — identical pre-existing baseline, none in my files |
| `sw.js` syntax | OK |
| manifest | valid JSON, `application/manifest+json` |
| `/sw.js`, all icons, manifest, `/404.html` | HTTP 200, correct content types |
| App in real browser | loads |
| Built `dist/index.html` | carries manifest + icon + theme tags |
| Secret scan on pushed diff | clean |

**PR #3 opened:** https://github.com/madnessgate44-debug/Amina/pull/3 — open, mergeable, 13 files, head `d73c052`.

## What you actually need to do

**One click.** After merging PR #3, run the "Deploy to GitHub Pages" workflow once. The installable app then goes live at the URL above. Pages deploys are manual-only by design — that was a deliberate safety change from T1, to stop auto-deploys shipping unreviewed code.

**Two honest limits I won't paper over:**

1. **Pages is static.** It installs and opens the app, but the AI routes need the server. For live AI answers, deploy `render.yaml` and set `GEMINI_API_KEY`. That's a 5-minute Render setup I can't do for you — it needs your account.
2. **I did not merge or enable auto-deploy.** Both are your call. Say the word and I'll merge PR #3 and dispatch the Pages build so the permanent installable URL is live.

   "text": "public async instrumentedFetch<T = any>(\n    endpoint: string,\n    payload: any,\n    options: {\n      studentId?: string;\n      language?: 'ar' | 'en';\n      model?: string;\n      timeoutMs?: number;\n    } = {}\n  ): Promise<{ data: T; metric: ApiCallMetric }> {\n    const t0 = performance.now();\n    const timeout = options.timeoutMs || TELEMETRY_TARGETS.MAX_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS;\n    const controller = new AbortController();\n    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeout);\n\n    const lang = options.language || 'ar';\n    const payloadStr = JSON.stringify(payload);\n    const tokensIn = this.estimateTokens(payloadStr, lang);\n\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(endpoint, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: payloadStr,\n        signal: controller.signal,\n      });\n\n      clearTimeout(timer);\n      const t1 = performance.now();\n      const latencyMs = Math.round(t1 - t0);\n\n      const data = await res.json();\n      const responseStr = JSON.stringify(data);\n      const tokensOut = this.estimateTokens(responseStr, lang);\n\n      const metric = this.recordCall({\n        endpoint,\n        model: options.model || data.model || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n        tokensIn,\n        tokensOut,\n        latencyMs,\n        status: data.source === 'error_fallback' ? 'fallback' : 'success',\n        studentId: options.studentId,\n      });\n\n      return { data, metric };\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      clearTimeout(timer);\n      const t1 = performance.now();\n      const latencyMs = Math.round(t1 - t0);\n\n      const metric = this.recordCall({\n        endpoint,\n        model: options.model || 'local_fallback',\n        tokensIn,\n        tokensOut: 10,\n        latencyMs,\n        status: 'error',\n        studentId: options.studentId,\n      });\n\n      throw err;"
  }

The audit is complete. Here's the report.

## Forge audit of `madnessgate44-debug/Amina` — COMPLETED

**Run:** https://github.com/madnessgate44-debug/Firstborn/actions/runs/38853827680
**Audited commit:** `2c4f3b23` (the merged PWA commit — so it includes today's work)
**Scope:** 141 files, 22 excerpts, 4 lenses × 2 competing attempts each.

## "Gemini and Groq only" — confirmed, not assumed

This mattered, so I verified the mechanism instead of trusting a label. The `company-audit.yml` workflow passes **exactly** `GROQ_API_KEY` and `GEMINI_API_KEY` into the run — no other provider. And freelm's `keyless: 'auto'` adds anonymous endpoints *only when no keys are set*. With both keys present, no anonymous fallback is reachable.

The run log confirms it: every winning model is a Google model — `gemini-3.5-flash` (Architecture) and `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` (Security, Quality, Configuration). No third-party provider answered.

**One honest caveat:** Groq was configured and available but Gemini won every lens. That's the router preferring Gemini, not Groq failing.

## Results — 9 findings, honestly graded

| Grade | Count | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Verified facts | 2 | machine-checked, rerunnable |
| Judgment calls | 6 | opinions, not proven |
| Withdrawn by evidence | 1 | a check disproved it |
| Version-grounding drops | 4 | registry contradicted the claim |

**The two verified facts:**
1. **HIGH — Missing lockfile.** I confirmed this independently: no `package-lock.json`, `yarn.lock`, or `pnpm-lock.yaml` is tracked. Real.
2. **INFO — `/api/health` leaks `hasApiKey`.** Confirmed: `server.ts:57` returns `hasApiKey: Boolean(apiKey)` to any unauthenticated caller. Minor, but real.

**The four "dropped" findings** are the engine working correctly — it claimed TypeScript and React versions were stale, then the npm registry check proved they're current and the engine withdrew them rather than shipping a false claim. Four other findings were withdrawn the same way.

## Where the verification panel was wrong

All four panel members **OBJECTED**, but not accurately:

- **Reviewer** objected that `aminaCurriculumConfig.ts` and `officialCurriculum.ts` "are not present." I checked: **both exist and are tracked in git.** The objection is false.
- The other three objected that missing-lockfile and path-resolution findings "cannot be verified" because excerpts were incomplete. For the lockfile, I verified it directly — **the finding is true.** The panel lacked the file inventory, not the finding.

The engine kept these objections visible rather than hiding them, which is the correct behavior. But an objection is not a refutation, and here three of the four were unfounded.

## Report saved

Full report with every machine check and its raw result: `docs/audits/amina-2c4f3b23.md` in the Firstborn repo (147 lines). I did not commit it — say the word and I will.

## What I did not do

The audit is read-only by design. It wrote nothing to Amina, created no branch, and executed no target code. Findings are recommendations; nothing was auto-fixed.

**Want me to act on the two verified findings?** The lockfile is a one-command fix (`npm install --package-lock-only` and commit). The `hasApiKey` field is a one-line removal. Both are small and safe.

## Separately — something the audit didn't cover

While verifying, I found **PR #2 (`fix/truth-pass-1`, T1–T7) is still open and unmerged.** Its auto-deploy trigger was also removed, so a push to `main` now auto-deploys. Two consequences worth your attention:

1. The truth-pass fixes are **not** in `main` and not on the live site.
2. `main` still contains a chat path that **fabricates a friendly reply when the AI call fails** — the exact dishonesty that branch was written to remove. It appears to be dead code (`CompanionChatScreen` isn't imported anywhere), but the live chat screen's error path silently substitutes canned lesson text on failure.

That's the opposite of the audit's "hardcoded/exposed API key" finding the engine withdrew. Tell me how you want to handle PR #2.

## The run is done — and the answer is **do not merge #116**

**Run:** https://github.com/madnessgate44-debug/Firstborn/actions/runs/39074720296
**Result:** `Files examined: 72/100 (72%)` — **8 of 29 chunks failed.**

Your rule was explicit: if the report shows 100% *and* every chunk answered, merge; if any chunk failed, send the report. **A chunk failed. I did not merge.**

## Why the chunks failed — and it isn't the sweep

The failures aren't random. Every failed chunk is the same error: `model returned no parseable JSON`. And there's a bigger problem underneath it.

**#116 silently disabled the Gemini/Groq routing you asked for.** Look at the route each run actually used — same secrets, same target, same hour:

| Ref | Path | Route actually used |
|---|---|---|
| `main` | sampled | **google/gemini-flash-latest**, gemini-3.5, gemini-2.5 |
| `feat/full-coverage-audit` | sampled | **kilo/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free** |
| `feat/full-coverage-audit` | full | **kilo/nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free** |

I ran the `main` control deliberately, because a claim this strong needs a control. Same secrets, same repo, same minute — `main` routes to **Gemini**, #116 routes to a **keyless NVIDIA model**. That's the one-line change in `src/company/model.ts`:

```
-  keyless: hasProviderKeys ? 'auto' : true,
+  keyless: keylessOption(this.env),   // always true
```

**The premise in #116's own comment is wrong.** It claims freelm gives keyless endpoints `priority: 100`, so they're "tried only after every keyed provider." I read freelm's source: `priority: 100` means **higher number = higher precedence**, not lower. The keyed providers get the *default* priority. So `keyless: true` doesn't demote the anonymous endpoints — it **promotes them above Gemini and Groq**. The PR reasoned backwards and shipped a change that demotes your paid-quality keys to last resort.

This also explains the failures: the anonymous Kilo endpoints are rate-limited to **3 requests/minute per IP**, and a full sweep fires 29 rapid calls. The weak model then returns prose instead of JSON — hence `no parseable JSON`. The rate limit doesn't break the *chunk*, it breaks the *model's ability to answer in JSON*.

So the two problems compound: the routing change makes the sweep run on the one route that can't sustain a sweep.

Two prior runs on the same branch already showed it — and were misread as success:

- 95% (3 chunks failed) — route: `kilo/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free`

**Run 39074720296** → `Files examined: 72/100 (72%)`, **8 of 29 chunks failed.**

## Correction: my previous root-cause was wrong

Last message I told you freelm's `priority: 100` meant keyless endpoints get tried **first**, and called it a priority inversion. **That was wrong, and I should not have stated it without testing.** I tested it properly this time:

```
keyless:true  -> google(p=0) , groq(p=0) , kilo(p=100) , ovh(p=100)
keyless:auto  -> google(p=0) , groq(p=0)
```

Higher number is *worse*. Keyed providers sort **first**, keyless **last**. #116's premise was correct; my objection to it was not. I apologize for the noise.

## The actual root cause — proven

The problem isn't ordering, it's **pool membership**. On `main`, hard work used `keyless: 'auto'`, which builds a **keyed-only** pool when keys exist. #116 replaced that with `keyless: true` unconditionally, which **always adds the anonymous Kilo/OVHcloud routes**. I verified what that does when a keyed tier is rate-limited:

```
keyless:true  -> calls: groq,kilo,ovh,google,groq,kilo   WINNER: kilo
keyless:'auto'-> calls: groq,google,groq,google,google   ERROR: NoProvidersAvailable
```

So the fallback *is* a genuine last resort, as the PR intended. But the outcome is what matters, and the outcome is measured in the run, not the intent:

| Ref | Path | Route actually used |
|---|---|---|
| `main` | sampled | **google/gemini-flash-latest**, gemini-3.5, gemini-2.5 |
| `feat/full-coverage-audit` | sampled | **kilo/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free** |
| `feat/full-coverage-audit` | full | **kilo/nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free** |

Same secrets, same target, same hour. `main` lands on Gemini; #116 lands on a keyless NVIDIA model. And Kilo is capped at **~3 requests/minute per IP** — a 29-chunk sweep blows straight through that, and the weaker model starts answering in prose instead of JSON. That's the 8 failures.

**What I have not proven:** *why* the keyed providers didn't serve these calls (quota exhaustion vs. model-discovery). `routeErrors` is collected but never printed, so the logs don't say. The routing change is the differentiator — the control proves that — but the exact trigger is inferred, not observed. I'm flagging that rather than dressing it up.

The agreed merge rule required 100% with every chunk answered, so #116\nwas not merged and no branch was pushed to the target.\n\nThis commit records the evidence and the diagnosis, read-only:\n\n- full-coverage-verdict-7b832d61.md  the verdict, the acceptance result, the\n  root cause, the correction to an earlier wrong claim, and the minimal fix.\n- firstborn-full-7b832d61.md         the raw audit report as emitted.\n- amina-2c4f3b23.md                  the earlier Amina company audit.\n- README.md                          index and the run ids behind each claim.\n\nRoot cause: the defect is pool membership, not ordering. main used\n`keyless: hasProviderKeys ? Done. The findings and report are now in the repo on an isolated branch with a reviewable PR.

## What I added

**PR #117** → https://github.com/madnessgate44-debug/Firstborn/pull/117
Branch `forge/full-coverage-audit-verdict`, based on `main` at `7b832d61`. **Documentation only — 4 files, +945, −0. No code, no workflows, no dependencies touched.** That keeps the diff clean so Claude can read the reasoning without wading through implementation changes.

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `docs/audits/full-coverage-verdict-7b832d61.md` | The verdict — start here. Acceptance result, root cause, my correction, minimal fix. |
| `docs/audits/firstborn-full-7b832d61.md` | The raw report exactly as the audit CLI emitted it (47 findings, 8 failed chunks). |
| `docs/audits/amina-2c4f3b23.md` | The earlier Amina company audit, so both are in one place. |
| `docs/audits/README.md` | Index plus the four run IDs behind every claim. |

## What the document establishes

**The acceptance test failed.** Run `39074720296` returned `Files examined: 72/100 (72%)`, 8 of 29 chunks failed, all on `model returned no parseable JSON`. Your rule required 100% with every chunk answered, so #116 stays a draft.

**Root cause is pool membership, not ordering.** `main` used `keyless: hasProviderKeys ? 'auto' : true` — a keyed-only pool when keys exist. #116 made it unconditionally `true`, which always appends the anonymous Kilo/OVHcloud routes. The control runs prove it: same secrets, same target, same minute — `main` routes to **Gemini**, the #116 branch routes to **Kilo/NVIDIA**. Kilo allows ~3 requests/minute per IP, and a 29-chunk sweep exceeds that.

**I included my correction.** My earlier "priority inversion" claim was wrong, and the document says so plainly rather than quietly dropping it. Measurement showed keyed providers sort first (`p=0`), keyless last (`p=100`) — #116's stated premise was right. If Claude is reviewing this, the record should show the error and its correction, not just the final answer.

**I flagged what I did *not* prove.** `routeErrors` is collected but never printed, so the logs never state *why* the keyed providers didn't serve those calls. The routing change is proven to be the differentiator by the control; the specific trigger is inferred. That's labeled as inferred in the document, and I recommended surfacing `routeErrors` as a fix in its own right.

**The "globe" question is recorded as a closed negative**, so it isn't mistaken later for unaddressed feedback. And "PR C" is identified as Phase C of the Amina work order, not a pull request.

## Safety

- #116 **untouched** at `685026b3`, still draft.
- No writes to Amina or any target repo. No merges, no deployment.
- The push hit an auth prompt because the cached remote URL had a stale token. I switched the remote to the tokenless HTTPS URL and pushed via the environment token through a one-off header — so **no token is stored in `.git/config`** (verified). Worth knowing: that stale credential in the clone's remote URL is why the first push hung.
- Working tree clean; my two throwaway `freelm` probe scripts are deleted.

## Suggested next step

Claude's review will likely land on one question: whether the minimal fix is to restore `'auto'` for the hard tier. I'd hold that decision for the review rather than act on it, since that same line also governs `src/services/model.ts` — it's a behavioral change to Forge's main engine, not just the audit path.

Once Claude has looked, I can prepare that fix on its own branch and re-run the full sweep to confirm 100% before you decide on #116.
```
